jobs.title: Systems Engineer - Test
jobs.description:
At Boeing, we innovate and collaborate to make the world a better place. We’re committed to fostering an environment for every teammate that’s welcoming, respectful and inclusive, with great opportunity for professional growth. Find your future with us.

**Boeing Defense & Space (BDS)** is seeking a motivated **associate Systems Engineer** for Sapphire Program in the Systems Engineering Integration and Test (SEIT) team located in Huntsville, AL. Sapphire for BDS is Boeing’s enterprise modernization program to standardize and unify digital engineering, supply chain, and manufacturing processes across defense platforms. This role partners with IT (Information Technology), engineering, supply chain, manufacturing, quality, and stakeholders to plan, track, and deliver program objectives on schedule, within budget, and to the required technical performance and safety standards. The Systems Engineer will report to the Sr Manager of the SEIT organization and partner day-to-day with the Systems Engineering Integration & Test (SEIT) Test Lead, and the Integrated Product Team (IPT) leads.

The selected candidate can work in any of the following locations: **Arlington, VA; Ridley Park, PA; Huntsville, AL; Berkeley, MO; Hazelwood, MO; Oklahoma City, OK; Plano, TX; San Antonio, TX; Mesa, AZ; El Segundo, CA; Huntington Beach, CA; Long Beach, CA; or Seal Beach, CA.**

**Position Responsibilities:**

* Supporting end-to-end Systems Engineering Integration & Test (SEIT) efforts for the Sapphire program, implementing test strategy, planning, execution, and closure across lab, ground, and flight environments.
* Support the Test Lead with maintaining the program-level test & verification master plan, detailed test plans, procedures, and acceptance criteria; ensure traceability to system requirements.
* Coordinate cross-discipline integration and test activities with cross functional IT bedrocks (ERP, MES, PDM) and I&I and subcontractor teams.
* Execute testing for complex system-level integration events, anomaly resolution, root-cause analysis, and corrective actions; drive test defect lifecycle to closure.
* Establish and implement test automation, repeatability, and regression frameworks to facilitate continuous integration and continuous verification.
* Ensure compliance with applicable aerospace standards and certification artifacts (e.g., DO-178C, DO-254, MIL‑STD, program-specific compliance requirements), and support certification authorities and program audits.
* Produce and present test status, risk assessments, metrics, findings, and recommendations to program leadership and stakeholders; maintain schedule and resource forecasts.
* Incorporate safety, cybersecurity, and configuration management controls into test planning and execution; ensure test activities respect export control and classified handling requirements when applicable.

**This position is expected to be 100% onsite. The selected candidate will be required to work onsite at one of the listed location options.**

**This position requires the ability to obtain a U.S. Security Clearance for which the U.S. Government requires U.S. Citizenship. Final U.S. Secret Clearance Post-Start is required.**

**Basic Qualifications** **(Required Skills & Experience):** **(please see education and experience for the levels below)**

* Bachelor of Science degree from an accredited course of study in engineering, engineering technology (includes manufacturing engineering technology), chemistry, physics, mathematics, data science, or computer science.
* 1+ years of experience in systems integration and test, with at least 1 year with complex, multi-discipline test teams or test organizations.
* 1+ years of experience in supporting and executing system-level test plans, procedures, and campaigns across lab, HIL, and flight environments.
* 1+ years of experience in software integration, embedded/real-time software testing, telemetry and data analysis; familiarity with flight-test support processes.
* 1+ years of experience with test automation and scripting in at least one language/toolset (e.g., Python, MATLAB, LabVIEW, Tcl).
* 1+ years of experience in applying requirements-based verification and maintain requirement-to-test traceability using tools such as DOORS, Polarion, or equivalent.
* 1+ years of experience in configuration management, anomaly/defect tracking tools (e.g., JIRA, TeamCenter), and test data management.
* 1+ years of experience in supporting root-cause analysis and driving corrective actions across organizational boundaries.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills

**Preferred Qualifications** **(Desired Skills & Experience):**

* Master’s degree in Systems Engineering, Engineering Management, or related technical discipline.
* Prior experience with Boeing or other major aerospace/defense program test leadership, ideally on reconnaissance, space, or ISR programs.
* Knowledge of and experience supporting certification/compliance processes relevant to defense systems (DO-178C, DO-254, MIL‑STD‑882 for safety, RMF for cybersecurity).
* Experience with RF and sensor integration, networking, distributed systems, SATCOM, or EW domains relevant to the Sapphire mission set.
* Familiarity with continuous integration/continuous delivery pipelines for embedded systems and related toolchains (Jenkins, GitLab, etc.).
* Experience with model-based systems engineering (MBSE) tools and workflows (e.g., SysML, Cameo, MagicDraw).

jobs.description:
**Standard Job Description**
----------------------------

Get ready for a challenge at the speed of Hypersonics.

Join Lockheed's Long Range Hypersonic Weapon (LRHW) team in Huntsville, AL. Our system will travel at Mach 5 (over a mile per second), providing a timely response to varying threat scenarios.

Learn more about our Hypersonic Solutions and the LRHW program

The LRHW program is seeking a **Systems Engineering Associate Manager** to join the team in Rocket City USA - Huntsville, AL.

The successful candidate will have a strong background in systems engineering and technical leadership.

You will lead a team to integrate hypersonic missile technology into an Army battery on a highly accelerated schedule to deliver a hypersonic operational system to the soldier.

**Key Responsibilities** of this role are, but not limited to, the following:

* Provide leadership and project management of the HWIL team on the LRHW program, including systems integration, test planning and execution for on‑site activities
* Provide technical guidance and oversight to a team of systems engineers, including mentoring and coaching to develop their skills and promote a positive teamwork culture
* Coordinate the planning, organizing, control, integration, and completion of engineering projects within area of assigned responsibility
* Perform data reviews and provide feedback to test and integration teams
* Work closely with Navigation, Guidance & Control, Flight Software development, and integration teams to ensure compliance with integration standards and test procedures.
* Accountability for the technical, cost, risk, and schedule aspects and ultimate completion of HWIL deliverables
* Perform managerial and administrative tasks for personnel such as annual performance reviews, timecards, career development, and training
* Coordinate employee recruitment, selection and training, performance assessment, work assignments, salary, and recognition/disciplinary actions

**Basic Qualifications**
------------------------

Experience with one or more of the below listed Systems Engineering processes and Systems Integration functions:

**Required Experience & Skills**

* Technical background in software engineering with hands-on experience using Agile methodology.
* Proven technical leadership of multidisciplinary teams.
* Experience with System Integration, Test, and/or Verification in a Hardware-in-the-Loop (HWIL) environment.
* Demonstrated experience in test planning and implementation, including understanding of complex interdependencies.

**Leadership & Behavioral Competencies**

* Proven ability to effectively communicate with customers and senior management, building strong, productive relationships.
* Demonstrated Full Spectrum Leadership commitment to: Building Effective Relationships, Energizing the Team, Delivering Results, Modeling Personal Excellence, Integrity, and Accountability.

Active or Current DoD Secret Security Clearance

**Desired Skills**
------------------

* Experience with embedded software/hardware
* Experience with Verification and Validation
* Requirements and Interface Control Document (ICD) development
* Experience leading teams/projects in a fast-paced, mutltidisciplinary enviroment with proven results
* Proven ability to support major milestone reviews (e.g. SRR, PDR, CDR, etc.)
* Demonstrated ability to manage complex technical systems/programs and collaborate with multi-functional teams
* Strong business acumen, management influence and whole systems thinking
* Technical leadership experience within SMD, Strike Weapon, or other large scale weapon systems

**Pay Information**

Full-Time Salary Range: $104900.00 - $194700.00

jobs.description:

At Blue Origin, we envision millions of people living and working in space for the benefit of Earth. We’re working to develop reusable, safe, and low-cost space vehicles and systems within a culture of safety, collaboration, and inclusion. Join our team of problem solvers as we add new chapters to the history of spaceflight!

This role is part of the Blue Origin Engines business unit, where our focus is the design, development, manufacturing, and testing of engines and propulsion systems. Built for multiple uses, our family of engines is powering the next generation of rockets for commercial, civil, national security, and human spaceflight.

We are seeking an Embedded Software Engineer to develop, test, and maintain software for embedded control platforms used in power conversion and power electronics systems. This role focuses on firmware and low-level software for microcontrollers, DSPs, and FPGAs, with close interaction between software, control algorithms, sensors, ADCs, gate drivers, and power hardware. The ideal candidate is a hands-on embedded software engineer who enjoys working close to the hardware. They can write reliable real-time code for microcontrollers, DSPs, and FPGA-based platforms, understand how software interacts with sensors, ADCs, PWM, gate drivers, and protection circuits, and are comfortable debugging systems in the lab.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Develop embedded software and firmware for microcontrollers, DSPs, and FPGA-based control platforms.
* Implement low-level drivers, control interfaces, communication protocols, and real-time software for power electronics systems.
* Interface with ADCs, voltage sensors, current sensors, temperature sensors, PWM modules, timers, gate drivers, and protection circuits.
* Implement software for sensor acquisition, scaling, filtering, calibration, diagnostics, and fault handling.
* Support real-time control execution for power converters, inverters, motor drives, and related power electronics applications.
* Develop and debug communication interfaces such as CAN, SPI, I2C, UART, Ethernet, and other embedded protocols.
* Work closely with hardware, controls, and power electronics engineers during board bring-up, integration, and validation.
* Debug embedded software issues related to timing, interrupts, ADC readings, PWM synchronization, communications, and fault responses.
* Perform software testing, hardware-in-the-loop testing, lab validation, and documentation.

**Required Qualifications**

* Experience developing embedded software or firmware for microcontrollers, DSPs, or FPGA-based systems.
* Strong programming experience in C/C++ for real-time embedded systems.
* Understanding of ADCs, PWM generation, timers, interrupts, communication peripherals, and low-level hardware interfaces.
* Experience working with voltage, current, and temperature sensor data in embedded systems.
* Knowledge of real-time software design, debugging, and hardware/software integration.
* Ability to read schematics and work closely with hardware engineers during board bring-up and troubleshooting.
* Hands-on experience using embedded development tools, debuggers, oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, and lab equipment.
* BS Engineering (computer engineering, electrical engineering, mechatronics, or similar) and 7+ years relevant industry experience

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with power electronics, power converters, inverters, motor drives, battery systems, or renewable energy systems.
* Experience with DSP platforms, FPGA logic integration, VHDL/Verilog, or FPGA-based control systems.
* Familiarity with control algorithms for power electronics or motor control.
* Experience with fault detection, protection logic, diagnostics, and safety-critical embedded systems.
* Knowledge of bootloaders, RTOS, device drivers, memory management, and embedded software architecture.
Experience with hardware-in-the-loop testing, automated testing, or production software validation.

The ideal candidate is a hands-on hardware engineer with strong experience in embedded control board design for power electronics. * Design embedded control board hardware for power conversion systems, including converters, inverters, motor drives, and related power electronics platforms.
* Develop control board architectures using microcontrollers, DSPs, FPGAs, ADCs, and mixed-signal circuitry.
* Design voltage, current, and temperature sensing circuits for accurate system monitoring and control.
* Develop signal conditioning, filtering, scaling, isolation, and protection circuitry for sensor inputs.
* Interface analog sensing circuits with ADCs and validate measurement accuracy, resolution, timing, calibration, and noise performance.
* Support schematic design, component selection, PCB layout review, board bring-up, testing, and troubleshooting.
* Work closely with firmware, controls, and power electronics engineers to integrate control boards with power stages, gate drivers, sensors, and communication interfaces.
* Debug control board hardware issues related to ADC readings, sensor accuracy, grounding, EMI, isolation, timing, and protection behavior.
* Validate control board performance in lab environments using oscilloscopes, power supplies, meters, signal generators, and other test equipment.

**Required Qualifications**

* Experience designing embedded control board hardware for power electronics or power conversion systems.
* Strong understanding of microcontrollers, DSPs, FPGAs, ADCs, and digital control hardware.
* Experience with voltage, current, and temperature sensing architecture.
* Knowledge of ADC signal chains, analog front-end design, signal conditioning, filtering, calibration, and measurement accuracy.
* Familiarity with mixed-signal PCB design considerations, including grounding, isolation, noise reduction, EMI, and high-voltage system interfaces.
* Ability to read schematics, review PCB layouts, bring up new hardware, and troubleshoot board-level issues.
* Hands-on lab experience testing and validating embedded control electronics.
* BS Engineering (computer engineering, electrical engineering, or similar) and 5+ years relevant industry experience.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with power converters, inverters, motor drives, battery systems, renewable energy systems, or high-voltage power electronics.
* Experience with gate driver interfaces, fault detection, protection circuits, and isolated sensing.
* Familiarity with CAN, SPI, I2C, UART, Ethernet, PWM, and other embedded communication or control interfaces.
* Experience supporting hardware from concept through prototype, validation, and production release.

jobs.title: Systems Engineer (Senior)
jobs.description:
**Systems Engineer (Senior)**

**Location:** Huntsville, AL  
**Clearance Required:** Active Top Secret  
**Experience Level:** Senior (Minimum 8 years)  
**Education Required:** Bachelor’s degree (B.S. or B.A.)

**Position Overview:**

We are seeking a **Systems Engineer (Senior)** to support complex IT infrastructure and system engineering projects in **Huntsville, AL**. The ideal candidate will possess strong hands-on experience with Microsoft Windows environments, system integration, virtualization technologies, and information security compliance. This role includes design, implementation, and maintenance of enterprise systems and network infrastructure in support of mission-critical operations.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Supervise, coordinate and/or design, develop and perform additions and changes to **network hardware, infrastructure server environments, and operating systems, and attached devices,** including **investigation, analysis, recommendation, configuration, installation, and testing** of new network hardware and software.
* Conduct analysis, configuration, testing, and deployment of **new hardware and software**, ensuring performance and security compliance.
* Provide **direct operations support** for infrastructure components including system performance evaluation, problem resolution, and hardware/software diagnostics.
* Troubleshoot issues at both the **physical and logical levels**, including network protocol analysis (e.g., TCP/IP) and physical device inspection.
* Participate in the planning, design, review, and deployment of **network and system upgrades**, including voice and data systems.
* Support **systems integration**, virtualization, and network administration tasks.
* Maintain systems in accordance with **security standards**, including application of approved patches and updates.
* Develop and maintain **Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs)** and quick reference guides.
* Support and help navigate **system accreditation processes**, including tasks associated with certification and documentation.
* Provide top-level technical expertise in support of **client/server environments**, including strategy development and infrastructure design.
* Advise on **hardware/software procurement**, system upgrades, and future-state architectures.
* Assist with **FISMA compliance**, including application of **NIST 800-53 controls** and participation in security documentation processes.

  

**Required Qualifications:**

* **8+ years of experience** in systems engineering, infrastructure support, or network administration.
* Strong background with **Microsoft Windows** and **Active Directory environments**.
* Understanding of **NIST 800-series publications** and **FISMA** compliance practices.
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field.
* **Active Top Secret Clearance** required.

  

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience with **VMware vSphere 7** and virtualization infrastructure.
* Familiarity with **Cisco networking** and network troubleshooting.
* Hands-on experience with **Dell server hardware** and **SAN storage systems**.
* Exposure to **system accreditation and authorization (ATO)** processes, particularly those involving the **FBI**.
* Experience evaluating, documenting, and managing **NIST 800-53** control implementations.
* Experience with **Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC)** tools such as **RiskVision, Xacta**, or **JCAM**.

defined problems (i.e. thrive in an environment where the problem is vague, requirements are lacking, and a solution is not obvious). We need problem solvers.

**Description**
---------------

At Northrop Grumman, our employees have incredible opportunities to work on revolutionary systems that impact people's lives around the world today, and for generations to come. Our pioneering and inventive spirit has enabled us to be at the forefront of many technological advancements in our nation's history - from the first flight across the Atlantic Ocean, to stealth bombers, to landing on the moon. We look for people who have bold new ideas, courage and a pioneering spirit to join forces to invent the future, and have fun along the way. Our culture thrives on intellectual curiosity, cognitive diversity and bringing your whole self to work — and we have an insatiable drive to do what others think is impossible. Our employees are not only part of history, they're making history.

Northrop Grumman Defense Systems is seeking Software Engineers to join the Global C2 Solutions Business Unit in Huntsville, Alabama. You will help design and implement containerization and virtualization strategies to migrate a mission‑critical command and control (C2) software.

In this role, you will support the Integrated Battle Command System (IBCS) program on Agile Software Teams, working closely with software, systems, hardware and IT engineers to build robust, secure, and scalable software solutions that address complex logical and mathematical challenges in support of Global C2 missions.

### **About the Opportunity**

Join an innovative leader in outdoor recreation products and help shape the next generation of fishing technology. As Lead Electrical Engineer, you’ll drive electrical and electronic product development from concept through production, lead engineering initiatives, and enhance the performance and reliability of existing products.

This is an opportunity to combine hands-on engineering expertise with technical leadership while developing innovative products used by outdoor enthusiasts worldwide.

### **Key Responsibilities**

* **Lead Product Development:** Oversee electrical and electronic design from concept through production, including prototyping, testing, validation, and product launch.
* **Provide Technical Leadership:** Guide engineering teams, establish priorities, manage project timelines, and drive successful execution.
* **Drive Innovation:** Develop new product designs and improve existing products for performance, reliability, manufacturability, and cost.
* **Ensure Engineering Quality:** Evaluate designs, troubleshoot complex technical issues, and verify compliance with product specifications and quality standards.
* **Manage Project Execution:** Develop technical documentation, cost estimates, test plans, and project schedules while managing resources and milestones.
* **Collaborate Across Teams:** Partner with manufacturing, operations, suppliers, and internal stakeholders to streamline product development and production readiness.
* **Optimize Design and Manufacturing:** Recommend design approaches, fabrication methods, and supplier solutions that improve product quality and production efficiency.

### **Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, or a related field.
* 7+ years of electrical design engineering experience, preferably in consumer product development.
* Advanced knowledge of electronic circuits, components, schematics, design, and testing.
* Proven ability to lead engineering teams and manage complex projects from concept through production.
* Experience translating product concepts into manufacturable designs.
* Proficiency with electrical design, simulation, and analysis tools.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.
* Excellent communication and cross-functional collaboration abilities.
* Self-directed, innovative, and comfortable taking ownership of projects with minimal supervision.

### **Why Join?**

* Competitive salary and cash profit-sharing opportunities.
* Comprehensive benefits, generous paid time off, and holidays.
* 401(k) with company match and additional retirement benefits.
* Professional development, training, and tuition assistance.
* Casual, collaborative work environment and company events.
* Employee discounts on outdoor recreation products.
* Employee wellness programs and family-focused benefits.

**Ready to lead engineering innovation and develop the next generation of outdoor products? Take the next step in your career and make an impact.**

**Full Relocation Provided**

jobs.title: Electrical Engineer II
jobs.description:
**Electrical Engineer II**

*This position must meet Export Control compliance requirements, therefore a “US Person” as defined by 22 C.F.R. § 120.15 is required. “US Person” includes US Citizen, lawful permanent resident, refugee, or asylee. In compliance with federal law, all persons hired will be required to verify identity and eligibility to work in the United States and to complete the required employment eligibility verification form upon hire.*

  

Canyon AeroConnect stands as one of the world’s leading suppliers of avionic-standard aircraft communications, navigation and audio/intercom systems. Canyon’s products have been widely adopted and proven in-service across a wide range of civilian, paramilitary and military fixed-wing and rotorcraft applications. Over the years, we’ve become known as the benchmark in aircraft tactical communication and audio equipment for Air Ambulance, Law Enforcement, SAR, EMS, Electronic News Gathering, Military and Marine applications. Products include digital and analog radio/audio management systems, Tac/Com, VHF/UHF radio systems, intercoms, data interface accessories, and aural warning.

  
  

**Role purpose (position scope):**

The Electrical Engineer supports the design, development, integration, verification, qualification, production, and sustaining engineering of airborne communication and control electronics within the Radio Business Unit. The position works cross-functionally with RF, software, systems, mechanical, manufacturing, test, quality, and supply chain teams to deliver reliable, configuration-controlled products and technically sound evidence for customer and regulatory requirements.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

* Design and maintain electronic assemblies, schematic designs, circuit interfaces, wiring/interconnects, and supporting engineering drawings for airborne radio and control products.
* Perform circuit-level analysis, component selection, derating, power-budget assessment, signal integrity evaluation, and troubleshooting of analog/digital and power-distribution functions.
* Develop or support engineering requirements, design documentation, interface definitions, test procedures, and requirements-to-verification traceability.
* Plan and execute bench verification and design characterization using oscilloscopes, DMMs, electronic loads, power supplies, spectrum analyzers, network analyzers, and automated test systems as appropriate.
* Investigate anomalies and field/production failures through structured root-cause analysis, controlled experiments, data evaluation, and documented corrective actions.
* Support environmental and EMC qualification activities, including preparation, testing, discrepancy resolution, and objective-evidence packages to applicable program requirements (e.g., DO-160 and other contractual standards).
* Partner with Manufacturing and Test Engineering to improve production testability, work instructions, acceptance criteria, first-pass yield, reliability, and transition of designs into repeatable manufacture.
* Participate in engineering change control, configuration management, supplier technical reviews, obsolescence mitigation, and sustaining-engineering activities.
* Coordinate technical deliverables with internal teams, suppliers, and customers; communicate risks, dependencies, verification status, and recovery actions clearly.

  

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, or a related engineering discipline; equivalent relevant experience may be considered under company policy.
* Practical experience with electronic hardware design, integration, debugging, and laboratory verification.
* Ability to interpret schematics, assembly drawings, specifications, test data, and component datasheets.
* Working understanding of analog and digital circuits, interfaces, basic RF concepts, power electronics, and PCB manufacturing constraints.
* Strong technical writing, problem-solving, prioritization, and collaboration skills.

  

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with airborne radios, avionics, embedded systems, or safety/mission-critical electronics.
* Familiarity with DO-160, MIL-STD-461, AS9100, IPC workmanship standards, or similar qualification and manufacturing frameworks.
* Experience with Altium, OrCAD, Cadence, or comparable ECAD tools; Jira/SVN or other engineering configuration tools.
* Experience with automated test equipment, Python/LabVIEW or other instrumentation automation, and structured statistical analysis.
* Knowledge of failure analysis, DFMEA/PFMEA, design-for-test, design-for-manufacture, and supplier technical investigations.

  

**Measures of Success**

* Timely completion of assigned design and verification deliverables with traceable evidence.
* Effective closure of technical investigations and reduction in repeat production or field failures.
* Improved test coverage, production yield, and engineering-change execution with controlled documentation.
* Clear communication and proactive resolution of technical risks and cross-functional dependencies.

  

**Role Expectations and Working Conditions**

Collaborates across engineering, manufacturing, test, quality, supply chain, program management, and external technical stakeholders. Work is primarily office/laboratory based with occasional factory-floor activity and potential program-related travel. Must follow site safety, ESD, quality, document-control, and information-security procedures.

jobs.title: Systems Engineer - Level 4
jobs.description:
RELOCATION ASSISTANCE: Relocation assistance may be availableCLEARANCE REQUIRED FOR START: YesCLEARANCE TYPE: Top SecretTRAVEL: Yes, 10% of the Time

**Description**
---------------

At Northrop Grumman, our employees have incredible opportunities to work on revolutionary systems that impact people's lives around the world today, and for generations to come. Our pioneering and inventive spirit has enabled us to be at the forefront of many technological advancements in our nation's history - from the first flight across the Atlantic Ocean, to stealth bombers, to landing on the moon. We look for people who have bold new ideas, courage and a pioneering spirit to join forces to invent the future, and have fun along the way. Our culture thrives on intellectual curiosity, cognitive diversity and bringing your whole self to work — and we have an insatiable drive to do what others think is impossible. Our employees are not only part of history, they're making history.

Northrop Grumman’s Space Systems Sector is seeking a **Systems Engineer – Level 4** to join our team in **Gilbert, Arizona or Dulles, VA.**

This **Systems Engineer -Level 4** position is for an individual contributor within a multi-disciplinary engineering team. The specific responsibilities of this position will be to manage the technical and functional interfaces of one or more hosted payload(s) to a spacecraft bus. Work products include the development of payload port-specific interface control documents (ICDs), managing giver-receiver materials, review and approval of bus accommodation documents, development of functional and performance test scripts, and identification of mechanical, electrical, and environmental constraints and requirements. Analysis roles include supporting science, experiment, and mission planning for the payload and evaluating mission performance and orbital operations.

**Job Responsibilities:**

* Perform technical planning and analyses at all levels of total system product to include concept, design, fabrication, test, installation, operations, maintenance, and disposal
* Develop system and subsystem architectures(s), system physical views including system elements (blocks) and critical interfaces (internal and external)
* Generate both original and revised specification/interface definition documents
* Produce requirements and manage changes using established Northrop Grumman guidelines and database tools
* Leads and prepares trade studies, system sensitivity studies, design optimization studies, system performance assessments, CONOPS development, and mission analysis/planning
* Support proposal writing, project planning and cost estimation efforts
* Play a key role in major program milestone and readiness reviews
* Help support critical test campaigns designed to exercise spacecraft & payload functionality, measure performance, and verify survivability in the extreme launch and space environments
* Provide on-floor support of integration, testing, and operational readiness of spacecraft and payloads. This includes working with the I&T team to ensure the safe, effective, and efficient testing of the spacecraft, reviewing test data logs, and supporting Non-Conformance Reports (NCRs) troubleshooting and regression testing, Failure Review Boards (FRBs), and test script changes.
* Incorporate lessons learned to continue to strengthen the product line
* Lead by example and be willing to mentor, coach, train, guide, direct and advise teammates

**Basic Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s Degree in a STEM (Science, Technology, Engineering or Mathematics) discipline and 8 years of engineering experience or Masters degree in a STEM discipline and 6 years of engineering experience or PhD in a STEM discipline and 4 years of engineering experience.
* Self-starter with strong technical problem-solving skills, an aptitude for understanding system and subsystem interactions and initiative to drive product development to closure

* Experience in systems engineering to include architectural studies, technical baseline definition, requirements & interface management, hardware/software integration, and test planning & execution
* Experience in space systems, spacecraft design, or mission operations
* **Must have active U.S. Government Top Secret Security Clearance and ability to obtain TS/SCI Clearance.**

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience working on spacecraft or aircraft systems or payloads
* Experience in system architecture, CONOPs development, or model-based system engineering
* Experience with various technical tools such as MATLAB, STK, CORE, DOORS, or CAMEO
* Experience in any of the following areas is also desired: orbital mechanics, orbital debris modeling, spacecraft attitude control, power systems and modeling, avionics or digital electronics design, risk analysis, optics, communications, rocket propulsion, thermal engineering, or spacecraft integration and testing
* Experience with Mission Operations for spacecraft
* Knowledge of Launch Vehicles, System Safety, System Reliability, Contamination Control, EMI, Space Environments (Radiation, Surface Charging, etc.), and Human Factors
* Active U.S. Government TS/SCI Clearance

Curious about all the exciting developments with the Northrop Grumman Space Sector? Click the link below:

https://www.northropgrumman.com/space.

Senior Software Engineer - Digital Platform and AWS (260807)

**Our Commitment to You**  
  
At Consumer Cellular, recruiting is human. Every application is reviewed by a real member of our Talent Acquisition team because we believe the people behind the résumé matter just as much as what's on it.  
  
All official communication from Consumer Cellular will come from a @consumercellular.com email address or through our verified texting platform, which will only be used to schedule interviews. We will never ask for personal and financial information during the recruiting process. If you receive outreach that doesn't match these criteria, please do not engage and feel free to verify directly at talentacquisition@consumercellular.com.

**Job Summary**  
Consumer Cellular is building a new cloud-native platform on Amazon Web Services, and we are hiring Senior Software Engineers to build the services that run on it.

This is a hands-on product engineering role. You will design and ship the APIs and event-driven services behind our customer-facing digital experiences- account management, activation, billing, and self-service - using a serverless-first architecture on AWS. You will work in Python and TypeScript, make substantive data modeling decisions across several purpose-built data stores, and own your services in production.

Two things make this a compelling time to join. The platform is new, so the patterns are not all set yet and your design decisions will outlive your first year. And we are migrating a large group of experienced colleagues onto it, so Senior Engineers here have real influence on how the whole organization builds- not only on their own backlog.

We serve millions of customers who depend on us for something that matters staying connected to the people they care about. Our customer base skews older than the industry average, which makes clarity, reliability, and accessibility engineering requirements rather than afterthoughts. If you like the idea of your work being judged by whether it works for people who are not power users, you will fit in well here.

**You will need to reside within 50 miles of our Corporate Headquarters in Scottsdale, AZ as this role has the option of hybrid or onsite.**

**Responsibilities**

* **Design and build production services.** Develop serverless APIs and event-driven workflows using AWS Lambda, Amazon API Gateway, and Amazon EventBridge, written in Python and Node/TypeScript.
* **Make and data modeling decisions.** We use several data stores deliberately: Amazon DynamoDB, Aurora DSQL, Amazon DocumentDB, and Amazon S3. You will select between them based on access patterns, and you will be expected to explain why.
* **Own what you ship.** Instrument your services, build the dashboards and alarms, author the runbooks, and participate in an on-call rotation for the services your team owns.
* **Build for failure.** Asynchronous systems fail in ways request/response systems do not. You will design for retries, idempotency, duplicate delivery, and partial failure as a matter of course.
* **Work in a modern delivery pipeline.** GitHub and GitHub Actions, OIDC-federated deployments, infrastructure as code, Ansible for configuration management, and service-to-service connectivity via Amazon VPC Lattice.
* **Raise the bar through review.** Provide thorough, constructive, and useful code and design review. A meaningful share of your impact in this role shows up in other people’s work.
* **Support colleague migration.** Pair with engineers moving onto the platform from our existing stack, and help turn what you learn into documentation and reusable patterns. We have built a structured enablement program, and Senior Engineers are central to it.
* **Contribute to platform standards.** Logging conventions, error handling, IAM patterns, repository structure, and data store selection guidance.

**Qualifications (Education, Experience, Skills)**

**Required**
------------

* Five or more years building and operating backend services in production. We care about depth of ownership rather than the number itself; if you have shipped and supported real systems that people depended on, tell us about it.
* **Strong proficiency in Python or TypeScript/Node**, and willingness to work in both. Most of our engineers arrive strong in one.
* **Hands-on AWS experience**, including a working understanding of IAM, networking fundamentals, and at least one managed AWS data service.
* Experience designing REST APIs and integrating distributed systems.

* Demonstrated debugging skill in distributed systems — you can work a problem from logs, metrics, and traces rather than by guessing.

**APPLICATIONS · FULL-TIME · ON-SITE — SANTA CLARA, CA**

**About SiFly Aviation**
------------------------

At SiFly, we’re building a new category of aircraft: vertical-takeoff, long-endurance drones that deliver helicopter-level performance at drone economics. After thousands of flight tests and years of engineering, our NDAA-compliant platform flies more than 2 hours in hover or 3 hours in forward flight on a single charge — matching the capability of traditional helicopters at a fraction of their cost and operational burden. We merge aerial robotics, perception, and onboard intelligence to cut complexity and minimize human intervention, and our unique approach to communications and networking unlocks remote operations from day one. It’s an ambitious mission, and we’re a small team that moves fast.

We are looking for a highly capable engineer who can contribute across embedded development, real-time processing, and system integration. * **Own the camera behaviour.** Work with image sensors and their parameters — exposure, shutter speed, ISO, and focal characteristics — and apply calibration methods to achieve consistent, repeatable results across units and conditions.
* **Build the video and data paths.** Create efficient pathways for video, telemetry, and sensor data, with an emphasis on low latency, stability, and clarity of output.
* **Integrate complete systems.** Connect and coordinate sensors, actuators, and communication interfaces into complete, working systems rather than isolated components.

* **Make results legible.** Develop clear ways to present complex measurements and results for debugging, calibration, and system evaluation — so the team can reason about the data, not just look at it.

jobs.title: Embedded Linux Engineer
jobs.description:
**Embedded Linux Engineer — Networking & Connectivity**
=======================================================

**EMBEDDED PLATFORM · FULL TIME · ON-SITE — SANTA CLARA, CALIFORNIA**

**About SiFly Aviation**
------------------------

At SiFly, we're building a new category of aircraft: vertical-takeoff, long-endurance drones that deliver helicopter-level performance at drone economics. After thousands of flight tests and years of engineering, our NDAA-compliant platform flies more than 2 hours in hover or 3 hours in forward flight on a single charge — matching the capability of traditional helicopters at a fraction of their cost and operational burden. We merge aerial robotics, perception, and onboard intelligence to cut complexity and minimize human intervention, and our unique approach to communications and networking unlocks remote operations from day one. It's an ambitious mission, and we're a small team that moves fast.

We are looking for a senior Embedded Linux Engineer to own connectivity on the aircraft: how a Q12 stays reachable over 5G, Wi-Fi 6, and Wi-Fi HaLow simultaneously, how traffic is routed and prioritized across those links as they degrade, and how video, telemetry, and command-and-control survive a handover mid-flight. Remote beyond-visual-line-of-sight operation is the product, and the network is what makes it possible. The picture is also wider than the aircraft alone: the same links and routing decisions span the DroneFi ground station and the pilot application, and you will own how they behave as one system.

This is a role with real ownership rather than a specification to implement. You will own our Dynamic Routing Engine — the service that decides, in flight, which link carries what — along with the link-management daemons, the secure overlay back to our cloud, and the test rigs that prove any of it works. The engine is led part-time today; ownership of it transfers to you as you onboard — and with it, the role of primary technical guide for DroneFi development, supported by the senior architect who owns our low-level networking foundations. We are hiring two Embedded Linux Engineers with deliberately different centres of gravity: you own connectivity and routing, while a counterpart works broadly across the platform — platform services, integration, and new platform capabilities — alongside the senior engineers who already cover BSP, boot, and the update pipeline. You will work closely together.

**The Role**
------------

You will own the networking stack on the aircraft and the software that manages it: multi-link connectivity across cellular, Wi-Fi 6, and Wi-Fi HaLow, the Dynamic Routing Engine that selects and blends those links, traffic policy and QoS that keeps command-and-control alive when video wants all the bandwidth, the Tailscale mesh and TLS-secured paths back to our AWS backend, and the behaviour of MQTT, WebRTC video, and the MAVLink router under real loss and latency. Day to day that means writing services in C, C++, and Python on a Yocto-based platform, living in packet captures, and building the emulation and field-test setups that turn “it felt better” into a number. You own the connectivity picture in its totality: not just the Linux side, but partnering with the applications team so the software riding on these links is as resilient to degradation and handover as the network beneath it.

You will collaborate closely with the rest of the embedded platform team — your generalist counterpart and the engineers who cover BSP, boot, updates, and the low-level networking foundations — the firmware engineers who own the radios and supervisory MCUs, the part-time engineer who leads the Dynamic Routing Engine today and will hand it over to you, the applications and autonomy teams whose traffic you carry and whose resilience you help design, the cloud team on the other end of every link, and our hardware and RF engineers in Santa Clara — including on antenna placement and integration on the airframe.

**What You’ll Do**
------------------

* **Own the Dynamic Routing Engine.** Design, implement, and harden the service that chooses and blends links in flight — link metrics and scoring, switching policy and hysteresis, failover timing, and behaviour at the edge of coverage — and close out the open risks against it.
* **Make multi-link connectivity dependable.** Own the cellular, Wi-Fi 6, and Wi-Fi HaLow links end-to-end on the Linux side: modem management, association and roaming, bonding and make-before-break handover, and graceful degradation rather than a cliff edge.
* **Own routing and traffic policy.** Policy routing across multiple tables and interfaces, nftables, tc-based QoS and shaping, VLANs, bridges, and network namespaces — so command-and-control, video, and bulk transfer each get what they need on a link that is shrinking.
* **Keep video and telemetry alive under degradation.** Tune WebRTC (WHIP/WHEP) and RTP video, adaptive bitrate and congestion control, MQTT keepalive and reconnect behaviour, and MAVLink routing on lossy, high-latency links — and make reconnection invisible to the operator.
* **Make the applications resilient with you.** Own the contract between the network and everything riding on it: expose link state, quality, and bandwidth signals that applications can act on, and work with the applications team so onboard and ground-side software handles degradation, handover, and offline periods by design rather than by surprise.
* **Own the secure overlay.** The Tailscale/WireGuard mesh, TLS, per-aircraft identity and certificate provisioning, NAT traversal, and an addressing plan that still works when the fleet is an order of magnitude larger.
* **Instrument the network.** Per-link metrics for signal quality, latency, loss, jitter, and throughput; structured connectivity logging that makes a post-flight “why did the link drop” answerable from data rather than guesswork.

**About Amaratek**

Amaratek is a contract inventor and innovator serving a broad range of industries and applications through interdisciplinary expertise in chemistry, life sciences, and engineering. We develop practical, real-world solutions to complex challenges in defense, health, and global development.

Recognizing that technologies developed for military applications can often address critical civilian needs, Amaratek also provides technical services to foreign governments, nongovernmental organizations (NGOs), and social entrepreneurs. Our work extends across areas such as healthcare, water, energy, and transportation, where reliability and performance are essential.

While our primary focus remains defense and homeland security technologies, we continually explore opportunities to apply our innovations to commercial and other markets.

**Position Overview**

Amaratek is seeking an Electrical Engineer with a Bachelor of Science (BS) or Master of Science (MS) degree in Electrical Engineering to contribute to the design, development, and testing of innovative technologies. The ideal candidate will have a strong foundation in electrical engineering principles, hands-on experience with electronic hardware and embedded systems, and the ability to troubleshoot complex technical challenges.

jobs.title: Embedded Flight Software Engineer
jobs.description:
**Company Description**

Proteus Space is a Los Angeles-based spacecraft technology company established to capitalize on a rapidly evolving space landscape and the urgent need to deliver resilient orbital capabilities to maintain and increase our national science and security interests. We combine serious space flight experience with an open minded, first-principles approach, leveraging advanced computational design and Industry 4.0 practices to deliver custom spacecraft and mission solutions with industry leading speed, precision, and reliability. We seek to enable every payload and mission with a fully custom, purpose-built spacecraft bus, designed and delivered using Proteus™, our patent-pending, automated computational design platform, with industry leading reliability.

**Role Description**

We are seeking an Embedded Flight Software Engineer with deep expertise in low-level embedded software, FPGA interfaces, drivers, and bootloader development to join our flight program team. This is a full-time, in-office role for an experienced professional with a proven track record of hands-on FSW development. In this role, you will design and implement low-level drivers, BSPs, and boot systems while managing memory architectures and FPGA hardware interfaces. You will bridge the gap between low-level hardware and high-level FSW logic, ensuring reliable spacecraft boot behavior, fail-safe recovery, and deterministic bus communications in space environments.

**Key Responsibilities**.

* Develop low-level C/C++ drivers, Board Support Packages (BSPs), and hardware interfaces for microcontrollers, FPGAs, and standard communication buses.
* Design and implement stage-1 and stage-2 bootloaders, robust boot behaviors, partition swapping logic, and fail-safe recovery modes.
* Architect memory management strategies across volatile and non-volatile memory (NOR/NAND Flash, SRAM, EEPROM) to preserve data integrity across reboots.
* Configure low-level communication protocols and bus interfaces (e.g., SPI, I2C, CAN, UART, SpaceWire, or PCIe) between compute units, peripherals, and payloads.
* Implement telemetry collection, time synchronization, and task scheduling within RTOS or embedded OS environments.
* Execute hardware-in-the-loop (HIL) testing and debugging on flatsats using logic analyzers, oscilloscopes, and FPGA emulator tools.
* Manage the codebase using modern version control systems and contribute to CI/CD workflows for automated testing and continuous integration.
* Execute comprehensive test campaigns on testbeds and flight units to verify software performance under flight-like conditions.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to integrate subsystems with the spacecraft main compute element.
* Ensure compliance with industry standards and regulatory requirements.
* Document design processes, test results, and system performance.
* Provide technical guidance on FSW architectures to fellow engineers, fostering a culture of excellence and innovation.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor's or advanced degree in computer science, aerospace engineering, or similar field.
* 5+ years of embedded software engineering experience, with exposure to low-level driver development, hardware integration, or bootloaders.
* Strong proficiency in C, C++, embedded Linux, and Real-Time Operating Systems (RTOS).
* Familiarity with version control systems (e.g., Git) and automated testing/CI workflows.
* Strong ability to collaborate effectively in a dynamic environment while maintaining a positive and professional attitude.
* Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
* Must possess or be willing and eligible to obtain a United States Department of Defense Top Secret security clearance.

**Desired Qualifications:**

* Experience writing custom drivers for FPGA logic blocks or hardware interfaces (such as I2C, CAN, SPI, UART, or SpaceWire).
* Experience with hardware-level communication protocols and hardware/software integration.
* Experience working in clean room environments and adhering to ESD protocols.
* Demonstrated experience with custom bootloader design, memory controller drivers, Flash file systems, and image verification/recovery techniques.

**Salary Range:** $130,000 - $180,000 per year. Final compensation is based on experience, education and qualifications.

**Benefits**

Proteus Space offers comprehensive benefits including paid medical healthcare for employees, flexible vacation policy, sick days, 401k matching option, pregnancy leave, family leave, holiday pay, military service leave, dental care, vision care and other benefits.

**Equal Opportunity**

Proteus is committed to providing equal employment opportunities regardless of an applicant's age, disability, sex, race, religion, gender, national origin, veteran status or any other legally protected characteristic. The Company will provide reasonable accommodations to an applicant with a disability or religious belief in or to enable the applicant to apply for the position.

This is a senior individual contributor role with influence across multiple engineering teams. jobs.title: Electrical Engineer II Medical Device
jobs.description:
**Electrical Engineer II: Job Posting**

RESOLVEM Inc. | Irvine, CA / Carlsbad, CA (On-site) | Full-time | Mid-level

**Apply here directly: https://resolvem.com/careers*****(****Do not apply via indeed****)***

**About the job**

At RESOLVEM Inc., you'll work across multiple medical device clients and product types, which means you'll accumulate range that engineers at a single-product company simply don't get. You'll take designs into actual field operation of medical line test equipment and medical products, drive root cause investigations when things fail, and grow into the engineer customers ask for by name.

**Why RESOLVEM?**

We're an engineering services firm specializing in R&D design support of new products and transferring product designs to design control and manufacturing. We help medical device companies bring their designs under design control, prepare them for mass manufacturing, and support their pilot manufacturing and transition to commercial-scale production. Because we work across multiple clients and products, you won't spend years on one subsystem. You'll build breadth and depth, fast, and you'll be trusted with real ownership from day one.

**What you'll do**

We'll be straight with you: this is regulated-industry work, and a real share of it is documentation. In medical devices paperwork is part of the product. An undocumented change is an unapproved change that could harm a patient. If that sounds like a chore rather than a craft, this isn't the right role. If you want to be an engineer whose design record holds up under an audit, read on.

Also, a board that works on the bench is not good enough. Our products are electromechanical systems, and you'll own how your design behaves inside the enclosure, on the harness, and inside the rest of the system. You will need to understand mechanical concepts, bills of materials, and how the electrical fits into a wider system.

* **Keep the design record airtight.** You'll author and process Engineering Change Orders (ECOs) on behalf of customers, redline drawings and specifications, compare design revisions, maintain BOMs, purchasing specifications, and obsolescence plans, route changes through approval, and keep the Design History File current and traceable.
* **Own electrical designs.** Lead schematic capture and PCB layout for analog, digital, power, and mixed-signal circuits, including sensor interfaces and microcontroller-based subsystems. Drive component selection, stack-up and layout strategy, signal integrity and power integrity considerations, and design-for-manufacturability/testability (DFM/DFT). Validate with LTspice/PSpice simulation before committing to hardware.
* **Take it from bring-up to production.** Own board bring-up, debug, and characterization. Build custom benchtop test equipment and fixtures, and automate test and data acquisition with Python, MATLAB, or LabVIEW. Support design transfer, pilot builds, and the handoff to contract manufacturers.
* **Lead investigations.** Drive electrical failure analysis and root cause analysis on complex issues. Author investigation reports, propose and verify corrective actions, and present findings to internal teams and customers.
* **Work fluently in the regulated world.** Execute within a certified quality management system (ISO 13485, FDA 21 CFR 820) and design control processes. Own Design History File (DHF) deliverables and requirements traceability for your subsystems. Apply ISO 14971 risk management (DFMEA, hazard analysis), support IEC 62304 software lifecycle activities, and lead EMI/EMC design and pre-compliance testing toward IEC 60601-1-2 and IEC 60601-1 certification.
* **Own verification and validation.** Define V&V strategy for your subsystems; author and execute protocols and reports; support test method validation (TMV), process development, inspection criteria, statistical data analysis, and equipment qualification (IQ/OQ/PQ).
* **Support firmware and system integration.** Develop or guide firmware for microcontroller-based designs using C/C++ and protocols such as I2C, SPI, and UART, and integrate electrical subsystems with mechanical, software, and systems engineering.
* **Raise the team.** Mentor interns and Electrical Engineer I staff, review their work, and serve as a technical point of contact for customers and contract manufacturers on assigned projects.

**Apply here directly: https://resolvem.com/careers**

**Do not apply via LinkedIn EZApply**

**You bring**

* Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering from an accredited university
* Minimum of 3-5 years of hands-on experience in schematic capture and PCB design, with demonstrated ownership of boards from concept through fabrication and bring-up
* Working understanding of mechanical and electromechanical systems: enclosures, connectors and cable harnesses, sensors, and thermal and vibration considerations, including the ability to read a mechanical drawing, reason about how a board fits and performs inside a real assembly, and work through fit, tolerance, grounding, and serviceability questions with mechanical engineers
* Proficiency with PCB design software (Altium Designer preferred; OrCAD, PADS, or KiCad acceptable) and circuit simulation tools (LTspice, PSpice, or equivalent)
* Strong benchtop skills: oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, spectrum analyzers, power meters, DMMs, and programmable supplies/loads
* Solid grounding in analog and digital circuit design and troubleshooting, including power supplies, signal conditioning, and noise mitigation
* Demonstrated experience leading electrical failure analysis and root cause investigations, including written reports
* Proficiency in at least one of MATLAB, Python, or C/C++
* Strong written and verbal technical communication; comfortable presenting in design reviews and to customers
* Ability to work independently on moderately complex projects and to collaborate across disciplines

**Apply here directly: https://resolvem.com/careers*

**Education and Experience**

jobs.description:
**Job Details**
===============

New ideas are all around us, but only a few will change the world. That’s our focus at JPL. We ask the biggest questions, then search the universe for answers—literally. We build upon ideas that have guided generations, then share our discoveries to inspire generations to come. Your mission—your opportunity—is to seek out the answers that bring us one step closer. If you’re driven to discover, create, and inspire something that lasts a lifetime and beyond, you’re ready for JPL.

Located in Pasadena, California, JPL has a campus-like environment situated on 177 acres in the foothills of the San Gabriel Mountains and offers a work environment unlike any other: we inspire passion, foster innovation, build collaboration, and reward excellence.

This opportunity is part of the **Mechanical and Control Systems Division (3500)**, which engages in research, technology development, and the creation of advanced mechanical, robotics, guidance & control, thermal, propulsion, and electronic packaging systems. We develop hardware and systems from early architecture through design, fabrication, subsystem and system-level integration and test.

As a Level II Propulsion Systems Engineer, you will be working for the **Thermal, Propulsion, and Materials Engineering Section (353)**, which provides leadership and unique world-class expertise in a wide range of technologies and technical discipline areas, including chemical and electric propulsion, thermal, materials, contamination control, analytical chemistry, and multiphase flow. This section is responsible for design, analysis, fabrication, testing, integration, and operations of thermal and propulsion flight systems for JPL missions. This section is also responsible for providing materials and process engineering, contamination control engineering, materials testing, and analytical chemistry support to technology and flight programs. You will be a member of the **Chemical Propulsion Systems Group (353C)** and will report to the Group Supervisor.

We are seeking an adaptable, high-energy professional who thrives in a dynamic, fast-paced setting and is comfortable navigating ambiguity. The ideal candidate possesses a risk-tolerant mindset, viewing challenges as opportunities to innovate, and excels in an evolving environment where decisiveness and agility are key to our collective success.

* Perform various spacecraft chemical propulsion subsystem static and transient analyses, such as flow-pressure drop, system sizing, blowdown, and waterhammer.

* Develop and execute ground tests to validate and anchor analysis models, including analyzing and reducing the test data.

* Experience with performing and generating tools/code for spacecraft propulsion related subsystem analyses, such as flow-pressure drop and test data reduction.
* Ability to perform first-order (hand calculation) and excel-level calculations.
* Capable of reporting and presenting complex analytical results clearly to multi-disciplinary teams.
* Familiarity with developing, supporting and conducting propulsion subsystem ground testing.
* Demonstrated creating and understanding fluid schematics and mechanical drawings.
* Ability to work as a member of a team and independently with limited supervision, when given only general instructions.

* Proficiency with programming languages (preferably MATLAB).

* Practical experience with commercial computer-aided design software (preferably Siemens NX and TeamCenter) and used in a Product Delivery Management (PDM).
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications.

* Uses discretion and independent judgment in evaluating problem solving approaches and solutions.
* Excellent verbal and written technical communication skills with the ability to work collaboratively in a team environment.

jobs.title: Software Engineer - Manipulation
jobs.description:
Apptronik is a human-centered robotics company developing AI-powered robots to support humanity in every facet of life. Our flagship humanoid robot, Apollo, is built to collaborate thoughtfully with people, starting with critical industries such as manufacturing and logistics, with future applications in healthcare, the home, and beyond.  
  
We operate at the cutting edge of Applied AI, applying our expertise across the full robotics stack to solve some of society's most important problems. You will join a team dedicated to bringing Apollo to market at scale, tackling the complex challenges like safety, commercialization, and mass production to change the world for the better.

**JOB SUMMARY**

The Software Engineer - Manipulation is a core contributor to our robot's ability to interact with the world reliably and precisely. This role is responsible for developing and deploying learning-based manipulation policies, with a focus on post-training methods that adapt and improve those policies on real tasks and physical hardware.

This role will bridge the gap between cutting-edge research and scalable, reliable production software. Working closely with the simulation, data, hardware, and systems teams, this engineer will take manipulation policies from demonstration data through post-training to robust deployment across our fleet.

  

**ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES or KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES**

* Implement and deploy state-of-the-art learning-based manipulation policies to achieve reliable, world-class performance on real-world tasks with physical hardware.
* Adapt and improve policies for new tasks and hardware using post-training methods such as RL fine-tuning, policy distillation, and interactive imitation learning (e.g., DAgger).
* Build and maintain the data pipelines that support post-training, including teleoperation and demonstration collection, retargeting, dataset aggregation, and curation.
* Drive the development cycle from simulation and offline evaluation to robustly transferring and fine-tuning policies on the robot.
* Develop visuomotor policies for grasping, in-hand manipulation, and whole-arm manipulation, with reliable, low-latency execution on hardware.
* Define evaluation metrics and regression tests for policy performance in simulation and on hardware, and use the results to guide technical decisions.
* Collaborate closely with the simulation, data, hardware, and systems teams to diagnose system-level issues and co-develop solutions.
* Maintain high standards for the codebase through testing, documentation, and peer code reviews.
  

**SKILLS AND REQUIREMENTS**

**Technical Skills (Must-Have)**

* **Manipulation:** Strong experience in robotic manipulation, including grasping, in-hand or whole-arm control, and high-DOF motion, with a track record of hardware deployment.
* **Learning-Based Control:** Hands-on experience training and debugging learned policies, including post-training methods such as RL fine-tuning, distillation, and imitation learning (e.g., DAgger).
* **Software Engineering:** Proficiency in Python, C++, and PyTorch or JAX, with experience building real-time robotic software stacks.
* **Data & Evaluation:** Experience working with demonstration and teleoperation data, and building evaluation pipelines for learned policies.

**Good to Have**

* **Simulation Environments:** Experience with physics engines such as IsaacSim, MuJoCo, or Drake for policy training and validation.
* **Generalist Policies:** Experience adapting large, general-purpose manipulation policies to specific tasks and embodiments.
* **Teleoperation:** Experience with VR/haptic interfaces and retargeting algorithms for human-in-the-loop control.
* **Tactile Sensing:** Experience integrating tactile/haptic feedback into manipulation pipelines.
* **Computer Vision:** Familiarity with 6D pose estimation, point cloud processing, or visual-servoing.

  

**EDUCATION and/or EXPERIENCE**

* An MS with 3+ years of relevant experience, or a recent PhD, in Robotics, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related field.
* Relevant experience specifically focused on learning-based manipulation or a closely related area.
* A proven track record of taking learned policies from a research/simulation environment and successfully deploying them on physical hardware.

  

**PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS**

* Prolonged periods of sitting at a desk and working on a computer
* Must be able to lift 15 pounds at times
* Vision to read printed materials and a computer screen
* Hearing and speech to communicate

The annual salary range is $180,000 - $240,000

* This is a direct hire. Please, no outside Agency solicitations.

jobs.title: Electrical Engineer I
jobs.description:
**ABOUT ROCKET LAB**

Rocket Lab is the end-to-end space company building rockets, spacecraft, and critical subsystems that keep the world connected, protected, expand humanity's reach to the Moon, Mars, and beyond. We move fast, build real hardware for meaningful missions, and make the impossible routine. Come shape the future with us.

**SPACE SYSTEMS**

At Rocket Lab, we're not just launching rockets — we're building the future of space. Our Space Systems team builds everything from complete spacecraft, precision payloads to the components and subsystems that allow them to thrive in space, like solar panels, flight software, star trackers, optical systems, separation systems, radios, and more.

Our Space Systems team has enabled more than 1,700 missions, ranging from interplanetary exploration, in-space manufacturing to national security and defense initiatives. The team has built spacecraft, payloads, and components for missions to the Moon and Mars, working with partners including NASA, the Space Development Agency, and the U.S. Space Force. Whether it's a single high-performance spacecraft, constellation, or the vertically integrated components that help them get to space — our world class Space Systems team is empowering some of the boldest and most ambitious space missions.

**ELECTRICAL ENGINEER I**

**At Rocket Lab Robotics, we build robotic systems that push the boundaries of what's possible in space**. From Mars-proven robotic arms to precision motion control systems for the most demanding environments in our solar system, our team delivers advanced electro-mechanical solutions for planetary exploration and various satellite programs. We've engineered hardware that has operated on the surface of Mars on NASA's Perseverance rover, supported lunar exploration through the CADRE rover program, and developed precision mechanisms for spacecraft subsystems including solar array drives, antenna gimbals, and optical payloads. As part of Rocket Lab, we combine the focus of small, dedicated robotics teams with the resources of a leading end-to-end space company, empowering some of the boldest missions in history. We're looking for people who take ownership and drive a problem from first principles all the way through manufacturing and delivery.

**ELECTRICAL ENGINEER I**

Rocket Lab Robotics specializes in high-performance robotic systems and precision mechanisms that enable the most ambitious space missions, including NASA's Mars Perseverance Rover and CADRE lunar rovers. Leveraging Mars-proven expertise from Motiv Space Systems, we deliver scalable, flight-proven solutions – such as robotic arms, motion control systems, and solar array drive assemblies (SADAs) – to support planetary exploration, satellite servicing, and national security missions.

Based at Rocket Lab Robotics in Pasadena, CA, the **Electrical Engineer I** you will participate in the development and test of avionics hardware for our robotics programs. You will work collaboratively with engineers of various disciplines and participate in all aspects of electrical hardware development, from requirements definition through design, prototyping, fabrication, testing, and production. We're looking for people who are passionate about robotics electrical hardware design, with a willingness to learn in a fast-paced environment.

**WHAT YOU'LL GET TO DO:**

* Gain experience in **robotics and motor control applications.**
* Gain experience in FPGA and Micro-Controller applications
* End to end ownership of Electronic Ground Support Equipment
* Schematic capture and PCB layout using Altium Designer
* Circuit analysis, including stress analysis and worst-case analysis
* PCBA design verification testing and system integration testing
* Production manufacturing support as needed

**QUALIFICATIONS YOU'LL BRING AS ELECTRICAL ENGINEER I:**

* Bachelor's degree in electrical or computer engineering; or other engineering discipline
* GPA of 3.0 or above
* A strong background in analog electronics design
* Proficiency performing circuit analyses in SPICE and Excel
* Proficiency with basic electronic lab equipment, such as power supplies, oscilloscopes, DMMs, signal generators, and soldering irons
* Experience with FPGA design in a professional or school environment
* Experience with Microcontroller design in a professional or school environment
* U.S. citizenship required, due to program requirements

**THESE QUALIFICATIONS WOULD BE NICE TO HAVE:**

* Experience designing for space environments, including radiation impacts and mitigation
* Proficiency with board bring-up and debug
* Experience in creation of design verification test plans and test execution
* Experience in designing for high-reliability aerospace applications
* Experience designing rigid-flex PCBs and electromechanical design

*This position may require prolonged periods of sitting, standing, walking, computer work, and occasional exposure to moderate levels of noise, dust, and fumes in production areas.*

**WHAT TO EXPECT**

We're on a mission to unlock the potential of space to improve life on Earth, but that's not an easy task. It takes hard work, determination, relentless innovation, teamwork, grit, and an unwavering commitment to achieving what others often deem impossible. Our people out-think, out-work, and out-pace. We pride ourselves on having each other's backs, checking our egos at the door, and rolling up our sleeves on all tasks big and small. We thrive under pressure, work to tight deadlines, and our focus is always on how we can deliver, rather than dwelling on the challenges that stand in the way.

### **Responsibilities**

* **Ignition HMI Development:** Lead the design, architecture, and deployment of commercial-grade operator interfaces standardized on the Ignition SCADA platform.
* **Site-Agnostic UI Architecture:** Build dynamic, site-agnostic HMI screens and tag structures that seamlessly scale across diverse power plant configurations, skids, and high generator counts.

* **Testing & Validation:** Own the testing lifecycle for new features, including unit testing, integration testing, and hardware-in-the-loop (HIL) validation to ensure site safety logic and grid compliance.

* **Cross-Functional Collaboration:** Work with Product, Controls and Hardware teams to translate utility requirements and interconnection standards into functional software specifications.

The Senior Sustaining Controls Engineer will play a crucial role in the success of our product automatically and reliably fulfilling customers’ electricity demand.
