jobs.title: Electromagnetic Device Engineer
jobs.description:
**What to Expect**

Tesla’s mission is to accelerate the world’s transition to sustainable energy. That mission depends on parts that switch, actuate, and isolate at high voltage, high current, and high cadence.

The Supplier Industrialization Engineer (SIE) for Electromechanical and Electromagnetic Devices is the manufacturing owner for this commodity. You sit between Design, Purchasing, and the supplier. You are the resident process expert, the NPI lead at the factory, and the person who does not accept “the line has always run this way.”

You will industrialize contactors, relays, solenoids, actuators, pyro disconnects, switches, and small electromagnetic machines from first samples through mass production. You will spend real time on supplier floors such as welding cells, winding lines, plating, overmold, and end-of-line test. You will make on-the-spot decisions that protect Tesla’s launch and the customer.

The pace is high. The work is first principles, data, and process control, not slideware.

 **What You'll Do**

* Own industrialization of electromechanical and electromagnetic devices from advanced development through PPAP / production part approval and stable mass production — including high-voltage contactors and relays, solenoids, actuators, pyro disconnects, switches, small motors, and related electromagnetic assemblies
* Plan, organize, and execute supplier process development: stamping and forming of magnetic circuits and contact systems; coil winding and termination; resistance / laser welding; plating; overmolding and potting; hermetic sealing; and final functional test
* Lead Design for Manufacturability (DFM) and Design for Assembly (DFA) with Tesla Design, Reliability, and the supplier. Close air-gap, contact-force, weld, creepage/clearance, and tolerance stack-up issues before tooling kickoff
* Define and freeze the process flow, PFMEA, control plan, and special characteristics (contact resistance, bounce, dielectric withstand, coil resistance, pull-in / drop-out voltage, weld splash, leak rate, insulation resistance)
* Qualify manufacturing lines at the supplier: equipment capability, MSA, SPC on critical dimensions and electrical parameters, poka-yoke, traceability, and end-of-line functional / hipot / leak test coverage
* Drive APQP deliverables and PPAP (or Tesla equivalent) to first-time-right launch. Own capacity models, OEE, yield, and ramp plans that match Tesla’s production cadence. Manage engineering change, second-source, and localization industrialization without interrupting Tesla production
* Audit suppliers against IATF 16949, VDA 6.3, and Tesla process requirements. Identify gaps in process control, change management, and sub-tier (contacts, magnets, coils, plastics, platings) and close them with the supplier
* Lead debug when yield, reliability, or delivery breaks. Run structured problem solving (8D, FTA, DOE, Ishikawa) and implement permanent countermeasure. Travel to supplier sites and Tesla factories and make technical decisions on the floor
* Translate Tesla application conditions (inrush, inductive load, vibration, thermal cycling, salt, HV isolation) into supplier process windows and validation plans (ISO 16750, LV 124 / VW 80000, AEC-Q200, IEC / UL where applicable)
* Partner with Purchasing, Quality, NPI, and Manufacturing to hit cost, quality (PPM), and delivery. Challenge the supplier on cycle time, scrap, automation, and material utilization — first principles, not tradition

  
**What You'll Bring**

* Degree in Electrical, Mechanical, Mechatronics, Manufacturing, or Materials Engineering, or equivalent experience
* 3+ years industrializing, manufacturing, or qualifying electromechanical or electromagnetic devices (contactors, relays, solenoids, actuators, motors, switches, or similar). Automotive, industrial power, or high-reliability electronics preferred
* Hands-on fluency with the processes that actually make these parts: coil winding, contact welding, magnetic circuit stamping, plating, overmold, potting, hermetic seal, and functional test
* Working knowledge of contact physics (arcing, bounce, welding, material transfer), electromagnetic actuation (force vs. air gap, coil heating, residual magnetism), and insulation / creepage at high voltage
* Proven ownership of APQP / PPAP (or equivalent), PFMEA, control plans, MSA, SPC, and process capability (Cpk) on electrical and mechanical special characteristics
* Ability to read drawings, GD&T, and electrical specifications; to challenge a datasheet; and to write a clear process or test requirement
* Structured problem solving (8D, FTA, DOE, 5-Why) and comfort with data (Excel required; JMP, Minitab, or Python a plus)
* Experience auditing manufacturing quality systems (IATF 16949, VDA 6.3, ISO 9001) and driving sub-tier control
* Clear, direct communication with suppliers and internal engineering — written and on the factory floor. You influence without hiding behind process theater
* Preferred: high-voltage contactor / pyro-fuse / traction-inverter or energy-product component experience; Six Sigma / CQE; Mandarin, German, Korean, or Japanese

#### **Benefits**

Along with competitive pay, as a full-time Tesla employee, you are eligible for the following benefits at day 1 of hire:

* Medical plans > plan options with $0 payroll deduction

Opportunities for career advancement, excellent benefits and long-term stability are some of the advantages of our growing, employee-focused company.

**Salary**

The typical annual salary range for this position is $145,000.00 USD to $160,000.00 USD. Salary will be based on current qualifications, directly related experience, geographic location, and possible contractual requirements which could fall outside of this range.

  
Responsibilities:

* **Position Objective & Summary**

* Functional and Engineering SME in countermeasures, electronic warfare, software architecture and sensors
* Serve as a Senior Data Analysis Engineer responsible for processing, reducing, analyzing, and evaluating ground laboratory and open-air flight test data
* Develops automated Python-based data extraction and analysis pipelines to evaluate complex avionics systems, electronic warfare (EW) suites, and sensor packages.Analysis directly supports formal verification of system performance requirements and Key Performance Parameters (KPPs), culminating in executive-level presentations and decision-quality technical reports for program managers, test directors, and acquisition authorities

* **Flight Test & Laboratory Data Reduction and Analysis (40%)**

jobs.title: Data Platform Engineer
jobs.description:
We are a high-growth company transforming how businesses operate by integrating AI, IoT, and cloud-native services into scalable, real-time platforms. As a Platform Data Engineer, you’ll play a critical role in building and maintaining the data infrastructure that powers our products, services, and insights.  
  
You’ll join a multidisciplinary team focused on ingesting, processing, and managing massive streams of sensor and operational data across a wide array of devices—from drones and robots to industrial systems and smart environments.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Design, build, and maintain scalable, reliable, and high-throughput data ingestion pipelines for structured and semi-structured data.
* Implement robust and secure data lake and SQL-based storage architectures optimized for performance and cost.
* Develop and maintain internal tools and frameworks for data ingestion using Python, Golang, and SQL.
* Build and maintain inference pipelines to support model serving and near real time prediction workflows
* Develop and maintain internal tools and deployment processes to support ML development workflow , including experimentation, testing, deployment and monitoring.
* Collaborate cross-functionally with Cloud, Edge, Product, and AI teams to define data contracts, schemas, and retention policies.
* Use AWS cloud infrastructure (including Argo Workflows, S3, Lambda, Glue, Kinesis, Athena, and RDS) to support end-to-end data workflows.
* Employ Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) practices using Terraform to manage data platform infrastructure.
* Monitor data pipelines for quality, latency, and failures using tools such as CloudWatch, SumoLogic, or DataDog.
* Build and maintain ingestion pipelines that land curated sensor and operational data into Delta tables on Databricks to support ML experimentation and model training.
* Continuously optimize storage, partitioning, and query performance across large-scale datasets.
* Participate in architecture reviews and ensure the platform adheres to security, compliance, and best practice standards.

**Skills and Qualifications**

* 5+ years of professional experience in software engineering or data engineering.
* Strong programming skills in Python and Golang.
* Deep understanding of SQL and modern data lake architectures (e.g., using Parquet, Iceberg, or Delta Lake).
* Hands-on experience with AWS services including but not limited to: S3, Lambda, Glue, Kinesis, Athena, and RDS.
* Proficiency with Terraform for automating infrastructure deployment and management.
* Hands-on experience with Databricks for ML workflows: MLflow experiment tracking and model registry, Model Serving, and building training datasets in Delta Lake (PySpark/Spark SQL).
* Experience working with real-time or batch data ingestion at scale, and designing fault-tolerant ETL/ELT pipelines.
* Familiarity with DVC for dataset versioning and management.
* Familiarity with event-driven architectures and messaging systems like Kafka or Kinesis.
* Strong debugging and optimization skills across cloud, network, and application layers.
* Excellent collaboration, communication, and documentation skills.

**Bonus Points**

* Experience working with time-series or IoT sensor data at industrial scale.
* Exposure to gRPC and protobuf-based data contracts.
* Experience supporting ML pipelines and feature stores.
* Working knowledge of Kubernetes concepts.
* Databricks Machine Learning certification (Professional)
* Prior startup experience and/or comfort working in fast-paced, iterative environments.

Atoms is building the machines that power the next era of progress.

Over the last decade, software has transformed the digital world. But the physical world, where food is made, minerals are mined, goods are moved, and industries are run, remains far less intelligent, far less efficient, and far more constrained. We're changing that.

Atoms builds Physical AI— real-world robots for the industries that move civilization forward, starting with food, mining, and transport. Our systems are designed to understand, predict, and control the real world with precision, turning complex physical operations into something more reliable, more scalable, and more productive.

This work requires more than robotics. It requires deep integration across hardware, software, AI, operations, manufacturing, and real estate. We don't just build machines in a lab. We deploy them into real environments, operate them, learn from them, and improve them until they work at scale.

We are roboticists, engineers, operators, and builders. We believe the next great technology companies will not only transform information, but the physical systems that shape everyday life.

If you want to work on hard problems with real-world impact, join us.

  

**About the role**

The QC Technician is the last check between our electronics and the field. You will flash firmware onto circuit boards every day, run functional tests, and make sure every board that leaves the bench is correctly programmed, traceable, and working.

This is a hands-on, bench-based role on the hardware production team. You will work closely with hardware and firmware engineers, follow documented procedures, and flag anything that looks off before it reaches a vehicle.

  

**What you'll do**

* Use multimeters, power supplies, and basic test equipment to check voltages and continuity.
* Separate passing and failing units, and tag failures clearly for engineering review. Write clear failure reports with symptoms, steps taken, and photos where useful.
* Log serial numbers, firmware versions, test results, and failures in our tracking system or spreadsheets, label boards and keep inventory of programmed, tested, and failed units accurate.
* Do first-level troubleshooting on failed flashes and tests: re-seat connections, check cables, retry, and swap fixtures–escalate recurring or unexplained failures to hardware and firmware engineers with enough detail to act on.

* Basic use of a multimeter and bench power supply.

* Reliable, consistent, and comfortable with repetitive, high-volume work.

jobs.description:

**About Us - FLI**

FieldLine Industries is a Colorado-based quantum sensing company developing and manufacturing high-sensitivity quantum magnetometers and advanced multi-sensor systems. Our technology is being applied in a wide variety of application areas including navigation in GNSS-denied environments, unexploded ordnance detection, maritime sensing, and space systems.

Our technology sits at the intersection of quantum physics, precision engineering, and real-world deployment—transforming applications in navigation, space and geographical mapping, geophysics, defense applications, and fundamental research. We’re a small, highly technical team that values solving problems together, with curiosity, rigor, reliability and humor. We are growing our engineering team and are currently hiring a mid-level Embedded Software Engineer.

**The Role**

Working directly with our lead software engineer and a multidisciplinary team of physicists and electrical and mechanical engineers, you will build the software that makes our sensors work: the firmware that runs on them, the embedded Linux systems that host them, and the tools we use to test, calibrate and deploy them.

Most of the work in front of us sits close to the hardware—Zephyr RTOS firmware on microcontrollers, embedded Linux on the systems around our sensors, and the data paths between our FPGA signal-processing chains and the rest of the system. Our sensors also fly on drones and are headed to orbit on small satellite payloads, so the same day might include writing a device driver, chasing a timing bug with a logic analyzer, and debugging telemetry from a field test. The work also reaches up the stack when we need it to: analyzing sensor data, storing and serving it, and moving it between instruments, vehicles and ground systems over the network.

This is a high-impact, high-ownership role. You will own major software subsystems, help set the engineering practices for software at FieldLine, and see your code run on hardware deployed in the field.

**What we’re looking for…**

This role is ideal for an engineer who is most at home where software meets hardware, and who is happy to follow a problem wherever it leads—down into a register map, across into a schematic, or up into a Python script that automates the test.

We’ll be upfront: the range of work here is broad, and we don’t expect anyone to arrive knowing all of it. What we’re looking for is a solid embedded foundation in C/C++ and real hardware, plus the curiosity and self-direction to pick up the rest. If you read the list below and recognize about half of it, and are excited to learn the other half, we want to hear from you.

We recognize that virtually every job post calls for someone driven and self-motivated, but *we actually mean it here!* You’ll be part of a small, tight team who enjoys collaborating while wearing multiple hats.

**Responsibilities:**

* Develop and maintain Zephyr RTOS firmware for sensor electronics and small-satellite payloads, including drivers, board support, and peripheral interfaces

jobs.title: Electrical Engineer
jobs.description:
Electrical Engineer

**Location:** Colorado Springs, CO  
**Work Arrangement:** Onsite  
**Industry:** Aerospace, Space & Defense

Job Summary

We are seeking an Electrical Engineer to support the design, development, testing, and optimization of advanced electronic products for aerospace, space, and defense applications. This role offers an opportunity to work across the full product development lifecycle, from circuit design and PCB layout to prototyping, troubleshooting, qualification testing, and final product delivery.

The ideal candidate will have a strong foundation in analog and digital circuit design, schematic capture, PCB design, and electrical testing. Candidates at various experience levels, including recent graduates with relevant academic projects, internships, or hands-on engineering experience, are encouraged to apply.

Working closely with the Lead Electrical Engineer and a collaborative engineering team, the successful candidate will contribute to innovative engineering solutions for mission-critical applications.

Key Responsibilities

* Assist in the design, development, and optimization of analog and digital electronic circuits.
* Create, review, and maintain electrical schematics and engineering design documentation.
* Support PCB design and layout, including component selection, placement, and signal routing.
* Perform circuit analysis, simulation, troubleshooting, and performance verification.
* Support firmware development and hardware-software integration as required.
* Research, evaluate, and select electronic components, including components suitable for space and defense applications.
* Build and test prototypes, perform hands-on assembly and soldering, and troubleshoot electronic hardware.
* Develop and maintain test procedures, test fixtures, and automated testing solutions.
* Conduct electrical testing and support environmental and qualification testing, including thermal vacuum, random vibration, electromagnetic interference (EMI), and stability testing.
* Use SPICE and other engineering analysis tools to simulate and evaluate circuit performance.
* Document test results and prepare technical reports, including worst-case circuit analysis and reliability assessments.
* Support system-level integration, product optimization, final testing, and performance verification.
* Collaborate with engineering, manufacturing, and cross-functional teams to meet technical specifications and customer requirements.
* Participate in technical reviews, resolve product-related issues, and assist with customer technical inquiries.

Required Qualifications

* Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering or a closely related field.
* Strong foundational knowledge of analog and digital circuit design.
* Experience with schematic capture and PCB design/layout tools through professional experience, internships, or academic projects.
* Understanding of circuit analysis, electrical testing, and electronic troubleshooting.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and technical documentation skills.
* Hands-on interest in prototyping, hardware development, testing, and product integration.
* Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a small, cross-functional engineering environment.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Must meet applicable U.S. export control eligibility requirements for the position.

Preferred Qualifications

* Approximately five years of relevant electrical engineering experience; however, candidates with less experience are encouraged to apply.
* Experience with embedded firmware development and hardware-software integration.
* Familiarity with FPGA technology and hardware description languages such as Verilog or VHDL.
* Experience with LabVIEW or other automated test and measurement software.
* Familiarity with SPICE circuit simulation and electrical engineering analysis tools.
* Knowledge of environmental testing, reliability analysis, and space qualification requirements.
* Experience in aerospace, defense, satellite electronics, or other space-related applications.
* Experience with component derating, worst-case circuit analysis, and reliability engineering.

Benefits

The organization offers a comprehensive benefits package, including:

* Medical, dental, and vision insurance.
* Short-term and long-term disability coverage.
* Basic and supplemental life insurance.
* Accident and critical illness insurance.
* Employee assistance programs.
* Retirement savings plan with employer matching.
* Professional development and career growth opportunities.

Additional Requirements

* **Work Location:** Colorado Springs, Colorado; onsite attendance is required.
* **Export Compliance:** This position involves access to information controlled under the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR). Candidates must satisfy the applicable U.S. person requirements under 22 CFR 120.15, which include U.S. citizens, lawful permanent residents, refugees, and asylees, as applicable.
* **Equal Employment Opportunity:** All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to legally protected characteristics. Reasonable accommodations are available during the application process.

Ideal Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate is a hands-on Electrical Engineer with a solid foundation in analog and digital electronics, PCB design, circuit simulation, and hardware testing. Candidates who demonstrate practical engineering skills, attention to detail, a collaborative mindset, and an interest in aerospace and space-based electronic systems will be well suited for this opportunity.

jobs.title: Design & Automation Engineer
jobs.description:
**Welcome to Lava Island**

Lava Island is an indoor play oasis where kids fly across trampolines, vanish into towering jungle gyms, dive into foam pits, and race down slides while families share pizza and celebrate birthdays in the party rooms. It is loud, bright, and full of energy.

Every trampoline, deck, slide, and play piece is made by hand. **Active Play Solutions (APS)** is the team that makes them. Before any of it gets built, somebody has to design it. That is you.

**The Job**

You will own original product design for Lava Island's playground and jump deck equipment, built in Autodesk Inventor, from first concept through build-ready specification. You will also work with the automation that makes APS's production floor smarter and more efficient as manufacturing scales.

This is a from-scratch role. You are not maintaining files somebody else built, you are the one building them, and you will lead APS's move from AutoCAD to Inventor, training the team on the new way of working as you go.

**Why APS**

* **Real design authority.** Build from concept, not from a spec somebody else already made.
* **Two disciplines, one seat.** Product design and automation both live on your desk.
* **Build something.** The CAD standards and design library for APS are being built right now. You help set how it runs.
* **Own the transition.** Lead the move to Inventor and shape how design works here going forward.
* **Denver home base.** On-site, minimal travel.
* Per company benefits program.
  

**What You Will Do**

**Design the equipment**

* Design playground and jump deck equipment from concept through build-ready specification in Autodesk Inventor.
* Review drawings and models for accuracy, manufacturability, and compliance with our design standards.
* Build a library of reusable design templates, standard parts, and design documentation for APS.

**Build the automation**

* Design and refine warehouse automation and machine programming as production volume scales.
* Evaluate and recommend equipment and tooling upgrades that improve manufacturing efficiency.

**Lead the transition**

* Move APS from AutoCAD to Inventor, building the training materials and coaching the team through it.

**Coordinate across teams**

* Work with the Design/architecture team in Revit so equipment integrates cleanly with building layouts.
* Partner with production floor leadership to refine designs based on real build feedback.

  

**What You Need**

* 5+ years in mechanical or product design, with real, original design work in Autodesk Inventor, not just editing existing files.
* Autodesk Certified Professional in Inventor for Mechanical Design (or equivalent) is strongly preferred, and matters more to us than a four-year degree. Real, demonstrated Inventor experience is what we're looking for.
* Strong working knowledge of Inventor iProperties, including their role in drawings, bills of materials, and design documentation.
* Experience integrating CAD design with automation, CNC, or robotics systems.
* Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings, specifications, and manufacturing requirements.
* Comfortable teaching others a new tool and new design standards.
* Comfortable working on-site in a production/warehouse environment.
* Comfort with email, digital documentation, and design/PDM systems. APS operates in a Microsoft 365 environment.

  

Background in playground, amusement, or structural steel manufacturing is a plus. So is familiarity with Revit, experience building configurable product models, experience with process automation or “smart” manufacturing systems, and having led a CAD platform transition before.

**Ready to Build What's Next?**

If you want to be the one designing what Lava Island builds next, not just running someone else's files, we want to meet you. Apply today.

This position is responsible for assembling and wiring electrical control systems, programming and troubleshooting automation equipment, supporting prototype development, and assisting with the installation and commissioning of new equipment.

The ideal candidate will possess strong experience in industrial automation, electronic troubleshooting, PLC programming, and machine controls, with hands-on knowledge of Beckhoff, WAGO, and Allen-Bradley control platforms. jobs.title: Robotics Software Engineer
jobs.description:
### **Description**

Stratom, Inc. is a mission-driven engineering company building autonomous and unmanned off-highway vehicles and related robotic systems. Our systems operate in demanding real-world environments, where performance, reliability, and engineering discipline are essential. Integrating advanced autonomy with rugged industrial hardware for austere conditions.  
  
Our work spans the full lifecycle of complex systems, from early concept and prototyping through fielded deployment. With multiple working prototypes in hand, our next major opportunity is transitioning these platforms into production over the coming years to deliver capable systems at scale. We are looking for talented and experienced engineers who want to take ownership of hard problems and play a key role in bringing multiple platforms into production.

### **Duties and Responsibilities**

Stratom is seeking a Robotics Software Engineer with 3-5 years of experience to support the design, development, testing, and integration of advanced autonomus robotic systems.  
  
This role is ideal for an engineer who enjoys hands-on problem solving and working across the full development process - problem definition, system design, implementation, testing, and deployment.  
  
The Robotics Software Engineer will work closely with experienced engineers and cross-functional teams to develop reliable software systems while growing technical expertise in robotics software development including perception, navigation, state estimation, and autonomous behaviors.

### **Qualifications**

**Requirements**

* Bachelor of Science in Robotics, Software, or Equivalent Engineering + 3 - 5 years experience
* Master of Science in Robotics, Software, or Equivalent Engineering + 1 - 3 years experience
* Experience developing software for robotic applications
* Proficiency with C++ programming languages
* Experience with modern software development practices (version control, unit testing, CI/CD).
* Knowledge of motion planning, navigation, mapping, or control systems
* Understanding of kinematics, dynamics, and state estimation (e.g., Kalman filtering)
* Experience developing on Linux-based systems
* Ability to work with sensors (LIDAR, cameras, IMUs), actuators, and microcontrollers
* Experience debugging hardware/software interfaces
* Experience executing functional, integration, regression, and system-level tests in a structured engineering environment

**Preferred Skills**

* Strong Proficiency with C/C++, Python
* Hands-on experience with ROS or ROS2
* Experience selecting sensors for robotic applications
* Experience developing and deploying autonomous behaviors for mobile robots
* Experience developing and deploying motion planning software for MDoF robotic arms
* Experience developing GUI applications for human-machine interfaces
* Proficiency in simulation environment setup and management

**Soft Skills**

* Strong problem-solving skills and engineering judgment
* Self-motivated with the ability to manage multiple priorities
* Strong written and verbal communication skills
* Collaborative team member with a hands-on approach
* Willingness to learn and take ownership of engineering challenges

**A Note About This Role**  
These qualifications represent the types of experience that tend to be successful at Stratom. We are intentionally building a small, highly effective team, and we value engineers who bring complementary strengths. Roles at Stratom often intersect, and the exact responsibilities may evolve based on the skills and initiative of the person who joins. Ultimately, we are building a team that contributes to our mission.

**Additional Requirements**  
This position requires use of information which is subject to the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) and/or the Export Administration Regulations (EAR). Non-U.S. persons selected must meet eligibility requirements for access to export-restricted information. The ITAR/EAR defines a U.S. person as a U.S. Citizen, U.S. Permanent Resident (i.e. 'Green Card Holder'), Political Asylee, or Refugee.  
  
While a DoD Security Clearance is not required when starting at Stratom, we require our employees maintain their eligibility to obtain one.

### **Benefits**

Stratom offers an array of benefits to eligible full-time employees, including health insurance, life and AD&D insurance, a retirement investment plan, annual paid time off, and holiday pay.  
  
Stratom is committed to providing Equal Opportunity in Employment, to all applicants and employees regardless of race, color, religion, sex, age, national origin, military status, veteran status, handicap, physical or mental disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, genetic information or any other characteristic protected by law.

### **About Stratom**

Stratom is a global leader in the development of unmanned ground vehicles and autonomous robotic systems that solve the most pressing real-world logistics and operational challenges for commercial and defense applications. Specializing in unmanned cargo movement, robotic refueling, robotic hazardous liquid transfer and autonomous mobile robots (AMR), the company’s military-proven tools, methods, technologies and strategic services solve the most difficult logistics and operational challenges. Whether in a safe, controlled settings or dynamic and challenging terrain, Stratom provides unique solutions to meet each customer’s specific needs. With its extensive expertise in R&D, engineering and system integration of autonomous technologies and solutions, Stratom, a Service-Disabled Veteran-Owned Small Business, is the go-to expert for global corporations, local businesses and government institutions.

Integrating advanced autonomy with rugged industrial hardware for austere conditions.
  
  
Our work spans the full lifecycle of complex systems, from early concept and prototyping through fielded deployment. With multiple working prototypes in hand, our next major opportunity is transitioning these platforms into production over the coming years to deliver capable systems at scale. We are looking for talented and experienced engineers who want to take ownership of hard problems and play a key role in bringing multiple platforms into production.
  
  
**About the Role**  
This role is for a senior embedded software engineer who is comfortable working across architecture, implementation, hardware integration, and verification. You will develop the vehicle control software that sits between autonomy and the physical machine on rugged robotic and ground vehicle systems, where embedded design decisions directly affect safety, reliability, testability, and field supportability.
  
  
The successful candidate will own embedded subsystems from early architecture and interface definition through bring-up, testing, field deployment, and long-term maintenance. This includes defining task scheduling and data flow, implementing drivers and control logic on microcontroller-based targets, building the test infrastructure that proves the software works, and helping define the low-level safety mechanisms that keep autonomous vehicles in a safe state. You will work closely with the autonomy, electrical, mechanical, and systems teams, and play a key part in defining how vehicle control and autonomy work together. As Stratom moves multiple platforms from prototype to production, this role will help shape embedded software that is not only functional but also robust, verifiable, maintainable, and ready for deployment at scale.

**Duties and Responsibilities**
-------------------------------

* Design, develop, test, and maintain embedded software in C and C++ on microcontrollers running RTOS for vehicle control, actuation, sensing, and autonomous system functions
* Develop and integrate peripherals and interfaces for CAN, PWM, GPIO, SPI, I2C, UART ADC, timers, and watchdog
* Own software architecture and design decisions for embedded subsystems, and lead design and code reviews
* Define and own the runtime architecture of embedded vehicle software, including task scheduling, inter-module data flow, and diagnostics
* Build unit, integration, software-in-the-loop, hardware-in-the-loop, and system-level tests, and integrate them into CI/CD pipelines to meet quality, repeatability, and schedule goals
* Lead embedded software bring-up on new vehicle platforms, including controller configuration, peripheral and network verification, and integration with sensors and actuato
* Triage issues and perform root cause analysis using system context, field observations, and log data
* Work with the autonomy and systems teams to define the vehicle control–autonomy interface, including messaging, fault handling, and platform safety requirements
* Contribute to the design and implementation of vehicle-level safety mechanisms for autonomous platforms, such as fault monitoring, emergency stop, and fail-safe behavior
* Mentor engineers and promote sound software and system safety practices across the team

  

**Qualifications**
------------------

**Requirements**

* Bachelor’s degree in computer engineering, computer science, electrical engineering, or a related field
* 5+ years of professional embedded software development experience
* Strong proficiency in C and C++
* Experience with Git, CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, static analysis, and code quality tools
* Experience with CAN and SAE J1939
* Experience developing software in a Linux environment
* Strong proficiency in Python for test automation and engineering tools
* Strong debugging, analytical, and problem-solving skills
  

  

**Preferred Skills**

* Experience designing and developing test infrastructure for safety-critical systems, including HIL/SIL environments and automated regression testing
* Familiarity with functional safety standards such as MIL-STD-882E and ISO 26262
* Experience with structured development processes, including requirements traceability, verification, and validation
* Experience designing software for multiple hardware targets, including HAL design and cross-platform build systems
* Familiarity with coding standards such as MISRA C/C++
* Hands-on experience with lab equipment (oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, CAN tools) and reading schematics
* Experience with ROS or ROS 2
* Experience with PID or vehicle control systems
* Experience deploying and supporting software across a fleet of autonomous vehicles or mobile robots

**A Note About This Role**
  
These qualifications represent the types of experience that tend to be successful at Stratom. We are intentionally building a small, highly effective team, and we value engineers who bring complementary strengths. Roles at Stratom often intersect, and the exact responsibilities may evolve based on the skills and initiative of the person who joins. Ultimately, we are building a team that contributes to our mission.

**Additional Requirements**  
This position requires use of information which is subject to the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) and/or the Export Administration Regulations (EAR). The ITAR/EAR defines a U.S. person as a U.S. Citizen, U.S. Permanent Resident (i.e. 'Green Card Holder'), Political Asylee, or Refugee.

* Verification and Testing: Design and execute functional and/or automated testing to demonstrate full compliance with software requirements. Assist in hardware bring-up, hardware/software debugging, analyzing steady state and transient test results, and dynamometer testing.
* Cross-functional Coordination: Work with electric machine designers to assist in optimized motor parameters. Partner closely with hardware and power electronics engineers to design, test, and optimize motor drive hardware and thermal performance. * B.S. in Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or Computer Science required with a minimum GPA of 3.3 – M.S. or PhD a plus

* An understanding of MCUs, switching devices (MOSFET, IGBT, SiC, GaN, etc.), gate drivers, current and voltage sensing, and ADC synchronization

**Description**

The Defense Systems Group at Leidos has an immediate opening for a Principal Digital Firmware Design Engineer at our St. Petersburg, FL facility. This position supports the development of advanced, mission-critical military communications systems and involves the design, integration, testing, and optimization of secure, ruggedized electronic hardware and firmware for defense applications.

The ideal candidate will possess deep expertise in FPGA-based digital design and hands-on experience with integrating hardware and firmware within complex embedded systems. This individual will have a demonstrated track record supporting defense programs across the full product lifecycle—from requirements development and architectural design through integration, qualification testing, and transition to production.

The Leidos St. Petersburg facility specializes in the design, development, modeling and simulation, analysis, prototyping, and testing of advanced electronic systems. Our primary focus areas include embedded communications systems, Software Defined Radios (SDR), and Phased Array Antenna Systems supporting Department of Defense and commercial customers.

Primary Responsibilities:

  

* Participate in a multi-disciplinary engineering team developing secure, high-performance military communications hardware and firmware.
* Analyze and decompose system-level requirements into detailed hardware design specifications with full traceability.
* Perform Logic Design; write VHDL code, perform synthesis, logic simulation, test bench generation, functional testing and hardware debugging of designs within FPGA/CPLD devices.
* Architect, implement and test embedded firmware /software within FPGA-based digital designs including signal processing, control logic, and high-speed interfaces on a variety of platforms (FPGAs, microcontrollers, microprocessors, and mixed signal designs).
* Troubleshoot and resolve complex hardware, firmware / software and integration issues across prototype and production phases.
* Support design reviews (SRR, PDR, CDR), technical documentation, and configuration management processes.
* Provide technical input for cost estimates, schedules, and risk assessments.
* Collaborate closely with Firmware, Software, RF, systems, and test engineering teams throughout the development lifecycle.

Clearance Requirements:

  

* U.S. Citizen required.
* Ability to obtain and maintain a Secret Security Clearance.
* Active Secret clearance preferred.
* Ability to obtain Top Secret clearance preferred.

Required Qualifications:

  

* BS or MS in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related field.
* 8+ years of experience in embedded hardware and digital design (10+ preferred for Senior level).
* Experience supporting full product development lifecycle including:
  + Requirements analysis, System design and hardware implementation, Integration and test
  + Firmware/software architecture development for embedded systems, including FPGAs and SoCs
  + Technical documentation and formal design reviews
* Strong VHDL, FPGA/SoC design and implementation experience:
  + Digital logic design using VHDL/Verilog with System-On-Chip devices (SoC’s), FPGA’s, CPLD/s, and/or Microcontrollers.
  + Modern vendor design tools (IDE’s) such as Xilinx Vivado, Vitis, STM, Libero SoC, Lattice Diamond
  + Simulation and Testbench generation (Xilinx simulator, Aldec Active HDL, Riveria Pro, Modelsim, or similar)
  + RISC microprocessors architectures (ARM Cortex, Microblaze, PowerPC, RISC-V)
  + C/C++ language software development for embedded, real-time systems.
* Experience with one or more of the following:
  + Integrating and troubleshooting digital subsystems within embedded systems.
  + Digital interfaces such as I2C, SPI, RS-232/422, USB, Ethernet
  + ADC/DAC devices and understanding performance characteristics.
  + Hands-on lab experience debugging hardware using oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, and related tools
* Understand trade-offs of embedded system targets (FPGA, SoC, microcontroller, RTOS, bare-metal) for developing best cost/option architectures

Preferred Qualifications:

  

* Active Secret or Top Secret clearance.
* Proven experience in full-stack FPGA development for Xilinx UltraScale/UltraScale+ architectures, spanning RTL design (VHDL/Verilog) and embedded C/C++ development for bare-metal, FreeRTOS, or embedded Linux environments (PetaLinux, etc).
* Experience with one or more of the following:

  + High-speed interfaces/protocols such as PCIe, JESD204B, LVDS, and SERDES
  + Simulation and modeling tools (MATLAB, Python, LabVIEW)
  + Implementing signal processing concepts such as digital filters, digital modulation, up/down conversion within HDL designs
  + IP cores and modern processor interfaces (Xilinx IP Cores, AXI4, AXI-Stream or similar)
  + Design, integration and testing electronic circuits within embedded systems, including digital, analog and radio frequency (RF) subsystems.

KNAPP brings new technology to warehouse automation.

The KNAPP Group is a global provider of intelligent automation solutions for intralogistics and manufacturing, specializing in the sectors healthcare, fashion/apparel, general retail, food retail, industry and service. We live and breathe automation. We, more than 8,000 employees of the KNAPP Group in over 60 locations worldwide, shaping the future-oriented industry of intralogistics are dedicated to making complexity simple.

* Ongoing monitoring of the processing status of open support requests and initiation of countermeasures if resolution times are too long.

* Providing frequent technical updates per mail or in a bridge call to KNAPP customers during an ongoing escalation.
* Actively monitoring customer sites and proactively resolving potential Incidents.
* Support our customer on all technical and operational matters and questions.
* Work with KNAPP subsidiaries and subject matter experts to ensure an efficient communication and problem resolution.
* Coordinate and ensure a proper documentation of root cause analysis and incident resolution.
* Proactively requesting customer information as part of the service agreement.
* Training of new employees.
* Checking and supplementing customer documentation and internal documentation.
* Execution of small projects from Customer Service.

**WHAT YOU HAVE**

* Bachelor's degree in related field or equivalent combination of education, training, and experience.
* 3-5 years direct experience preferred
* Excellent IT knowledge (software, hardware, networks, OS, protocols)
* Good knowledge of electrics and mechanics
* Basic knowledge of PLC control systems
* Basic knowledge of control systems
* Basic knowledge of warehouse logistics processes and automation systems
* Excellent communication skills both written and verbal
* Ability to record complex technical issues both orally and in writing
* Ability to work well under pressure

* Authorization to work in the U.S.
* Passport or ability to obtain passport
* Professional office etiquette is always required
* Travel expected up to 20%
* Overtime as required by work
* Ability to travel by air both domestically (US) and internationally
* Physical requirements: sitting for long periods of time, standing, walking, climbing a ladder, speaking, visual acuity, finger dexterity, listening, reaching at arm’s length, and lifting up to 30 pounds.

**WHAT YOU WILL GET**

* 2 remote days per week when in office
* Half day Fridays when in office
* A beautiful new, state-of-the-art, office complex in Kennesaw, GA
* Industry competitive compensation
* Great benefits with better than average employer contributions, including health, dental, vision, life insurance, Flexible Spending Accounts, Short & Long Term Disability and more!

* Paid Vacation & Holidays

jobs.title: Substation Automation Engineer
jobs.description:
Overview:

ENERCON's Substation Group is at the forefront of the energy transition, tackling real-world challenges as the grid evolves. With the rapid growth of smart home technology, electric vehicles, battery energy storage, and renewable energy sources, we’re facing a new era of power systems—one defined by multi-directional power flows, advanced data acquisition, and dynamic load management. Join us as we help redefine how energy is delivered, managed, and sustained for generations to come.

Due to continued growth, our Power Delivery group is seeking a Substation Automation Engineer in one of the following office locations:

* Houston, TX
* Orlando, FL
* Overland Park, KS
* Kennesaw, GA
* Covington, LA (Hybrid)
* Remote

This position may be filled at various engineering levels. Job title and job level will be determined based upon candidate’s qualifications and experience.

Responsibilities:

Imagine a day where you're helping utilities modernize the power grid through advanced automation and digital substation technologies. You develop SCADA systems, integrate intelligent electronic devices (IEDs), configure communication networks, and support field commissioning activities that bring substations to life. Your work enables operators to monitor, control, and respond to changing grid conditions in real time, helping deliver safe, reliable, and sustainable power to millions of customers.

**Substation Automation & Integration**

* Develop and implement substation automation systems, including SCADA, RTU, HMI, and Intelligent Electronic Device (IED) integration.
* Configure and test communication protocols such as DNP3, IEC 61850, IEC 60870, and Modbus.
* Design and develop automation databases, point lists, communication mappings, and control logic.

**Engineering & System Configuration**

* Configure and commission substation automation equipment, including RTUs, gateways, protocol converters, network switches, and automation controllers.
* Develop and maintain engineering documentation including automation architecture drawings, communication diagrams, device configuration files, and testing procedures.
* Support cybersecurity and network design efforts for modern digital substations.

**Collaboration & Quality Assurance**

* Work closely with protection and control engineers, network engineers, project managers, and clients to develop integrated automation solutions.
* Perform quality reviews to ensure compliance with client standards and industry best practices.
* Support troubleshooting and resolution of automation, communication, and system integration issues.

**Field Support & Commissioning**

* Provide technical support during system installation, energization, and commissioning activities.
* Conduct field testing and validation of automation systems and communication networks.
* Travel to client sites as required to support project execution and startup activities. #LI-MD1

Qualifications:

* Bachelor of Science in Electrical Engineering or related engineering discipline required
* Minimum of 2 years of experience in electric utility, substation automation, SCADA, or control systems engineering
* Familiarity with utility communication protocols including DNP3, IEC 61850, IEC 60870, or Modbus
* Understanding of substation protection and control system and IED applications
* Experience configuring automation equipment, RTUs, gateways, HMIs, or communication processors
* Ability to read and interpret substation drawings, communication diagrams, and protection and control schematics
* Strong written and verbal communication skills with both internal and external stakeholders
* Must be self-driven in time management to meet deadlines and provide accurate deliverables, with the ability to communicate effectively with both internal and external stakeholders
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite (Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint).
* Willingness to enter energized electric substations with proper training and PPE
* Willingness to travel for client site visits, commissioning activities, and project meetings

Preferred Qualifications

* Professional Engineer License or equivalent certification
* Five or more years of experience in substation automation, SCADA integration, or utility controls engineering
* Experience with SEL, Novatech, Siemens, GE Vernova, Hitachi Energy, Schneider Electric, ABB, or similar utility automation platforms
* Hands-on experience with SEL RTAC, SEL-3530 RTAC, SEL Blueframe, Beckwith M-3931, or comparable automation systems
* Knowledge of utility networking, Ethernet switches, fiber-optic communications, and cybersecurity principles
* Experience performing field commissioning activities
* Experience working within electric utility organizations or consulting engineering environments
* Utility-scale transmission or distribution substation experience up to 500 kV

jobs.description:
Overview:

Become a part of ENERCON as a Senior or Principal Instrumentation and Controls Design Engineer. We are seeking talented I&C Engineers to join our Nuclear Design Group.

Our Instrumentation & Controls Engineer career path has many options. You can bring your experience to our mid-level and senior roles, or step into a principal engineer position where you’ll lead and mentor others. We continually invest in our employees and provide training and tools for advancement, development, and career progression—whether you prefer a path to become a subject matter or technical expert, a people leader, a project manager, or a leader in business development. We are currently hiring for full-time roles in the following locations:

* Glendale, AZ
* San Luis Obispo, CA
* Kennewick, WA
* Chattanooga, TN
* Kennesaw, GA (Suburb of Atlanta)
* Naperville, IL (Suburb of Chicago)
* Overland Park, KS

* Palm Beach Gardens, FL
* Birmingham, AL

* King of Prussia, PA

We are looking for Instrumentation and Control Systems Engineers to be part of multi-discipline project teams that perform upgrades and modifications to nuclear power plants. The subject matter will be in the following areas:

* Digital Systems, such as PLCs, DCSs, Human System Interfaces, network devices, and similar control systems
* Sensing instruments and transmitters for level, pressure, flow, temperature, reactivity, vibration, position, and speed.
* Functional Requirements and Procurement Specifications for instrumentation and control systems
* Design change package preparation and review/design verification per industry and client standards
* Provide guidance as a mentor in the development of less experienced nuclear instrumentation and controls design engineers

Responsibilities:

As a key member of our engineering department, you'll collaborate with interdisciplinary teams to support the safe, reliable, and efficient operation of commercial nuclear power facilities. A typical day may include conducting electrical assessments, ensuring compliance with regulatory standards, updating plant drawings and documentation, reviewing vendor submittals, and implementing innovative solutions to enhance plant reliability and safety.

* **Develop Engineering Deliverables:** Produce precise and error-free drawings, calculations, and analyses that exceed industry codes, standards, and client expectations, ensuring every project is built on a solid foundation of accuracy
* **Set the Standard:** Develop engineering documents that not only meet but surpass client, ENERCON, and regulatory requirements, adhering to processes that guarantee excellence every step of the way
* **Stay on the Cutting Edge:** Continuously enhance your expertise in industry codes, safety culture principles, and advanced design techniques, staying ahead in the dynamic nuclear sector
* **Drive Quality & Precision:** Deliver exceptional engineering solutions that align with rigorous quality assurance programs and consistently raise the bar for project performance
* **Cultivate Strong Client Connections:** Build trust and lasting relationships through clear communication, professional engagement, and the consistent delivery of superior engineering results
* **Collaborate Across Disciplines:** Partner seamlessly with multidisciplinary teams to create integrated, well-rounded designs that meet diverse project requirements
* **Provide Field Support:** Take your expertise on-site, engaging directly with client personnel, performing detailed plant walkdowns, and ensuring all structures, systems, and components meet the highest engineering standards #LI-MB1

Qualifications:

* Bachelor's Degree in Electrical, Mechanical, Chemical, Computer, Mechanical, Nuclear Engineering, or related field in Engineering or equivalent education/experience
* A minimum of 6 years of experience in design engineering of instrumentation and control systems; preferably for nuclear power, 10+ years experience for Principal Level
* Experience with power plant instrumentation and controls systems design for either BWR or PWR units, including turbine/feedwater controls, radiation monitoring, HVAC/chiller controls, reactor protection, plant process computers, and human system interfaces
* Experience in preparing, marking up, and reviewing design drawings, instrument data sheets, and software/cyber security documents
* Experience developing system requirement/ procurement specifications, design descriptions/control narratives, test plans/test procedures, and requirements traceability matrixes
* Must have experience in power generation, nuclear power or government (DOE) projects directly or with an engineering/design consulting firm
* Good writing, presentation and communication skills
* Ability to be an individual contributor and work effectively in teams
* Proficient in Word and Excel
* Due to Federal Contract Requirements, US Citizenship is required
* Approximate travel of 10% as needed

jobs.description:
This Opportunity

WSP is currently initiating a search for an **Intermediate Professional, Electrical Engineering** for our **Meridian, ID** office. Be involved in projects with our **ESSP (Electrical Studies, SCADA & Protection) Team** and be a part of a growing organization that meets our clients' objectives and solves their challenges.

WSP brings global expertise in power delivery, power generation, and program management—anchored by the acquisition of POWER Engineers, Inc. TRC Companies have now joined WSP, deepening our power practice and expanding our energy advisory and intelligent grid services. We're partnering with clients to shape how energy systems evolve around the world—and we need your help.

The successful applicant will be responsible for performing services related to electrical studies, SCADA, and system protection. Depending on project needs and individual expertise, this role may involve supporting a broad range of activities or specializing in a specific area as outlined under “Your Impact.” Candidates are not expected to be proficient in all listed areas, they are expected to have a fundamental understanding of three-phase power and power system fundamentals. Applicable power systems primarily include conventional and renewable generation facilities, substations, transmission systems, and distribution systems. Activities may include one or more of the following:

**Your Impact:**

* Protective Relaying: short circuit and symmetrical component analysis, time-current coordination, protection scheme and criteria development, relay settings calculation, integration with SCADA systems, NERC compliance, and arc flash analysis. Applicable software: AcSELerator Quickset (SEL-5030), AcSELerator Architect, GE EnerVista, ASPEN OneLiner, Gridscale X (CAPE), SKM-PTW, ETAP, RSCAD/RTDS
* Power System Planning Studies: steady-state real and reactive power flow including outage contingencies, generation interconnect feasibility, P-V and Q-V analysis for voltage stability margins, dynamic stability performance, automation of large batch simulations, working with models from NERC regional entities (WECC, MRO, SERC etc.), NERC compliance. Applicable Software: PSS/E, PSLF, PowerWorld, DSA Tools, Python Scripting
* Design Studies: substation grounding, corona, electric and magnetic fields, insulation coordination (lightning, switching surge, and contamination performance), transient (time domain) simulation, power quality (harmonics, voltage flicker, over/under voltage, etc.), motor starting, AC interference (transmission line interaction with railroads and pipelines). Applicable Software: CDEGS, ATP-EMTP, PSCAD, POLARIS-EMF, COMSOL Multiphysics, TFlash
* Networking and Communications: design and configure network and communication paths for Remote Terminal Units (RTUs), protective relays, meters, Human Machine Interface (HMIs), PLC’s and other SCADA system equipment; develop basic specifications for fiber optic, microwave, power line carrier, or radio communication paths; travel to project sites to troubleshoot and commission network and communication systems. Applicable network and communication protocols: DNP, Modbus, SEL Communication Protocol, Goose Messaging, IEC 61850
* Logic and Control Systems: develop and implement logic and control schemes for remote and local operation of power system equipment; develop programs on various platforms for implementation of these schemes; travel to project sites to test and commission the control schemes. Applicable Logic and Control Platforms: SEL RTAC, Orion, Cooper SMP, GE-D20
* Write technical reports summarizing analysis with findings and conclusions, generating complete, accurate, and concise documentation using sketches, calculations, electronic systems, spreadsheets, and software.
* Assist technical staff and project managers with risk identification and assessment, offering input and analysis with design concepts, construction, mitigation and improvement activities, and remediation projects.
* Assist with work plan preparation and coordination of field/site work and permitting.
* Complete training on assigned tasks.
* Perform additional responsibilities as required by business needs.
* Exercise responsible and ethical decision-making regarding company funds, resources, and conduct, and adhere to WSP’s Code of Conduct and related policies and procedures.
Perform additional responsibilities as required by business needs.  

**Who You Are:**

**Required Qualifications**

* BSEE (BS Electrical Engineering), BSEET (BS Electrical Engineering Technology), or BSCE (BS Computer Engineering) degree, from an ABET-accredited university
* One 1+ years of industry experience performing design or device configuration in technical disciplines described in the Roles and Responsibilities section
* Knowledge of electrical engineering principles, practices, process, design/build, and the application to permitting and project work-related issues.
* Analytical mindset with an ability to exercise sound judgement in evaluating situations and making decisions.
* Strong interpersonal and communication skills when interacting with others, expressing ideas effectively and professionally to an engineering and non-engineering audience.
* Capable self-leadership with attention to detail, accuracy, multi-tasking, and prioritization of responsibilities in a dynamic work environment.
* Ability to work independently with minimal supervision, as well as part of a team to meet business objectives.
* Basic proficiency with technical writing, office automation, software, technology, math principles, predictive models, spreadsheets, and tools.
* Proven track record of upholding workplace safety and ability to abide by WSP’s health, safety and drug/alcohol and harassment policies.
* Ability to work schedules conducive to project-specific requirements that may extend beyond the typical workweek.
Occasional travel may be required depending on project-specific requirements.

At Zebra, we are a community of innovators who come together to create new ways of working. United by curiosity and a culture of caring, we develop smart solutions that anticipate our customer’s and partner’s needs and solve their challenges.

**Minimum Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in engineering (Computer Engineering or Electrical Engineering or related fields) with 8+ years of relevant experience
* Significant experience delivering platform product embedded firmware development.
* Proven experienced in programming languages C/C++
* Experience in the following: ARM architecture, embedded microcontroller architecture, multi-core systems, RTOS, embedded Linux, filesystems, storage memory, networking, platform libraries, etc.
Skills in platform architecture, Object Oriented Programming, software design patterns, devices driver development.  

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Development experience in I2C, SPI, UART, USB, CAN, Modbus, WLAN, PWM, ADC, Bluetooth, Ethernet, others Microcontroller peripheral.

The role requires strong knowledge of engineering principles, programming, and control system technologies, with a focus on improving the reliability and performance of conveyors, sortation systems, scanners, cameras, print-and-apply systems, and SCADA devices. * Advanced verbal and written English skills with ability to interpret and communicate policies.

* Strong problem-solving mindset, adaptability, and commitment to continuous improvement.

* Flexibility to work varied shifts, including nights, weekends, and holidays.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* 2+ years of PLC programming, troubleshooting, and HMI/control network design, along with SCADA systems and KPIs.

* Hands-on experience with motor controls (VFDs, DC drives, starters) and industrial electrical systems (480V 3-phase, 120 VAC, 24VDC).

jobs.description:
At Lilly, the work is demanding because patients are waiting. We unite caring with discovery to help make life better for people around the world, knowing that every decision, every detail, and every day matters. Headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, our over 50,000 employees around the globe take on complex challenges to discover and deliver life-changing medicines, strengthen how health is understood and managed, and support the communities we serve. This is hard, urgent, selfless work—but it’s work worth doing. If you’re driven by purpose and ready to bring your best to work that truly matters for patients, we invite you to join us.
  
  
**Job Position Overview:**  
The Automation Engineer is a member of the Equipment Development Group (EDG) within the Engineering Technology Center (ETC). EDG’s mission is to provide innovative engineering and equipment solutions in support of customers across Lilly’s global research, development, and manufacturing communities by integrating new and established technologies—both internally and through external suppliers—to create world-class solutions for a wide variety of technical challenges. The Automation Engineer is responsible for problem-solving, electronic systems design, software architecture, and coding, and is accomplished in automated systems design and programming utilizing Allen-Bradley PLC controllers, ladder logic development tools, HMI environments, and machine vision applications. The role supports capital project delivery, contributes to validation and qualification activities, and provides global technical consultation to Lilly manufacturing sites and development teams.
  
  
**Responsibilities:**  

* Provide electrical system design and architecture for automated manufacturing equipment
* Perform electrical design (component specification, UL compliance, and schematic creation/approval), software design, coding, and debugging using Allen-Bradley PLC RS Logix, FactoryTalk View HMI, and Microsoft development environments, contributing to project requirements documents and machine vision application development
* Create validation and safety documentation, including FAT execution and machine safety reports, ensuring automation designs incorporate appropriate safety controls and risk mitigation
* Provide automation leadership on capital projects, partnering with system integrators and internal teams to deliver designs that meet requirements, optimize life cycle cost, and leverage replication and best practices
* Develop broad understanding of Lilly's manufacturing processes and lifecycle, monitor external automation standards, evaluate emerging technologies, mentor EDG staff, and support corporate initiatives like cybersecurity and engineering information management
* Champion safe, compliant, and effective operations by supporting departmental activities, maintaining HSE compliance, fostering cross-functional collaboration, and promoting continuous improvement across diverse work environments

* Education Level: Bachelor's in engineering or related science
* Minimum 3 years' experience in automation machine control, process control, or equivalent with demonstrated proficiency in Allen-Bradley PLC/HMI platforms (PLC RS Logix, FactoryTalk View, Microsoft Visual Basic, and/or Visual C++) and machine vision applications
* Qualified applicants must be authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis. Lilly will not provide support for or sponsor work authorization or visas for this role, including but not limited to F-1 CPT, F-1 OPT, F-1 STEM OPT, J-1, H-1B, TN, O-1, E-3, H-1B1, or L-1.

* Experience in automation system project delivery and major capital projects, including schedule and cost management and collaboration with other Lilly asset delivery teams.
* Experience with robotic systems integration in manufacturing automation applications, including design, programming, integration, and commissioning of robotic assembly or handling systems

**OVERVIEW**

Matrix Technologies is seeking a Senior Electrical Engineer to join our Industrial Electrical Design team. This role is focused on the design and implementation of industrial electrical systems, control panels, motor control centers (MCCs), and variable frequency drive (VFD) systems for a wide range of industrial clients.

The ideal candidate enjoys solving complex electrical design challenges, developing detailed construction and fabrication packages, and working closely with clients, contractors, and multidisciplinary engineering teams. This position is centered on electrical engineering and control panel design rather than PLC programming.

You will play a key role in delivering high-quality engineering solutions while mentoring junior engineers and helping drive successful project execution from concept through startup.

  + EPC project experience.

* This employee may perform industrial field work, which could include exposure to hazardous locations, inclement weather, moving mechanical parts, noise, ladders, uneven ground, and stairs.

jobs.title: Thermal and Fluid Systems Engineer
jobs.description:
**Job Summary:**

This entry level/early career professional, applied science position utilizes the core competencies of thermal and fluid sciences, using and advancing analytical and experimental approaches to answer key questions about the performance and architecture of a system or component. This drives decisions and creates technical content which ultimately leads to state of the art, highly effective, environmentally friendly, and competitive products.

**Key Responsibilities:**

Investigates product, system, and/or technology problems that are related to thermal and fluid sciences, understands causal mechanisms, recommends appropriate action, owns problem resolution and documents results with guidance from more experienced team members. Applies and supports the improvement of processes such as Pre Program Planning, (PPP), Product Preceding Technology, (PPT), Value Package Introduction (VPI), or Value Package Change, (VPC), Engineering Standard Work, (ESW), Functional Excellence Practice (FEP) and tools related to thermal and fluid sciences such as GT-Suite, Boost, Fluent, Converge, Concerto, CyberApps (virtual application model), Cummins Data Analysis Tool (CDAT), Mach, test data calculation, DARTS, test data storage, Calterm, Electronic Control Module (ECM) calibration tool, Emissions data system, Integrity, and ACCEPTS ECM in-loop test bench required to support the processes and enable high quality decision making. Obtains input and negotiates with immediate stakeholders, such as team members, technical managers, project leaders, other Thermal Sciences engineers, product and manufacturing engineers, and supplier partners and delivers information and recommendations to support project decisions, or to provide input related to further analysis, design optimization, feasibility studies, or architecture definition. Makes decisions in the areas of day to day project details, such as conducting analysis, testing, and communication with stakeholders that impact and support the successful progression of projects. Owns problem resolution for moderately complex components, products, systems, subsystems or services with technical complexity and ambiguity increasing as experience is gained in the role. Provides independent execution of established work processes and systems, while still developing technology or product knowledge; engages with the improvement of systems and processes. Involves minimal direct management of people, but could involve the coordination and direction of work amongst technicians and/or temporary student employees. Contributes effectively toward team goals, exhibits influence within a work group and continues to develop proficiency in the competency areas critical to success in the role.

**Competencies:**

Applies Principles of Fluid Dynamics and Heat Transfer - Interprets and predicts the performance of fluid and thermal systems by leveraging a quantitative and intuitive comprehension of the flow of liquids and gases, the transfer of thermal energy between elements of a system, and the application of modeling and experimental tools, to answer key questions about the system or component.

Applies Principles of Thermodynamics and Energy Conversion Systems - Interprets and predicts the performance of energy conversion systems such as IC engines, gas turbines, fuel cells, and batteries, by leveraging a quantitative and intuitive comprehension of thermodynamics, fluid mechanics, modeling tools, controls, and experimental tools to answer key questions about the system or component.

Product Failure Mode Avoidance - Mitigates potential product failure modes, by identifying interfaces, functions, functional requirements, interactions, control factors, noise factors, and prioritized potential failure modes and potential failure causes for the system of interest to effectively and efficiently improve the reliability of Cummins’ products.

Product Function Modeling, Simulation and Analysis - Impacts product design decisions through the utilization and/or interpretation of computational tools and methods that predict the capability of a product's function relative to its system, sub-system and/or component level requirements.

Product Problem Solving - Solves product problems using a process that protects the customer; determines the assignable cause; implements robust, data-based solutions; and identifies the systemic root causes and recommended actions to prevent problem reoccurrence.

System Requirements Engineering - Uses appropriate methods and tools to translate stakeholder needs into verifiable requirements to which designs are developed; establishes acceptance criteria for the system of interest through analysis, allocation and negotiation; tracks the status of requirements throughout the system lifecycle; assesses the impact of changes to system requirements on project scope, schedule, and resources; creates and maintains information linkages to related artifacts.

Systems Thinking - Defines the system of interest by drawing the boundaries, identifying its context within its environment, its interfaces, and that it has a lifecycle to aid in planning the problem statement, scope and deliverables ; analyzes linkages and interactions between elements that comprise the system of interest by using appropriate methods, models and integration of outcomes to understand the system, predict its behavior and devise modifications to it in order to produce the desired effects.

Collaborates - Building partnerships and working collaboratively with others to meet shared objectives.

Communicates effectively - Developing and delivering multi-mode communications that convey a clear understanding of the unique needs of different audiences.

Decision quality - Making good and timely decisions that keep the organization moving forward.

Drives results - Consistently achieving results, even under tough circumstances.

Self-development - Actively seeking new ways to grow and be challenged
