jobs.title: Material Flow Automation Engineer
jobs.description:
**Why Emotiv**

At Emotiv, we don’t just move materials. We accelerate possibility. We are reimagining mobility with advanced warehousing and sequencing solutions trusted by leading automotive OEMs. We are a team of doers, thinkers, and builders who believe operational excellence is achieved through empowered people and a constant drive to improve.

If you’re looking for a company where you can be seen, grow, and help shape the future of supply chain innovation, we’d love to meet you.

**The Role**

We are seeking a strategic, hands-on, and innovative Material Flow Automation Engineer to lead the design, standardization, implementation, and optimization of automated material handling and material flow systems across our manufacturing and warehousing operations, including Manufacturing Support Services (MSS) and Value-Added Assembly (VAA) spaces. This role will transform traditional material handling into safe, scalable, data-driven systems using AMRs, autonomous forklift trucks (AFTs), conveyors, lift-assist equipment, smart storage, fleet management tools, simulation software, digital twin models, and integrated controls.

The ideal candidate is a hands-on, analytical problem solver with experience in high-volume manufacturing, material handling automation, logistics, and continuous improvement. They are passionate about leveraging technology to enhance operational performance, streamline material movement, and support scalable growth

This is a hybrid position based in Kansas City, Louisville, or Detroit. The role reports to the Director of AME & Automation and is part of the Engineering team.

**What You’ll Do**

* Develop automation strategies for receiving, storage, kitting, sequencing, line-side delivery, finished goods, dunnage, and empty-container return.
* Analyze material flow, inventory movement, forklift activity, routes, and replenishment processes to improve safety, quality, productivity, and throughput.
* Develop and maintain material layouts, storage concepts, line-side presentation standards, traffic paths, and end-to-end material flow designs for MSS and VAA operations, balancing safety, space utilization, labor, inventory, throughput, and launch requirements.
* Partner with plant leadership and cross-functional teams to define current-state constraints, validate root causes, and implement practical solutions for material flow, congestion, line-side delivery, storage, quality, productivity, and capacity challenges.
* Specify and integrate AMRs, AGVs, conveyors, automated storage, lift equipment, scanners, sensors, controls, and fleet-management systems.
* Lead the selection, supplier assessment, proof-of-concept testing, factory and site acceptance testing, validation, and deployment of AMRs, AFTs, tuggers, autonomous forklifts, and other MHE solutions.
* Define equipment and system acceptance criteria covering payload and load stability, acceleration/deceleration, turning radius and aisle requirements, docking accuracy, stopping distance, dynamic obstacle avoidance, charging, availability, fleet sizing, traffic management, and production-rate capability.
* Lead automation projects from concept and sourcing through installation, commissioning, validation, training, handoff, and ramp-up.
* Design material-delivery standards covering storage, line-side presentation, traffic flow, docking, charging, payload transfer, and facility interfaces.
* Use layouts, time studies, labor analysis, simulation, and digital twins to validate concepts, size equipment, and reduce implementation risk.
* Develop, validate, and maintain digital twin and discrete-event simulation models to evaluate capacity, throughput, route congestion, storage utilization, labor, equipment utilization, fleet mix, delivery cycles, bottlenecks, and future-state scenarios before physical implementation.
* Translate operational data and simulation outputs into scenario comparisons, sensitivity analyses, capital requests, total-cost-of-ownership evaluations, ROI/payback cases, and clear recommendations for plant and executive decisions.
* Integrate material automation with WMS, ERP, MES/FMS, inventory transactions, production signals, traceability, and dispatch systems.
* Support Industry 4.0 integration by defining data, controls, software, and interface requirements across WMS, ERP, MES/FMS, PLCs, fleet-management systems, sensors, RTLS/IoT devices, APIs, and production signals, with attention to traceability, cybersecurity, data ownership, and maintainability.
* Support quoting, launches, expansions, and engineering changes by defining equipment, labor, space, capital, assumptions, milestones, and risks.
* Develop technical requirements, scopes of work, compliance matrices, responsibility matrices, test plans, and RFQ/RFI packages for turnkey/end-to-end integrators, integration partners, and equipment OEMs; lead technical bid reviews, supplier clarifications, assumption/risk closure, and sourcing recommendations.
* Evaluate RFQ responses for technical compliance, functional safety, VDA 5050 or comparable mixed-fleet interoperability, controls architecture, fleet and charging concepts, software licensing, lifecycle support, spare parts, service coverage, lead time, implementation risk, scalability, warranty, recurring fees, and total cost of ownership.
* Coordinate end-to-end delivery from concept and supplier selection through design, controls and equipment interfaces, installation, commissioning, training, ramp-up, handoff, and post-launch performance verification, while clearly defining owner-furnished equipment and supplier responsibilities.
* Establish standards for fleet management, mapping, traffic control, charging, safety, machine interfaces, and interoperability.
* Reduce forklift use, unnecessary movement, inventory handling, ergonomic risk, shortages, downtime, and floor-space requirements.
* Maintain layouts, process flows, specifications, automation standards, launch checklists, and lessons learne

jobs.title: Technical Programme Manager, Electrical Engineering
jobs.description:
**About IonQ:**

  

IonQ, Inc. [NYSE: IONQ] is the world's leading quantum platform and merchant supplier - delivering integrated quantum solutions across computing, networking, sensing, and security. IonQ's newest generation of quantum computers, the IonQ Tempo, is the latest in a line of cutting-edge systems that have been helping customers and partners including Amazon Web Services, and AstraZeneca achieve 20x performance results and accelerate innovation in drug discovery, materials science, financial modeling, logistics, cybersecurity, and defense. In 2025, the company achieved 99.99% two-qubit gate fidelity, setting a world record in quantum computing performance.  
  
Headquartered in College Park, Maryland, IonQ has operations in California, Colorado, Massachusetts, Tennessee, Washington, Italy, South Korea, Sweden, Switzerland, Canada, and the United Kingdom. Our quantum computing services are available through all major cloud providers, while we also meet the needs of networking and sensing customers across land, sea, air, and space. IonQ is making quantum platforms more accessible and impactful than ever before.

**Role Overview**
-----------------

**Role:**
---------

IonQ is building quantum computers that change which problems the world can solve. Our Control Electronics team creates every custom electronic device inside an IonQ system, taking the hardware, gateware, firmware and test behind the precision control boards around the ion trap from development through to production.

As Technical Programme Manager for Electrical Engineering, you will drive the team's workstreams, working directly with the programme lead TPM in our Programme Management Office. You will sit at the centre of a cross-functional group of engineers and physicists, turning complex technical work into clear plans, measurable milestones and predictable delivery for our quantum computing roadmap. This is a hands-on role that takes real weight off our design engineers, so they can stay focused on design and the bench.

**Responsibilities:**
---------------------

You will create and run the operating rhythm that keeps teams aligned and leaders informed: building development plans and an integrated schedule, tracking dependencies and surfacing risk early. You do not need to be the designer, but you need to be technical enough not to be fooled. When an estimate looks too long or a fix is always two days away, you will know which questions to ask, bring in the right architect or physicist, and turn the answer into a realistic plan with the right number of steps.

Much of the help the team needs sits between functions. You will be the link between design engineering, procurement, materials management, supply chain, NPI and production, organising orders, parts and boards so that engineers handle the technical questions and the logistics are handled for them. When a component has a long lead time, you will understand its key characteristics well enough to help find an alternative. You will also keep embedded software, systems architecture and physics requirements in step with the electronics plan, represent the team's progress in programme meetings so that leads do not have to attend every one, and travel up to 20% of the time to partner sites as needed.

**Key responsibilities include:**
---------------------------------

* Drive the control electronics workstreams across hardware, gateware, firmware and test, owning schedule, resources, dependencies and stakeholder alignment
* Build and maintain a realistic integrated schedule, challenging estimates and surfacing technical and schedule risk early
* Coordinate orders, parts and boards with procurement, materials management and suppliers, and help resolve long lead and obsolete component issues
* Drive cross-functional execution with physics, systems, embedded software, NPI and production teams, taking issues to closure with clear mitigation plans
* Establish programme cadences and executive reporting, including dashboards, status updates and decision logs

**Requirements:**
-----------------

We are looking for a technically fluent programme manager with genuine hardware programme experience, who brings structure, pace and precision to complex electronics work. You will have run, or worked closely inside, the full hardware lifecycle, including firmware and lower level test, from requirements and design through fabrication, bring-up and revision into production. You will have enough exposure to firmware or RTL work to judge whether an estimate is realistic, even if you have not written that code yourself.

You will bring a degree in electrical engineering or a related technical field, and an advanced degree is a plus. You will be comfortable working day to day with physicists and engineers, building trust quickly, and translating progress, risks and trade-offs into clear, decision-ready reporting for senior stakeholders. You thrive in ambiguity, can spot inconsistencies in messy data, and enjoy both sides of the job: getting into the detail of procurement and tracking, and knowing when to take a technical discussion offline with the right people.

**You'd be a great fit with:**
------------------------------

* Experience as a technical programme manager delivering complex electronics hardware programmes from development into production
* A degree in electrical engineering or a related technical field
* Working knowledge of firmware, gateware or RTL development and lower level hardware test
* Hands-on experience managing procurement, component sourcing and supplier issues for prototype or low-volume builds
* Fluency with modern programme tools such as Jira, Confluence, Smartsheet and GitHub

The total compensation package includes base salary, bonus, equity, and a range of benefits available on our career site.

Compensation will vary based on individual factors such as education, qualifications, and experience of the final candidate(s), specific office locat

jobs.title: Communications Systems Engineer
jobs.description:
**Description**

Would you be excited to build communications/networking architectures across hardware/firmware/software boundaries?

Are you interested in trying novel, creative, and risky approaches for communications systems to solve and overcome mission critical challenges?

Would you enjoy rapid prototyping of ideas on both novel and deployed RF hardware/systems?

If so, we’re looking for someone like you to join our team at APL!

The Networked Systems and Integrated Fires group is seeking a Communications Systems Engineer to contribute to communications system design, implementation, hardware test/evaluation, firmware, real-time embedded software, and more. As part of our team, you will make critical contributions to both new and legacy communications systems and work on a variety of projects in a fast-paced team environment.

**As a Communications Systems Engineer, you will:**

* Work with multi-disciplinary teams in designing, implementing, and analyzing systems/algorithms for future resilient, secure, and adaptive communications networks operating in highly contested environments
* Develop FPGA firmware (VHDL) from concept through implementation, evaluation, and deployment
* Contribute to MATLAB modeling and simulation
* Validate and analyze performance of prototypes and tactical systems against complex operational scenarios
* Work as part of a team to design novel solutions and approaches for size/weight/power/cost (SWaP-C) constrained communications concepts
* Provide status updates, analysis results, and algorithms in written reports and in presentations to internal APL staff, program contractors, and government sponsors
* Support occasional field tests for hardware testing

  
**Qualifications**

**You meet our minimum qualifications for the job if you…**

* Have a BS degree in Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or related discipline
* Have 3+ years of experience in FPGA/firmware development in VHDL or Verilog
* Have demonstrated ability to work both independently and as part of a multi-disciplinary team
* Can effectively communicate ideas and results
* Have professional experience in at least **one** of the following:
* Implementing digital signal processing (DSP) algorithms on FPGA
* C/C++ embedded programming on FPGA System-on-Chip (SoC) devices
* RF systems link analysis or communications algorithm modeling/simulation in Python or MATLAB
* Strong knowledge of RF (Radio Frequency) hardware design/test principles, with hands-on experience using test equipment
* Are able to obtain an Interim Secret security clearance by your start date and can ultimately obtain a Secret security clearance. If selected, you will be subject to a government security clearance investigation and must meet the requirements for access to classified information. Eligibility requirements include U.S. citizenship.

**You’ll go above and beyond our minimum requirements if you…**

* Have a MS degree in Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or related discipline
* Have experience implementing advanced concepts on FPGA such as adaptive filtering techniques, error correction codes, etc.
* Have hands-on experience implementing high speed ADC/DAC interfaces on FPGA
* Have experience with current military links (e.g. CDL, Link 16 / MIDS)
* Have an active Top Secret security clearance

  
  
**About Us**

**Why Work at APL?**

The Johns Hopkins University Applied Physics Laboratory (APL) brings world-class expertise to our nation’s most critical defense, security, space and science challenges. While we are dedicated to solving complex challenges and pioneering new technologies, what makes us truly outstanding is our culture. We offer a vibrant, welcoming atmosphere where you can bring your authentic self to work, continue to grow, and build strong connections with inspiring teammates.

At APL, we celebrate our differences of perspectives and encourage creativity and bold, new ideas. Our employees enjoy generous benefits, including a robust education assistance program, unparalleled retirement contributions, and a healthy work/life balance. APL’s campus is located in the Baltimore-Washington metro area. Learn more about our career opportunities at https://www.jhuapl.edu/careers.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, creed, color, religion, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, age, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, occupation, marital or familial status, political opinion, personal appearance, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. APL is committed to providing reasonable accommodation to individuals of all abilities, including those with disabilities. If you require a reasonable accommodation to participate in any part of the hiring process, please contact Accessibility@jhuapl.edu.

The referenced pay range is based on JHU APL’s good faith belief at the time of posting. Actual compensation may vary based on factors such as geographic location, work experience, market conditions, education/training and skill level with consideration for internal parity. For salaried employees scheduled to work less than 40 hours per week, annual salary will be prorated based on the number of hours worked. APL may offer bonuses or other forms of compensation per internal policy and/or contractual designation. Additional compensation may be provided in the form of a sign-on bonus, relocation benefits, locality allowance or discretionary payments for exceptional performance. APL provides eligible staff with a comprehensive benefits package including retirement plans, paid time off, medical, dental, vision, life insurance, short-term disability, long-term disability, flexible spending accounts, education assistance, and training and development. Applications are accepted on a rolling basis.

  
  
**Minimum Rate**  
  
$100,000 Annually

**Description**
---------------

At Northrop Grumman, our employees have incredible opportunities to work on revolutionary systems that impact people's lives around the world today, and for generations to come. Our pioneering and inventive spirit has enabled us to be at the forefront of many technological advancements in our nation's history - from the first flight across the Atlantic Ocean, to stealth bombers, to landing on the moon. We look for people who have bold new ideas, courage and a pioneering spirit to join forces to invent the future, and have fun along the way. Our culture thrives on intellectual curiosity, cognitive diversity and bringing your whole self to work — and we have an insatiable drive to do what others think is impossible. Our employees are not only part of history, they're making history.

At the heart of Defining Possible is our commitment to missions. In rapidly changing global security environments, Northrop Grumman brings informed insights and software-secure technology to enable strategic planning. We’re looking for innovators who can help us keep building on our wide portfolio of secure, affordable, integrated, and multi-domain systems and technologies that fuel those missions. By joining in our shared mission, we’ll support yours of expanding your personal network and developing skills, whether you are new to the field, or an industry thought leader. At Northrop Grumman, you’ll have the resources, support, and team to do some of the best work of your career.

We are seeking a Senior Principal Systems Engineer (T04) to support development of Electronic Warfare (EW) systems for airborne sensor platforms. This position is 100% onsite and focuses on system design, integration, and test of complex EW capabilities. The selected candidate will work closely with Integrated Product Team (IPT) leads across Hardware (HW), Software (SW), Firmware (FW), Integration & Test (I&T), and Program Management to help define, develop, integrate, and verify mission-effective EW solutions.

**This position requires up to 100% on-site**

* Support troubleshooting and root-cause analysis of system issues identified during integration and test, coordinating with cross-functional team members to implement solutions.
* Prepare and present technical material for internal and customer technical reviews (e.g., SRR, PDR, CDR, TRR) and technical interchange meetings.
* Contribute to risk identification, mitigation planning, and updates to the technical baseline for the EW system.
* Provide technical guidance and mentoring to junior and mid-level engineers as appropriate.

**This position is contingent upon the successful transfer of an active U.S Government Secret Clearance and the ability to obtain Special Program Access prior to start.**

**Basic Qualifications:**

  

* Bachelor’s degree with 8 years of experience, master's degree with 6 years of experience or Ph.D. with 4 year of experience in Science, Technology, Engineering, Mathematics, or related technical fields; an additional 4 years of experience may be considered in lieu of a degree.
* U.S Citizenship is required.
* A current/active U.S. Government Secret Clearance
* Ability to obtain Special Program Access (SAP) prior to start
* Experience in systems engineering, integration and test, and/or system design for complex aerospace or defense systems.
* Experience with airborne sensors, RF systems, and/or Electronic Warfare concepts (e.g., threat detection, jamming, countermeasures).
* Experience working within multi-disciplinary IPTs (HW, SW, FW, I&T, Program Management).

**Preferred Qualifications:**

  

* Direct experience with EW systems, such as radar warning receivers, electronic support measures, electronic attack, or airborne EW payloads.
* Experience with digital signal processing (DSP) for EW or RF sensors applications (e.g., detection, filtering, pulse/feature extraction, beamforming).
* Experience with analog RF hardware for EW sensor applications, including RF front end design, filtering, amplification, impedance matching, and component level troubleshooting across relevant frequency bands.
* Experience with requirements management tools (e.g., DOORS, Jama) and model-based systems engineering (MBSE) methods and tools.
* Background in system integration, verification and validation, and test execution for flight or mission systems.
* Proficiency with data analysis tools (e.g., MATLAB, Python) for EW, RF, or sensor performance assessment.
* Experience participating in technical reviews and contributing to proposal or capture activities for EW or sensor programs.
* Experience prioritizing and managing tasks while supporting multiple concurrent efforts

jobs.title: Mission Software Engineer
jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century's most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril's family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

**About the Team**
------------------

The Imaging team builds and fields state-of-the-art camera and sensor systems deployed to solve real security challenges for the United States and its allies. We work across the full stack, from bare-metal hardware and firmware to networked services and cloud integrations, and we own our systems all the way through to the field. When something breaks in a deployed environment, we fix it.

**About the Role**
------------------

We're looking for a Mission Software Engineer to join the Imaging Interfaces team. This is not a pure product development role. You will spend meaningful time keeping fielded systems alive, triaging issues across the full stack, and serving as a technical representative for our products in integrations with external teams and customers.  
  
The work is varied and sometimes ambiguous. You might spend a morning extending a gRPC service, an afternoon diagnosing a time sync issue on a deployed device over the phone with a field operator, and a week traveling to support a customer integration. You'll need to be comfortable with that range-and ideally energized by it.  
  
If you want to own your software end-to-end in a fast-moving environment where the stakes are real, this role is built for you.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

**Own fielded system success.** You are responsible for the health and uptime of deployed imaging systems. When issues arise-whether the root cause is in your code, the firmware, the network, or the hardware-you triage, diagnose, and drive resolution.  
  
**Build and maintain production services.** You'll develop and extend modular software services that run on edge-compute devices in austere environments. These services need to be reliable, observable, and maintainable by engineers who didn't write them.  
  
**Support field operations.** You'll work directly with field operators and non-technical users to diagnose and resolve issues on deployed hardware. Clear communication under pressure is part of the job.  
  
**Represent the team externally.** You'll serve as a subject matter expert in integrations with other products and teams; sometimes remotely, sometimes on-site. You don't need to know everything, but you need to be able to speak credibly across the full system stack and know what you don't know.  
  
**Maintain end-to-end system understanding.** Our devices sit at the intersection of hardware, firmware, networking, and software. You'll develop broad fluency across that stack over time, and apply it to optimize how our services interact and degrade gracefully when components fail.  
  
**Collaborate across teams.** You'll plan, build, and test complex functionality alongside firmware, hardware, and platform engineers. You'll need to be effective working across team and organizational boundaries.  
  
Travel expected approximately 25% of the time for field testing and customer integrations.

**What We're Looking For**
--------------------------

**Required**
------------

* **2+ years of software development with meaningful production ownership:** not just shipping features, but owning systems after they ship (their health, uptime, and behavior once they are in users' hands).
* **Deep proficiency in at least one of C++, TypeScript(node.js/React), or Python, and the ability to work effectively across the stack boundary in a second language** (reading, debugging, and modifying code outside your primary). Our work spans a large TypeScript/React operator-facing UI and a growing body of C++ services running on edge hardware, and C++ depth is increasingly central as we expand across our imaging product lines.
* **Comfort ramping quickly into unfamiliar languages, tools, and deployment systems.** Our language and tooling mix varies by product and shifts over time; we value engineers who get productive in a new stack rather than staying in one lane.
* **2+ years working in Linux-based environments,** including hands-on work with bare-metal hardware.
* **Demonstrated ability to diagnose and resolve issues across system boundaries** (networking, services, hardware interaction) without always having full visibility into every component.
* **Strong written and verbal communication skills,** including the ability to explain technical problems clearly to non-technical audiences, including operators in the field.
* **Eligibility to obtain and maintain a U.S. Secret clearance.**

**Preferred**
-------------

* Strength with performance-sensitive, real-time, or resource-constrained systems (edge or embedded).
* Experience with gRPC or similar RPC frameworks.
* Familiarity with systemd service management and observability practices on Linux.
* Familiarity with Nix or NixOS: uncommon, but genuinely valuable, and something you will use daily on our stack.
* Experience supporting fielded or deployed systems, not just development environments.
* Experience with imaging, EO/IR, ISR, or command-and-control (C2) systems.

**What Makes Someone Successful Here**
--------------------------------------

The engineers who thrive in this role share a few traits that don't always show up on a resume:  
  
They close loops. When they pick up a problem they own it until it's resolved, not until it's someone els

Luxshare Technology, a subsidiary of Luxshare Precision, is a leading provider of communication infrastructure and enterprise-class interconnect products. We are a global designer and manufacturer of 5G communication equipment and enterprise-level interconnect solutions, including base station antennas, filters, RRUs, connectors, cables, optical modules, and AOC products. jobs.description:
**Job Overview**

NSG Life Safety is seeking a Systems Engineer who will be responsible for the design, engineering, estimating support, and preparation of technical submittals for Fire Alarm and Electronic Security systems. This position requires proficiency in both disciplines, with the ability to develop accurate, code-compliant, and complete engineering packages for commercial, institutional, and public construction projects.

The Systems Engineer will work closely with Project Managers, Estimators, Field Technicians, and other members of the Engineering Department to ensure projects are properly designed, coordinated, and executed.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Engineering & System Design**

* Prepare complete Fire Alarm and Electronic Security submittal packages, including engineered drawings, equipment data sheets, calculations, and technical narratives.
* Develop Fire Alarm system designs in accordance with applicable NFPA codes, Massachusetts regulations, project specifications, and manufacturer requirements.
* Perform Fire Alarm notification appliance circuit (NAC), voltage drop, battery standby, and power supply calculations.
* Prepare Electronic Security system designs, including Access Control, Video Surveillance, Intrusion Detection, and Intercom systems.
* Develop device layouts, riser diagrams, wiring details, equipment schedules, and system architecture drawings utilizing AutoCAD.
* Review project drawings, specifications, and contract documents to ensure designs meet project requirements.
* Coordinate with manufacturers and vendors to verify equipment compatibility and system functionality.

**Project Submittals & Coordination**

* Independently prepare, review, and submit complete Fire Alarm and Security submittal packages for approval.
* Review consultant comments and revise engineering documents as necessary.
* Coordinate with Project Managers and Field Technicians to resolve design conflicts and installation challenges.
* Participate in project coordination meetings as needed.
* Assist with the preparation of as-built drawings, closeout documentation, and final project deliverables.
* Ensure engineering documents are accurate, organized, and submitted within established project schedules.

**Estimating & Technical Support**

* Review project documents and assist with material takeoffs, equipment selections, and estimates for new projects and change orders.
* Provide technical support to the Estimating and Project Management departments.
* Review proposed system designs for constructability, cost efficiency, and compliance with project requirements.
* Maintain familiarity with manufacturer pricing, product availability, and technical specifications.
* Assist with identifying value-engineering opportunities and alternative equipment solutions.

**Technical Development & Process Improvement**

* Develop and maintain proficiency with NSG's Fire Alarm and Electronic Security product offerings.
* Maintain familiarity with applicable NFPA codes, industry standards, and emerging technologies.
* Develop technical knowledge of Rauland and Valcom intercommunication systems.
* Maintain and organize NSG's engineering standards, technical documentation, and product library.
* Identify and implement improvements to engineering workflows, drawing templates, submittal procedures, and internal resources.
* Collaborate with Engineering leadership to improve department efficiency, consistency, and overall quality.
* Pursue and maintain applicable NICET certifications and manufacturer training.

**Qualifications & Expectations**

* Experience with Fire Alarm and/or Electronic Security system design, engineering, or project coordination.
* Proficiency in AutoCAD and the preparation of technical drawings.
* Working knowledge of Fire Alarm codes, including NFPA 72 and applicable Massachusetts requirements.
* Understanding of Electronic Security system components, configurations, and installation practices.
* Ability to interpret construction drawings, specifications, and technical documentation.
* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
* Ability to manage multiple engineering assignments and meet project deadlines.
* Strong communication skills and the ability to coordinate across departments.
* NICET Fire Alarm Systems certification preferred, with continued certification advancement encouraged.

jobs.description:
**Company Overview**

Flowserve is the recognized world leader in supplying pumps, valves, seals, automation, and services to the power, oil, gas, chemical, and other industries. With more than 16,000 employees in more than 50 countries, we combine our global reach with a local presence. We are seeking a highly skilled and motivated Mechatronics Engineer to join our dynamic team and contribute to our mission to create extraordinary flow control solutions to make the world better for everyone.

**Role Summary**

As a Principal Mechatronics Engineer, you will join our global Innovation team focused on rapidly bringing new products to market. Based in Budapest, you will work with global project teams, providing expertise in mechatronic system design, systems architecture development, firmware development, signal processing, controller programming, and system cybersecurity. Your role will encompass research, ideation, proof of concept, and proof of value demonstrations, paving the way for new product development and integrated solutions. Collaborating closely with internal technical teams, engineering units, and the product management team, you will align innovation priorities and drive the development of advanced mechatronics technologies.

**Responsibilities**

  

* Provide technical leadership on complex projects involving mechatronics and digital solutions, applying engineering principles to devise innovative solutions.
* Lead concept development projects by: Generating innovative product or solution concepts using systematic problem-solving and design thinking. - Recommending buy / build / partner approaches for competitive product commercialization.
* Collaborate with technical specialists and engineering leaders to develop proofs of concept and partner with the product management team for proof-of-value demonstrations.
* Coordinate and develop global mechatronics platform architectures, leveraging synergies between product platforms to create a unified technology platform for all products.
* Drive the development of mechatronics technologies, focusing on:
* Digital solutions and modern drive technologies for intelligent fluid and vacuum pump systems.
* Digital solutions for competitive actuator products.
* Modern electronics technologies for pneumatic-driven positioner electronics.
* Guide external technical teams contracted to support development of key enabling components/features outside Flowserve’s scope of expertise
* Collaborate with the technology scouting team to monitor industry trends, maintain networks with partners, and explore potential technology collaborations.
* Propose investment plans to build mechatronics platform capabilities.
* Partner with the strategic business management team to:
* Develop detailed project charters and execution plans.
* Support voice-of-customer activities and evaluate business potential.
* Develop and maintain an international network with Flowserve teams and external partners, defining and evaluating global buy-build-partner opportunities.
* Participate in regular reviews with business and technology leaders, providing updates on the innovation funnel.
* Travel up to 20% as required, primarily to the United States, Germany, and the Netherlands.

**Required Qualifications and Experience**

  

* Bachelor’s degree in Mechatronics, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related discipline, with at least 10 years of experience in technology development, innovation, or advanced product development.
* Cross-disciplinary mechatronics expertise; Strong practical understanding of hardware, software, and mechanical engineering, including how these disciplines integrate within complex mechatronic products and systems.
* Electrical and system architecture development; Demonstrated experience developing system and electrical component architectures, including embedded hardware/software integration and the definition of scalable mechatronics platforms.
* Controls and product-development capability; Solid understanding of control strategies and controller technologies, including PLCs and microcontrollers, with experience applying these capabilities to the development and commercialization of new products or solutions.

**Preferred Qualifications and Experience**

  

* Excellent systems-level understanding across relevant technical disciplines, including electronics, mechanics, physics, and user interfaces.
* Demonstrated success developing and commercializing new products or solutions that incorporate differentiating technologies.
* Experience in research and innovation; familiarity with design-thinking methods is preferred.
* Strong communication, collaboration, and teamwork skills, with the ability to work effectively across functions in a multinational environment.
* Professional English proficiency.
* Demonstrated expertise in: Hardware platform architecture; Modern software and data-modeling architecture concepts; Product development involving modern motors, drives, and power-electronics technologies; Embedded hardware and software integration; Low-power measurement-electronics development; Simulation-based development; Modern drive-control and process-control theories.
* Experience with concept generation and technology commercialization strategies.
* Strong industry network and the ability to identify, assess, and develop global technology partnerships.
* Ability to conduct comprehensive evaluations of the technical and market potential of new products and technologies.

* Familiarity with strategic business management, including voice-of-customer activities.
* Experience facilitating collaboration between technical and business functions.

jobs.title: Electrical Engineer

**About Voltava:**  
At Voltava, people power everything we do. We are a premier global manufacturing and assembly partner formed through the combination of Detroit Manufacturing Systems, Android Industries, and Avancez with approximately 5,400 Team Members across 21 facilities worldwide. Our vibrant, collaborative, and people-focused culture is the foundation for everything we deliver, from complex module assembly and sequencing to contract manufacturing, supply chain, automation, and tooling and equipment design for OEM customers across the automotive, industrial, e-mobility, heavy truck, defense, and technology sectors. Kinetyc, our scalable contract manufacturing arm based in Wixom, Michigan, expands our capabilities and capacity to support customers across a range of industries. Together, we are Building A Better Everything.
  
  
**About the Role:**  
Join our engineering team as an Electrical Engineer and help turn innovative ideas into reliable, production-ready products. In this hands-on role, you’ll design, integrate, test, and continuously improve electrical systems while partnering closely with mechanical, manufacturing, controls, and cross-functional teams.
  
You’ll have the opportunity to work from concept and prototype through production, solving real-world engineering challenges along the way. From designing electrical systems and building prototypes to troubleshooting issues on the production floor, your work will directly impact product performance, quality, reliability, and manufacturability.
  
If you’re a curious, hands-on problem solver who enjoys taking on complex challenges, working with emerging technology, and seeing your designs come to life, this is an opportunity to make a tangible impact.
  
  
**What You Will Do:**  

* Design, develop, and review electrical schematics, wiring diagrams, cable assemblies, and system interfaces.
* Select electrical components based on performance, availability, reliability, and cost.
* Develop and maintain electrical Bills of Materials (BOMs) and engineering documentation.
* Build, test, and troubleshoot prototypes, assemblies, and production equipment.
* Develop electrical test procedures, acceptance criteria, and production test equipment.
* Diagnose electrical failures, perform root cause analysis, and implement corrective actions.
* Support manufacturing teams with technical guidance, troubleshooting, and clear work instructions.
* Identify and implement design improvements that enhance reliability, quality, and manufacturability.
* Collaborate with mechanical, manufacturing, controls, and other engineering teams to integrate power, controls, sensors, communications, and embedded systems.
* Participate in design reviews, product revisions, and engineering change activities.
* Support the transition of designs from development into repeatable, production-ready processes.

**What You Need To Be Successful:**  

* Experience designing, integrating, testing, or troubleshooting electrical systems.
* Ability to read, create, and interpret electrical schematics, wiring diagrams, and technical documentation.
* Experience selecting electrical components and documenting engineering designs.
* Strong hands-on troubleshooting skills using tools such as multimeters, oscilloscopes, power supplies, and other laboratory equipment.
* Strong problem-solving and root cause analysis skills.
* Ability to communicate technical information clearly and collaborate effectively across engineering and manufacturing teams.
* Ability to work safely and effectively in both engineering and manufacturing environments.

**Bonus Points If You Have:**  

* Experience designing or integrating electrical systems for drones, robotics, automated equipment, or other electromechanical products.
* Experience with PCB design, embedded systems, battery systems, motors, or motor controllers.
* Experience developing manufacturing tests, production test equipment, or automated testing systems.
* Experience with design for manufacturability (DFM) and transitioning products from development into production.
* Experience with electrical CAD tools and engineering documentation systems.
* Experience troubleshooting electrical systems in a production or high-volume manufacturing environment.

**Education:**  

* Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

**Travel:**  

* None

**What We Offer:**  
We believe our team members are our greatest investment, which is why we offer a competitive total rewards package designed to support you at every stage of your career and life. Our benefits may include comprehensive health, dental, and vision coverage, retirement savings programs with employer contributions, tuition reimbursement, paid time off and holidays, employee assistance resources, and additional wellness programs and benefits designed to support your health, financial well-being, professional growth, and overall quality of life.
  
  
**Our Core Values:**

This role requires a hands-on engineer capable of independently troubleshooting complex automation systems in a fast-paced manufacturing environment. This role ensures production equipment operates safely, reliably, and efficiently while supporting continuous improvement, new equipment integration, and plant automation initiatives.

The Controls Engineer collaborates with manufacturing engineering, equipment vendors, quality, EHS, and operations teams to implement robust automation solutions that improve throughput, quality, and uptime.

**Automation & Controls Development**

* Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering or a related engineering discipline.

* Experience creating and maintaining electrical schematics and wiring diagrams.
* Experience with PCB assemblies, cable design, and wire harnesses.

jobs.title: Lead Platform Engineer, Agentic Issue Resolution (AIR)
jobs.description:
**Overview**
------------

At Ford, you’ll work on ideas that matter, alongside passionate people who want to make a global impact. Together, we’re shaping the next era of transportation—grounded in purpose, driven by progress. Make your move.

* Job Type: Full time
* Work Type: Hybrid

  

We made history and now we work to transform the future – for our customers, our communities and our families. You'll see your work on the road every day, helping people move freely and pursue their dreams. At Ford, you can build more than vehicles. Come build what matters.

  

Shape the Future of Manufacturing with **ATP**

At Ford, we aren’t just building vehicles — we are redefining how the world moves. Within the Advanced Industrial Technology and Platforms (ATP) organization, we are the architects of Ford’s next industrial revolution.

Our mission is clear: we build and scale industrial platforms, technologies, and capabilities that unlock Ford Firsts to drive sustained competitive advantage in manufacturing. Driven by our vision to "build once, scale everywhere," we bridge the gap between cutting-edge technology and global physical deployment.

Our guiding mantra is simple yet relentless: Scale what matters, win what's next.

If you are a high-tech builder, thinker, or innovator who thrives at the intersection of software, hardware, and massive scale, ATP is where you belong. Join us, and write the next chapter of industrial history.

**In this position...**

Plant teams lose hours each shift piecing together what went wrong: pulling data from separate systems, chasing history, and rebuilding context before they can fix anything. That groundwork is the job of AIR (Agentic Issue Resolution), ATP's AI system that helps plant teams investigate and fix production issues. AI agents take an issue, gather approved evidence from plant systems, connect it to what the plant already knows, and recommend a fix that a person reviews and approves. Each confirmed fix is saved so the next plant can reuse it.

**Why it's important...**

* AIR runs multiple investigation workflows on shared, reusable components.

* Investigations use authorized evidence and produce traceable recommendations a person can review.

* Plant teams spend less time rebuilding issue history and more time fixing problems.

* A fix confirmed at one plant is reused at the next without rework.

* The platform meets agreed security, reliability, and production-readiness standards.

**What you'll do...**

**Design the AIR Platform**

* Define the architecture across user experience, workflow orchestration, agents, tools, knowledge, evaluation, and feedback.

* Build reusable components for issue intake, investigation planning, evidence retrieval, analysis, recommendations, and follow-up.

* Set how agents call tools and plant systems through approved, permissioned interfaces.

**Make Every Investigation Evidence-First**

* Retrieve authorized sources before drawing conclusions, separate evidence from inference, and show the source behind every claim.

* Work with plant experts to turn how they solve problems into modular, measurable workflows.

* Capture each validated fix as a reusable record the next plant can apply.

**Build It to Run in a Plant**

* Define APIs and data contracts with CoreMesh (our manufacturing knowledge graph), FPS+ (the digital version of the Ford Production System), and InZone (the mobile app supervisors use to run a shift).

* Build in identity, permissions, audit logging, human approval steps, and clear escalation when the system is unsure.

Set standards for testing, versioning, release, rollback, monitoring, and production support.

**Lead the Engineering**

* Lead the AI agent and evaluation engineers on the AIR team, run design reviews, and coach the data scientists building agents.

* Partner with MLOps and evaluation engineers to measure agent behavior before release and monitor it after.

**You'll have...**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience.

* 7+ years building production software platforms or distributed systems, including technical leadership.

* Hands-on experience building applications on large language models: agent workflows, orchestration, retrieval, and tool integration.

* Strong API and service design, testing, and maintainable code in Python, TypeScript, Go, or Java.

* Experience designing secure systems with authorization, audit logging, and operational controls.

* Clear communication with engineering, data, security, and plant teams.

**Even better, you may have...**

* Manufacturing, quality, maintenance, or industrial operations experience.

* Knowledge graphs, ontologies, semantic search, or case-based reasoning.

* Event-driven systems, workflow engines, and production observability.

* Human-in-the-loop design for operational decisions.

* Google Cloud Platform experience.

You may not check every box, or your experience may look a little different from what we've outlined, but if you think you can bring value to Ford Motor Company, we encourage you to apply!
  
  
As an established global company, we offer the benefit of choice. You can choose what your Ford future will look like: will your story span the globe, or keep you close to home? Will your career be a deep dive into what you love, or a series of new teams and new skills? Will you be a leader, a changemaker, a technical expert, a culture builder…or all of the above? No matter what you choose, we offer a work life that works for you, including:
  

* Immediate medical, dental, vision, and prescription drug coverage
* Paid parental leave, new parent ramp-up programs, subsidized back-up child care and more
* Family building benefits including adoption and surrogacy expense reimbursement, fertility treatments and more
* Vehicle discount program for employees and family members and management leases
* Tuition assistance
* Established and active employee resourc

jobs.title: Principal Electrical Engineer
jobs.description:
**Nordson Electronics Solutions, a global leader in assembly and advanced packaging stage solutions,** is seeking an experienced and highly motivated individual to join our team. We are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace, and we are looking for candidates who share that same commitment.

**Summary of the role**

As a member of our team, you will have the opportunity to work in a dynamic and collaborative environment, where your ideas and contributions will be valued and respected.

**Role:** Principal Electrical Engineer

**Location:** Golden Valley, MN

**Division:** OSM

**Department:** Engineering, Electrical Team

**Position Summary**

The Optical Sensors and Metrology (OSM) group within Nordon’s Advanced Technology Solutions division is a world leader in 2D and 3D sensing solutions for challenging electronics and semiconductor manufacturing applications. Chances are the device you are using right now contains components that were inspected using Nordson technology.

  

Our engineers collaborate across optical, electrical, mechanical, algorithm and software disciplines to develop industry-leading sensing and metrology solutions that help customers improve yield, quality, and manufacturing performance.

  

We are seeking a Principal Electrical Engineer to provide technical leadership in the development of next-generation inspection and metrology sensors. In this role, you will help define system architectures, solve complex technical challenges, and guide products from concept through production.

  

Success in this role requires strong collaboration across optical, mechanical, software, and algorithm teams to optimize complete sensing systems rather than individual components. You will work closely with multidisciplinary teams to transform innovative ideas into high-performance products that deliver measurable customer value.

  

This is an individual contributor role with significant technical leadership, cross-functional influence, and mentoring responsibilities.

**Essential Job Duties and Responsibilities**

* Lead electrical architecture decisions and trade studies balancing performance, reliability, manufacturability, cost, and schedule.
* Collaborate with optical, mechanical, software, and algorithm teams to develop integrated sensing solutions.
* Design electronic circuits for products that sense physical phenomenon such as capacitance, temperature, humidity, light, vibration, inclination, gases, particles, resistivity, and more.
* Solve challenging technical problems through innovative design, simulation, prototype development, and feasibility studies.
* Interpret internal and customer requirements and translate those into product specifications and design concepts.
* Supervise PCB layouts that package electronics into challenging spaces and environments (temperature and vacuum) that often require high performance materials.
* Perform verification testing of designs to confirm compliance to product specifications.
* Design products that comply with CE and other applicable international regulatory requirements.
* Provide technical leadership and mentorship across multiple development programs and engineering disciplines.
Identify technical risks early and drive mitigation strategies throughout the product lifecycle.  

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering or related discipline; Master's degree preferred.
* 10+ years of product development experience in electrical engineering, sensing systems, instrumentation, embedded electronics, or related technologies.
* Demonstrated success leading complex projects, and influencing engineering direction across multidisciplinary teams.
* Experience developing products from concept through production release.
Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to analyze complex technical issues and develop practical solutions.  

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience designing high-performance analog, mixed-signal, or data acquisition systems.
* Experience with embedded processors, FPGA development, digital signal processing, or real-time system architectures.
* Experience with wireless communication technologies and high-speed digital interfaces.
* Experience with simulation, modeling, and analysis tools such as SPICE or MATLAB.
* Experience designing low-noise power systems, battery-powered products, or power management circuitry.

* Experience developing electronics for optical sensing, imaging, illumination, or metrology applications.
Note: We recognize that successful candidates may not meet every preferred qualification listed above. If your experience aligns with the core requirements and you are excited about the opportunity, we encourage you to apply.  

  

**Working Conditions**

* Regular on-site presence is required for integration, experimentation, and testing.
* Occasional travel to suppliers, manufacturing sites, or customer locations is expected, generally less than 10%.
* Ability to perform hands-on assembly and alignment activities and lift equipment or assemblies weighing up to 35 pounds.

**Interested?**

If you are interested in being a part of a team and creating an inclusive and diverse workplace, please apply online with your CV.

**About Nordson Electronics Solutions**

Nordson Electronics Solutions is a trusted surface treatment and precision fluid dispensing equipment supplier within the global electronics manufacturing industry, working closely with semiconductor, printed circuit board, and precision assembly manufacturers. By joining our team today, you will help us bring innovative ideas to life. Nordson Electronics Solutions is a global team that works to create machines and systems that improve the electronics and semiconductor manufacturing process. We offer a supportive culture in a growing and dynamic work environment. Whether you're just beginning your career or you're a seasoned professional, there's a place for you to belong at Nordson Elec

The Event IT Technician is responsible for the preparation, deployment, maintenance, and support of technology systems used in live events, trade shows, conferences, and corporate events. This role ensures event computers, networking equipment, storage systems (NAS), printers, and associated technology infrastructure are configured, updated, tested, and fully operational before, during, and after events. These responsibilities also extend to on-site, traveling locations.

The ideal candidate possesses strong technical troubleshooting skills, experience with both Windows and macOS environments, a solid understanding of networking fundamentals, and the ability to work in a fast-paced & team focused event production environment.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Computer & Event Technology Management**

* Configure, deploy, maintain, and troubleshoot event laptops (Windows & MacOS), and related hardware.
* Support both Windows PC and Apple Mac systems utilized in live production environments.
* Manage inventory of computers, peripherals, adapters, cables, and event technology equipment.
* Perform post-event equipment evaluations and ensure all systems are returned to operational standards.

* Layer 2 (Data Link): VLANs, switching, MAC addressing, and network segmentation.
* Layer 3 (Network): IP addressing, routing fundamentals, subnetting, and DHCP.
* Support network connectivity for event systems, media servers, printers, and production equipment.
* Assist with network documentation and infrastructure planning.

* Support Microsoft 365 applications and services.
* Troubleshoot Outlook, Teams, OneDrive, SharePoint, and related Microsoft platforms.
* Assist with user account setup, permissions, and device integrations.
* Support cloud collaboration and file-sharing workflows.

**Storage & Print Services**

* Configure and maintain Network Attached Storage (NAS) systems.
* Manage storage permissions, data organization, backups, and file-sharing processes.
* Configure and support print servers and network printers.
* Troubleshoot printing, connectivity, and driver-related issues.

**Event Support**

* Assist with onsite event deployment, setup, testing, and teardown, loading & unloading trucks.

* Respond quickly to technology issues and minimize downtime.

**Required Qualifications**

* 2+ years of experience in IT support, systems administration, event technology, or related field.

* Working knowledge of computer imaging and deployment processes.
* Proficiency in Microsoft 365 applications and services.
* Understanding of networking fundamentals, including OSI Layers 1-3.
* Experience with NAS storage systems and network printer/server configuration.
* Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced environment.
* Excellent communication and customer service skills.
* Ability to lift and transport equipment up to 50 lbs.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in live events, AV production, broadcast, or trade show environments.
* CompTIA A+, Network+, or similar certifications.
* Experience with Ubiquiti, Netgear, Fortinet, Qnap, or similar networking platforms.
* Familiarity with MDM platforms, JAMF, SmartDeploy, and endpoint management tools.
* Experience managing equipment inventory and asset tracking systems.
* Peplink or similar cellular bonded router experience.

The successful Event IT Technician is organized, detail-oriented, proactive, and thrives in a production-focused environment. They take ownership of technology readiness, can rapidly troubleshoot issues under pressure, and ensure event technology systems are reliable, secure, and ready for deployment.

jobs.title: Electrical Engineer - R&D
jobs.description:
**Job Title**: Electrical Engineer – R&D

**Department**: Research and Development

**SUMMARY:**

The R&D Electrical Engineer will apply electronics and engineering principles to develop, verify, assemble, and document electronic systems for testing and production of engine management components. Conduct technical research on existing and emergent technologies for understanding and potential business applications. Assist the design, verification, and production of new and existing automotive sensor products. Generate PCBs, schematics, wiring diagrams, system layouts, and mechanical drawings for documentation of test system builds. Identify and establish tolerances for sensor testing as needed. Leverage content-area expertise to develop creative solutions for technical problems in engineering design.

**RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Meet with design teams and stakeholders as needed to determine electronics applications and requirements.
* Produce high quality, accurate work, meeting design parameters and efficiency expectations.
* Create accurate, well-ordered schematics and PCBs using applicable Schematic and PCB Layout programs.
* Design well-ordered, compatible electrical/electronic sub-systems to component level.
* Evaluate, troubleshoot, design, and modify circuitry / systems for use in the production and evaluation of vehicle sensor components, as dictated within the scope of projects.
* Design/assist with PLC and microcontroller designs to enable test automation of engine operations and functions.
* Research and develop electronic test evaluation criteria for vehicle engine management components.
* Develop/conduct design reviews of proposed developments at key intervals with design team and stakeholders.
* Collaborate as needed with design team to address concerns and gather best ideas and practices for projects.
* Produce well-presented, labelled, and accurate spreadsheets to analyze, display, and share data as needed.
* Generate detailed operational procedures, specifications, diagrams, and documentation as needed.
* Support company needs with content-area expertise on sensor design and test issues.
* Utilize user feedback and data to upgrade, improve, or repair existing machines as appropriate.
* Keep current on advancements in technology, design trends, and engineering best practices.
* Ensure products are user friendly and safe for the environment, complying with industry safety standards.
* Continual diligence in improving and maximizing efficiency and accuracy for the above items.

**KNOWLEDGE AND SKILL REQUIREMENTS:**

* Education / Experience: BS in Electrical Engineering ideal, but preference is weighted towards documented, successful experience and knowledge of the processes of hands-on Electronics Design.
* Content-area Expertise: Sound knowledge of Electrical Design Engineering principles and best practices.
* PCB / Schematic Design: Ability to generate electronic designsdocumentation accurately and efficiently with applicable software in accordance with established best practices and principles.
* Languages: Any experience in PLC, PIC, Python, C++ (microcontrollers) programming is welcome and useful.
* Measurement: Strong understanding of Oscilloscopes, DMMs, and other measurement devices as needed.
* Verification: Employs robust strategies to verify accuracy of work product throughout design process.
* Automotive: Experience/knowledge is helpful, particularly with engines and electronic sensor components.

jobs.title: Supervisory Electronics Engineer
jobs.description:
**Summary**
-----------

This position is located in the National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration (NOAA), National Weather Service (NWS), Office of Observations (OBS), Surface and Upper Air Division (SUAD), Logistics Management Branch (LMB), National Reconditioning Center (NRC), with 1 vacancy in Grandview, MO.
  
  
This position is also announced under vacancy number NWS-27-13100069-ST, which is open to Status Candidates. You must apply to both announcements if you want to be considered for both.

Learn more about this agency

  

**This job is open to**
-----------------------

### **The public**

U.S. Citizens, Nationals or those who owe allegiance to the U.S.

### **Career transition (CTAP, ICTAP, RPL)**

Federal employees whose job, agency or department was eliminated and are eligible for priority over other applicants.

### **Veterans**

Veterans of the U.S. Armed Forces or a spouse, widow, widower or parent of a veteran, who may be eligible for derived preference

### **Clarification from the agency**

Open to the Public and Career Transition (CTAP, ICTAP, RPL).

  

**Duties**
----------

As a Supervisory Electronics Engineer, you will perform the following duties:

* As the Chief of the National Reconditioning Center (NRC), manage a team responsible for the repair and testing of the complex electronic equipment of all National Weather Service (NWS) programs, such as radars, computers, and remote sensing systems. Coordinate technical activities for the effective integration of all technical elements into a cohesive national Automated Surface Observing System (ASOS) and NEXRAD integrated logistics program (ILP) for the NWS and for agencies serviced as NWS Primary Inventory Control Activity (PICA). Provide coordination with technical activities, PICA requirements, and with the design, development, procurement, production, storage, distribution, maintenance, utilization and categorization of spare parts and equipment to be supported by the Office of Observations (OBS).
* Manage, control, and continuously operate automated software programs in direct support of ASOS and NEXRAD. Analyze, develop, and use engineering models and systems to optimize ASOS and NEXRAD logistics through the development of a logistics life-cycle plan. Provide inspections and analyses of newly repaired equipment and systems. Guide and monitor the National Logistics Support Center (NLSC) in the management and operation of a diverse range of ASOS and NEXRAD items, stocked and distributed by NLSC, used to resolve engineering, quality assurance, and other issues.
* Provide strategic planning support to senior management to assist in setting agency and the Surface and Upper Air Division's (SUAD) goals. Direct and develop plans for NRC program teams or other groups in accomplishing and producing projects and studies. Provide recommendations, advice and support to the SUAD Director on the composite impact of common and cross-cutting program issues, and requirements, NWS integrated work team activities, and solutions and proposals for supporting and improving NWS observations programs and projects. Analyze and evaluate the effectiveness of line program operations in meeting established goals and objectives. Represent the organization in reaching compromises and agreements. Serve as Contracting Officer Representative Level II (COR), and is responsible for the review of contracts and contracting actions to manage and ensure effective and efficient operations.

* The incumbent is required to have or obtain within two- year and maintain Federal Acquisition Certification for Program and Project Managers (FAC-P/PM) Level II.
* Must be able to obtain a FAC-COR Level II Certification within two years of assignment and maintain qualifications after that.

  

**Requirements**
----------------

### **Conditions of employment**

**Key Requirements:**

* Applicants must be U.S. Citizens.
* Suitable for Federal employment, as determined by background investigation.
* More requirements are listed under Qualifications and Additional Information.
* Must be registered for Selective Service, if applicable (www.sss.gov)
* Qualification requirements must be met by closing date of the announcement.

**Additional Considerations:**

* One year probationary period may be required.
* A one year supervisory probationary period may be required (probationary period can be served concurrently).
* Payment of relocation expenses (PCS) is not authorized.
* This position requires Moderate Risk Security Clearance.
* Background investigation will be required. Continued employment is subject to applicant's successful completion of security investigation and favorable adjudication. Failure to successfully meet these requirements will be grounds for termination.

* Note: A one year probationary period will be required unless you are a current Department of Commerce (including NOAA) employee and are in the same line of work and with no more than a 30 day break in service.

As a condition of employment for accepting this position, for those required to serve a 1-year probationary period, we will evaluate your fitness and whether your continued employment advances the public interest. In determining if your employment advances the public interest, we may consider:

jobs.title: Systems Software Engineer II
jobs.description:
**JOB SUMMARY:**

The position requires the individual to apply their technical knowledge and experience for the successful database programming and custom graphics development and subsequent installation of this programming into the Building Management System for all assigned projects. Additionally this role supports the startup, commissioning and trouble-shooting of the assigned projects. The position requires a high level of experience in computer skills and the understanding of computer-operated systems, including network types. This role will also require responsibility for documenting all fields as built conditions, as well as, the commissioning process documents. The position is required to closely interact with the Project Manager and any assigned Project Engineering staff to assist with the timely and successful completion of each project.

**ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:**

* Performs as a lead Systems Software Engineer in the development of lower and mid-level control systems databases & programs.
* Supports the execution of the initial systems point-to-point commissioning activities
* Performs the troubleshooting of local and wide area network issues as they arise.
* Utilizes computer hardware and software to support and/or execute the pre-functional testing of the system software code in relationship to the design sequence of operations.
* Participates and supports the final systems functional testing relative to standard, 3rd party, LEED and Title 24 testing as required.
* Possesses the knowledge of multiple vendor software versions
* Develops and utilizes the skill set to effectively work with 3rd party integrations of other vendor products, systems and protocols.
* Maintains a lead role in the field coordination of installing subcontractors when a Project Engineer is not assigned to the project.
* Responsible for attending required field project coordination meetings and commissioning meetings as required by the assigned projects.
* Participates and leads all end user/customer system training requirements on assigned projects.
* Responsible for the systematic turnover of the project from the construction phase to the Service team on all assigned projects.
* Assists Design Engineers with the validation of sequence of operations development against design build and/or contract requirements.
* Coordinates with project staff to ensure accurate and timely recording of project costs including time sheets, daily reports, etc.
* Manages field time and budgets relative to the field work of assigned projects.
* Provides the necessary leadership role for the field team when executing mid-sized projects requiring multiple team members.
* Communicates effectively with other team members regarding project issues, obstacles, and information needs.
* Attends and successfully completes the OSHA 10 and OSHA 30 safety training classes.
* Responsible for practicing safe work habits and participates in office safety program requirements and that of any specific safety requirements of all assigned projects.
* Responsible for coaching, mentoring and development of junior level Systems Software Engineers.

* Working knowledge of MS Office, Windows, File Structure. Basic TCP/IP network structure and web navigation are desired.
* Must be highly organized and possess the ability to work in a high paced environment with the ability to prioritize tasks to meet the schedules given by Sunbelt leadership.
* Has the ability to operate independently and autonomously and take ownership of all assigned tasks.

* Excellent oral, written and interpersonal skills are a requirement of this position.

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Systems (Games and Interactive Experiences)
jobs.description:
Meta is building frontier AI models that generate production-ready software. We're looking for a systems engineer to lead and push this capability toward games and interactive experiences that run smoothly on real devices, respond instantly to input, and adapt to their hardware and platform. Your systems expertise — frame pacing, device optimization, multiplayer networking, cross-platform porting — will directly improve our models by shaping the evaluation and training data we use. As a tech lead, you will drive technical strategy, own roadmaps, and solve the most complex problems in this space.  
  
  

### **Software Engineer, Systems (Games and Interactive Experiences) Responsibilities:**

* Drive technical strategy and roadmaps for games and interactive experiences, setting direction for the team and solving the most complex technical challenges in real-time systems
* Build, optimize, and ship interactive experiences that meet performance targets across frame rate, latency, and resource efficiency on real devices
* Develop cross-platform and networked real-time solutions that adapt to different hardware capabilities, form factors, and network conditions
* Create evaluation frameworks, benchmarks, and tooling to assess and improve model-generated experiences
* Lead cross-functional technical initiatives and mentor engineers through design reviews, technical guidance, and career development
* Own components or systems end-to-end, from design through production

  
  
  

### **Minimum Qualifications:**

* 8+ years of experience building and shipping games, applications, or interactive experiences to production
* Experience testing, debugging, and optimizing interactive applications for performance and reliability
* Experience as a tech lead, driving technical strategy, roadmaps, and solving complex cross-team technical problems
* Experience with the systems layer of interactive software, such as frame pacing, threading, app lifecycle, or platform integration
* Programming experience in C++, C#, Kotlin/Java, Swift, or shader languages
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, relevant technical field, or equivalent practical experience

  
  
  

### **Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience porting applications across platforms, form factors, or input devices
* Experience adhering to and implementing responsible, ethical AI practices (e.g., risk assessment, bias mitigation, quality and accuracy reviews)
* Demonstrated ability to integrate AI tools to optimize/redesign workflows and drive measurable impact (e.g., efficiency gains, quality improvements)
* Experience with game engine technology such as Unity or Unreal, or with real-time graphics and shader pipelines
* Demonstrated ongoing AI skill development (e.g., prompt/context engineering, agent orchestration) and staying current with emerging AI technologies
* Experience building networked real-time or multiplayer experiences
* Exposure to large language models or generative AI application development
* Experience building spatial or XR experiences, including sensor-driven input such as hand tracking and gaze
* Experience with graceful degradation strategies across varied hardware and thermal conditions
* Experience with performance profiling tools such as RenderDoc, Perfetto, PIX, or Instruments

  
  
  

### **About Meta:**

Meta builds technologies that help people connect, find communities, and grow businesses. When Facebook launched in 2004, it changed the way people connect. Apps like Messenger, Instagram and WhatsApp further empowered billions around the world. Now, Meta is moving beyond 2D screens toward immersive experiences like augmented and virtual reality to help build the next evolution in social technology. People who choose to build their careers by building with us at Meta help shape a future that will take us beyond what digital connection makes possible today—beyond the constraints of screens, the limits of distance, and even the rules of physics.  
  
  

Meta is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, transgender status, sexual stereotypes, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Meta participates in the E-Verify program in certain locations, as required by law. Please note that Meta may leverage artificial intelligence and machine learning technologies in connection with applications for employment.
  
  
Meta is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities in our recruiting process. If you need any assistance or accommodations due to a disability, please let us know at accommodations-ext@meta.com.  
  
$183,997/year to $257,000/year + bonus + equity + benefits

Compensation details listed in this posting reflect the base hourly rate, monthly rate, or annual salary only, and do not include bonus, equity or sales incentives, if applicable. In addition to base compensation, Meta offers benefits. Learn more about benefits at Meta.
