**Description**
---------------

At Northrop Grumman, our employees have incredible opportunities to work on revolutionary systems that impact people's lives around the world today, and for generations to come. Our pioneering and inventive spirit has enabled us to be at the forefront of many technological advancements in our nation's history - from the first flight across the Atlantic Ocean, to stealth bombers, to landing on the moon. We look for people who have bold new ideas, courage and a pioneering spirit to join forces to invent the future, and have fun along the way. Our culture thrives on intellectual curiosity, cognitive diversity and bringing your whole self to work — and we have an insatiable drive to do what others think is impossible. Our employees are not only part of history, they're making history.

At the heart of Defining Possible is our commitment to missions. In rapidly changing global security environments, Northrop Grumman brings informed insights and software-secure technology to enable strategic planning. We’re looking for innovators who can help us keep building on our wide portfolio of secure, affordable, integrated, and multi-domain systems and technologies that fuel those missions. By joining in our shared mission, we’ll support yours of expanding your personal network and developing skills, whether you are new to the field, or an industry thought leader. At Northrop Grumman, you’ll have the resources, support, and team to do some of the best work of your career.

We are seeking a Senior Principal Systems Engineer (T04) to support development of Electronic Warfare (EW) systems for airborne sensor platforms. This position is 100% onsite and focuses on system design, integration, and test of complex EW capabilities. The selected candidate will work closely with Integrated Product Team (IPT) leads across Hardware (HW), Software (SW), Firmware (FW), Integration & Test (I&T), and Program Management to help define, develop, integrate, and verify mission-effective EW solutions.

**This position requires up to 100% on-site**

**Roles and Responsibilities:**

  

* Contribute to system-level architecture, design, and requirements decomposition for airborne EW sensor systems.
* Support development, analysis, and maintenance of system and subsystem requirements, interfaces, and performance allocations.
* Plan and execute integration and test (I&T) activities for EW systems and sensors in laboratory and as required, field environments.
* Collaborate with HW, SW, FW, I&T, and Program Management team members to maintain technical alignment and support risk and schedule coordination.
* Perform system-level analysis, modeling, and performance trades to assess EW capabilities and inform design decisions.
* Develop and review test plans, procedures, and test reports; support configuration control and traceability to requirements.
* Support troubleshooting and root-cause analysis of system issues identified during integration and test, coordinating with cross-functional team members to implement solutions.
* Prepare and present technical material for internal and customer technical reviews (e.g., SRR, PDR, CDR, TRR) and technical interchange meetings.
* Contribute to risk identification, mitigation planning, and updates to the technical baseline for the EW system.
* Provide technical guidance and mentoring to junior and mid-level engineers as appropriate.

**This position is contingent upon the successful transfer of an active U.S Government Secret Clearance and the ability to obtain Special Program Access prior to start.**

**Basic Qualifications:**

  

* Bachelor’s degree with 8 years of experience, master's degree with 6 years of experience or Ph.D. with 4 year of experience in Science, Technology, Engineering, Mathematics, or related technical fields; an additional 4 years of experience may be considered in lieu of a degree.
* U.S Citizenship is required.
* A current/active U.S. Government Secret Clearance
* Ability to obtain Special Program Access (SAP) prior to start
* Experience in systems engineering, integration and test, and/or system design for complex aerospace or defense systems.
* Experience with airborne sensors, RF systems, and/or Electronic Warfare concepts (e.g., threat detection, jamming, countermeasures).
* Experience working within multi-disciplinary IPTs (HW, SW, FW, I&T, Program Management).

**Preferred Qualifications:**

  

* Direct experience with EW systems, such as radar warning receivers, electronic support measures, electronic attack, or airborne EW payloads.
* Experience with digital signal processing (DSP) for EW or RF sensors applications (e.g., detection, filtering, pulse/feature extraction, beamforming).
* Experience with analog RF hardware for EW sensor applications, including RF front end design, filtering, amplification, impedance matching, and component level troubleshooting across relevant frequency bands.
* Experience with requirements management tools (e.g., DOORS, Jama) and model-based systems engineering (MBSE) methods and tools.
* Background in system integration, verification and validation, and test execution for flight or mission systems.
* Proficiency with data analysis tools (e.g., MATLAB, Python) for EW, RF, or sensor performance assessment.
* Experience participating in technical reviews and contributing to proposal or capture activities for EW or sensor programs.
* Experience prioritizing and managing tasks while supporting multiple concurrent efforts

new_jobs.title: Mission Software Engineer
new_jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century's most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril's family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

**About the Team**
------------------

The Imaging team builds and fields state-of-the-art camera and sensor systems deployed to solve real security challenges for the United States and its allies. We work across the full stack, from bare-metal hardware and firmware to networked services and cloud integrations, and we own our systems all the way through to the field. When something breaks in a deployed environment, we fix it.

**About the Role**
------------------

We're looking for a Mission Software Engineer to join the Imaging Interfaces team. This is not a pure product development role. You will spend meaningful time keeping fielded systems alive, triaging issues across the full stack, and serving as a technical representative for our products in integrations with external teams and customers.  
  
The work is varied and sometimes ambiguous. You might spend a morning extending a gRPC service, an afternoon diagnosing a time sync issue on a deployed device over the phone with a field operator, and a week traveling to support a customer integration. You'll need to be comfortable with that range-and ideally energized by it.  
  
If you want to own your software end-to-end in a fast-moving environment where the stakes are real, this role is built for you.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

**Own fielded system success.** You are responsible for the health and uptime of deployed imaging systems. When issues arise-whether the root cause is in your code, the firmware, the network, or the hardware-you triage, diagnose, and drive resolution.  
  
**Build and maintain production services.** You'll develop and extend modular software services that run on edge-compute devices in austere environments. These services need to be reliable, observable, and maintainable by engineers who didn't write them.  
  
**Support field operations.** You'll work directly with field operators and non-technical users to diagnose and resolve issues on deployed hardware. Clear communication under pressure is part of the job.  
  
**Represent the team externally.** You'll serve as a subject matter expert in integrations with other products and teams; sometimes remotely, sometimes on-site. You don't need to know everything, but you need to be able to speak credibly across the full system stack and know what you don't know.

**Collaborate across teams.** You'll plan, build, and test complex functionality alongside firmware, hardware, and platform engineers. You'll need to be effective working across team and organizational boundaries.  
  
Travel expected approximately 25% of the time for field testing and customer integrations.

**What We're Looking For**
--------------------------

* **Comfort ramping quickly into unfamiliar languages, tools, and deployment systems.** Our language and tooling mix varies by product and shifts over time; we value engineers who get productive in a new stack rather than staying in one lane.
* **2+ years working in Linux-based environments,** including hands-on work with bare-metal hardware.
* **Demonstrated ability to diagnose and resolve issues across system boundaries** (networking, services, hardware interaction) without always having full visibility into every component.
* **Strong written and verbal communication skills,** including the ability to explain technical problems clearly to non-technical audiences, including operators in the field.
* **Eligibility to obtain and maintain a U.S. Secret clearance.**

**Preferred**
-------------

* Strength with performance-sensitive, real-time, or resource-constrained systems (edge or embedded).
* Experience with gRPC or similar RPC frameworks.
* Familiarity with systemd service management and observability practices on Linux.
* Familiarity with Nix or NixOS: uncommon, but genuinely valuable, and something you will use daily on our stack.
* Experience supporting fielded or deployed systems, not just development environments.
* Experience with imaging, EO/IR, ISR, or command-and-control (C2) systems.

**What Makes Someone Successful Here**
--------------------------------------

They close loops. When they pick up a problem they own it until it's resolved, not until it's someone els

new_jobs.description:
**Overview**
------------

At Ford, you’ll work on ideas that matter, alongside passionate people who want to make a global impact. Together, we’re shaping the next era of transportation—grounded in purpose, driven by progress. Make your move.

* Job Type: Full time
* Work Type: Hybrid

  

We made history and now we work to transform the future – for our customers, our communities and our families. You'll see your work on the road every day, helping people move freely and pursue their dreams. At Ford, you can build more than vehicles. Come build what matters.

  

Shape the Future of Manufacturing with **ATP**

At Ford, we aren’t just building vehicles — we are redefining how the world moves. Within the Advanced Industrial Technology and Platforms (ATP) organization, we are the architects of Ford’s next industrial revolution.

Our mission is clear: we build and scale industrial platforms, technologies, and capabilities that unlock Ford Firsts to drive sustained competitive advantage in manufacturing. Driven by our vision to "build once, scale everywhere," we bridge the gap between cutting-edge technology and global physical deployment.

Our guiding mantra is simple yet relentless: Scale what matters, win what's next.

If you are a high-tech builder, thinker, or innovator who thrives at the intersection of software, hardware, and massive scale, ATP is where you belong. Join us, and write the next chapter of industrial history.

**In this position...**

Plant teams lose hours each shift piecing together what went wrong: pulling data from separate systems, chasing history, and rebuilding context before they can fix anything. That groundwork is the job of AIR (Agentic Issue Resolution), ATP's AI system that helps plant teams investigate and fix production issues. AI agents take an issue, gather approved evidence from plant systems, connect it to what the plant already knows, and recommend a fix that a person reviews and approves. Each confirmed fix is saved so the next plant can reuse it.

**Why it's important...**

* AIR runs multiple investigation workflows on shared, reusable components.

* Investigations use authorized evidence and produce traceable recommendations a person can review.

* Plant teams spend less time rebuilding issue history and more time fixing problems.

* A fix confirmed at one plant is reused at the next without rework.

* The platform meets agreed security, reliability, and production-readiness standards.

**What you'll do...**

**Design the AIR Platform**

* Define the architecture across user experience, workflow orchestration, agents, tools, knowledge, evaluation, and feedback.

* Build reusable components for issue intake, investigation planning, evidence retrieval, analysis, recommendations, and follow-up.

* Set how agents call tools and plant systems through approved, permissioned interfaces.

**Make Every Investigation Evidence-First**

* Retrieve authorized sources before drawing conclusions, separate evidence from inference, and show the source behind every claim.

* Work with plant experts to turn how they solve problems into modular, measurable workflows.

* Capture each validated fix as a reusable record the next plant can apply.

**Build It to Run in a Plant**

* Define APIs and data contracts with CoreMesh (our manufacturing knowledge graph), FPS+ (the digital version of the Ford Production System), and InZone (the mobile app supervisors use to run a shift).

* Build in identity, permissions, audit logging, human approval steps, and clear escalation when the system is unsure.

Set standards for testing, versioning, release, rollback, monitoring, and production support.

**Lead the Engineering**

* Lead the AI agent and evaluation engineers on the AIR team, run design reviews, and coach the data scientists building agents.

* Partner with MLOps and evaluation engineers to measure agent behavior before release and monitor it after.

**You'll have...**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience.

* 7+ years building production software platforms or distributed systems, including technical leadership.

* Hands-on experience building applications on large language models: agent workflows, orchestration, retrieval, and tool integration.

* Strong API and service design, testing, and maintainable code in Python, TypeScript, Go, or Java.

* Experience designing secure systems with authorization, audit logging, and operational controls.

* Clear communication with engineering, data, security, and plant teams.

**Even better, you may have...**

* Manufacturing, quality, maintenance, or industrial operations experience.

* Knowledge graphs, ontologies, semantic search, or case-based reasoning.

* Event-driven systems, workflow engines, and production observability.

* Human-in-the-loop design for operational decisions.

* Google Cloud Platform experience.

You may not check every box, or your experience may look a little different from what we've outlined, but if you think you can bring value to Ford Motor Company, we encourage you to apply!
  
  
As an established global company, we offer the benefit of choice. You can choose what your Ford future will look like: will your story span the globe, or keep you close to home? Will your career be a deep dive into what you love, or a series of new teams and new skills? Will you be a leader, a changemaker, a technical expert, a culture builder…or all of the above? No matter what you choose, we offer a work life that works for you, including:
  

* Immediate medical, dental, vision, and prescription drug coverage
* Paid parental leave, new parent ramp-up programs, subsidized back-up child care and more
* Family building benefits including adoption and surrogacy expense reimbursement, fertility treatments and more
* Vehicle discount program for employees and family members and management leases
* Tuition assistance
* Established and active employee resourc

new_jobs.description:
**THE POSITION**

Our roster has an opening with your name on it

We are looking for a full stack Senior Software Engineer to lead the design, development, and delivery of high-scale applications. In this role, you will autonomously architect resilient systems, establish modern engineering standards, and collaborate closely with cross-functional partners to drive key technical and product initiatives across the organization. You'll own the frontend architecture of our web and mobile products end to end, while working comfortably across the stack to build and extend the services that power them. This is a senior role: you'll set technical direction, raise the quality bar, and mentor other engineers.

In addition to the specific responsibilities outlined above, employees may be required to perform other such duties as assigned by the Company. This ensures operational flexibility and allows the Company to meet evolving business needs.

  

**THE GAME PLAN**

Everyone on our team has a part to play

* Autonomously drive sustained business impact across team goals, product capabilities, and technical systems.
* Take ownership of semi-annual and annual technical objectives, consistently delivering high-quality, mission-critical systems on schedule.
* Define and shape the long-term architectural vision for core full stack and microservices platforms.
* Architect technical solutions for complex, ambiguous engineering challenges, making sound trade-offs between immediate velocity and long-term system health.
* Lead cross-team technical initiatives to extend software standards and platform impact across the engineering organization.
* Mentor engineers, influence organizational design standards, and champion best engineering and operational practices.
* Proactively manage technical dependencies and align architectural strategy across external engineering teams.
* Partner with product and business stakeholders to resolve ambiguity, clarify requirements, and address technical risks early in the lifecycle.
* Leverage deep domain knowledge to guide technology choices independently in fast-paced, high-scale environments.
* Streamline complex application architecture by focusing on core scalability, efficiency, and critical business outcomes.
* Architect and build applications that are resilient, secure, and maintainable under high traffic loads.
* Develop high-performance front-end interfaces and back-end microservices utilizing modern frameworks and design patterns.
* Design, build, and optimize high-throughput GraphQL APIs to power seamless client applications and backend integrations.
* Lead rigorous code reviews, establish testing strategies, and enforce engineering excellence across the software development lifecycle.
  

**THE STATS**

What we're looking for in our next teammate

* Degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience, with 5+ years building and shipping production software.
* Deep expertise in modern web frontend architecture with TypeScript, JavaScript (ES6+), and React — including component design, state management, and hooks.
* Mobile development with React Native, plus readiness to work natively: we're migrating our mobile apps to native (Swift/iOS and Kotlin/Android) with the help of AI tooling, so you're either comfortable in native mobile or a strong engineer eager to pick it up fast. Existing Swift or Kotlin experience is a plus.
* Strong command of HTML5, CSS3, responsive design, and cross-browser/cross-device compatibility across web and mobile.
* Proven track record of frontend performance optimization: code splitting, lazy loading, bundle/asset optimization, rendering performance, and Core Web Vitals.
* Test-first mindset with hands-on frontend testing experience (e.g., Jest, React Testing Library) and a commitment to code quality, maintainability, and observability.
* Working knowledge of backend services in Java and Spring Boot — enough to build and extend APIs and collaborate closely with backend teams.
* Experience consuming and integrating APIs on the client, including GraphQL.
* Solid grasp of software design patterns and architectural best practices for reliable, scalable, maintainable systems.
* Hands-on use of AI development tools (AI coding assistants, agentic IDEs, LLM-based testing or review tools) in real projects.
* Strong communication and cross-functional collaboration skills.
* Proven technical leadership: mentoring engineers, setting technical direction, and raising engineering standards across a team.

Preferred Skills

* Experience with design systems, reusable component libraries, and accessibility (WCAG) best practices.
* Familiarity with relational databases, messaging/streaming concepts (e.g., Kafka), and GraphQL federation (e.g., Cosmo).
* Experience with CI/CD pipelines and build tooling (e.g., Gradle, Buildkite).
* Cloud infrastructure (preferably AWS), containerization (Docker), and orchestration (Kubernetes); exposure to Helm and Terraform a plus.
  

**ABOUT FANDUEL**  
FanDuel Group is the premier mobile gaming company in the United States and Canada. FanDuel Group consists of a portfolio of leading brands across mobile wagering including: America's #1 Sportsbook, FanDuel Sportsbook; its leading iGaming platform, FanDuel Casino; the industry's unquestioned leader in horse racing and advance-deposit wagering, FanDuel Racing; and its daily fantasy sports product.  
In addition, FanDuel Group operates FanDuel TV, its broadly distributed linear cable television network and FanDuel TV+, its leading direct-to-consumer OTT platform. FanDuel Group has a presence across all 50 states, Canada, and Puerto Rico.  
The company is based in New York with US offices in Los Angeles, Atlanta, and Jersey City, as well as global offices in Canada and Scotland. The company's affiliates have offices worldwide, including in Ireland, Portugal, Romania, and Australia.  
FanDuel Group is a subsidiary of Flutter Entertainment, the world

Job Title: Sr. Systems Engineer

Posting Start Date: 10/27/26

Job Location(s): Greensboro - Thorndike

If you are looking for a challenging and exciting career in the world of technology, then look no further. Skyworks is an innovator of high-performance analog semiconductors whose solutions are powering the wireless networking revolution. Through our broad technology expertise and one of the most extensive product portfolios in the industry, we are Connecting Everyone and Everything, All the Time.

At Skyworks, you will find a fast-paced environment with a strong focus on global collaboration, minimal layers of management, and the freedom to make meaningful contributions in a setting that encourages creative thinking. We are excited about the opportunity to work with you and glad you want to be part of a team of talented individuals who together are changing the way the world communicates.

Requisition ID: 78874

Job Description:

**Description**
---------------

Skyworks is seeking a Systems Engineer to develop, model, and analyze advanced RF communication systems for mobile and connected applications. This role will translate customer use cases and evolving wireless requirements into system architectures, performance targets, and actionable product requirements.

Working closely with Systems Architects and cross-functional engineering teams, the Systems Engineer will evaluate system-level tradeoffs and help guide the development and integration of RF front-end and power-management solutions. The position will contribute to current product development while helping shape technology and product roadmaps for 5G Advanced, emerging 6G architectures, and adjacent connected applications.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Develop RF communication system models, simulations, and level plans for transmit and receive signal chains.
* Translate customer, platform, and system requirements into component-level and functional-block requirements.
* Analyze end-to-end system performance, including output power, efficiency, linearity, noise, sensitivity, dynamic range, thermal performance, and power consumption.
* Use MATLAB, SystemVue, Excel, and other modeling tools to evaluate RF components within cellular and connected-device architectures.
* Perform architecture and design tradeoff analyses across performance, size, power, integration complexity, cost, development risk, and schedule.
* Experience with AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, or similar for use in programming and system analysis
* Partner with Qorvo Systems Architects on advanced technologies and applications, including 5G Advanced, MIMO, Carrier Aggregation, Envelope Tracking, RF power management, IoT, UWB, baseband predistortion, antenna tuning, and emerging 6G concepts.
* Guide the system-level integration of RF functional blocks—including Power Amplifiers, LNAs, acoustic filters, SOI switches, antenna-tuning solutions, and power-management devices—into complete RF front-end modules.
* Collaborate with product, design, applications, test, characterization, and manufacturing teams to ensure system requirements are understood and achieved throughout development.
* Correlate simulation results with laboratory measurements and product characterization data.
* Support technical design reviews, architecture documentation, customer discussions, and system-level decision-making throughout the product lifecycle.
* Identify opportunities to improve system performance, product differentiation, modeling accuracy, and development efficiency.
* Contribute to the continued development of system-modeling methodologies, analysis tools, and reusable design processes.

**What Success Looks Like**
---------------------------

The successful candidate will connect customer and system-level requirements with practical product solutions. They will use modeling, analysis, and cross-functional collaboration to influence RF architectures, improve product performance, reduce development risk, and help create differentiated RF front-end solutions for future mobile and connected platforms.

**Required Experience and Skills**
----------------------------------

**Qualifications:**
-------------------

* Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Physics, Applied Mathematics, or a related technical discipline.
* 5+ years of relevant work experience.
  + If advanced degree less relevant work experience may be considered.
* Experience with RF communication systems, including system-level modeling, simulation, analysis, or design.
* Understanding of RF transmit and receive architectures and key performance parameters.
* Experience with RF simulation or analysis tools such as MATLAB, SystemVue, ADS, VSS, or equivalent platforms.
* Ability to analyze complex technical problems and translate results into clear requirements and recommendations.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain complex technical concepts to diverse technical audiences.
* Strong organizational skills and the ability to plan, prioritize, and execute multiple technical activities in a fast-paced development environment.
* High attention to detail and a commitment to developing robust, manufacturable, and high-yield products.
* Demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively across engineering disciplines and organizational boundaries.

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

* Master’s degree or PhD in Electrical Engineering, Physics, Applied Mathematics, or a related field.
* Experience with cellular RF front-end architectures, mobile handset platforms, or connected-device systems.
* Knowledge of Power Amplifiers, LNAs, acoustic filters, RF switches, RF power management, Envelope Tracking, antenna tuning, or integrated front-end modules.
* Familiarity with MIMO, Carrier Aggregation, wideband modulation, linearization, or baseband predistortion.
* Experience using RF laboratory

new_jobs.title: Automation Engineer
new_jobs.description:
The Automation Engineer will be responsible for the design, programming, integration, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement of automated assembly and testing equipment, including PLC-controlled machinery, robotic work cells, and associated controls hardware. This role will work cross-functionally with manufacturing engineering, maintenance, quality, and production teams to bring automated systems from concept through commissioning (both in-house and vendor) and provide ongoing production support. We are looking for individuals who have knowledge or experience in assembly/testing and automation processes, a keen eye for safety and quality, the ability to solve problems and troubleshoot, and the desire to develop and expand their skills in a production-driven environment. The Automation Engineer will report to the PES Value Stream Manager.

**What You'll Do**

**Controls Design and Programming**

* Design, develop, and debug PLC programs (Allen-Bradley, Siemens, or similar) for assembly automation equipment
* Program and integrate industrial robots (FANUC, Universal Robots, etc.) for pick-and-place, path planning, material handling, loading/unloading, dispensing, welding, or assembly applications
* Develop HMI screens and operator interfaces for machine control and diagnostics
* Design and implement vision system integration (Keyence or similar) for part inspection, guidance, and quality verification
* Configure and troubleshoot servo motion control systems, VFDs, and motor drives
* Collaborate with mechanical and electrical design engineers during the concept and design phases to ensure controls feasibility

**Equipment Specification & Vendor Management**

* Develop detailed technical specifications (URS/equipment specs) for new automation equipment, including PLC, robotics, and vision system requirements
* Research and evaluate automation equipment vendors, integrators, and component suppliers based on technical fit, cost, lead time, and reliability
* Solicit and review vendor quotes and proposals; lead technical evaluation and vendor selection process
* Manage vendor-built automation projects from kickoff through FAT/SAT and installation, including schedule tracking, budget oversight, and change order management
* Review vendor-supplied design packages, electrical schematics, and controls documentation for compliance with internal standards and specifications
* Act as primary technical point of contact and lead design reviews, progress meetings, and FAT/SAT activities with external vendors and integrators
* Ensure vendor equipment meets safety, quality, and performance requirements prior to acceptance and handoff to production

**Troubleshooting & Continuous Improvement**

* Provide technical support for installed equipment, including root cause analysis and corrective action for downtime events
* Identify and implement improvements to improve machine uptime, cycle time, and overall equipment effectiveness (OEE)
* Support preventive maintenance programs and develop troubleshooting documentation for maintenance and production staff
* Analyze production data and machine performance to identify optimization opportunities
* Integrate mechanical, electrical, pneumatic, and controls subsystems into functioning automated work cells

**Documentation & Compliance**

* Create and maintain electrical schematics, I/O lists, controls architecture diagrams, and program documentation that complies with all applicable safety standards
* Participate in risk assessments and safety validation for automated equipment
* Maintain version control and backups of PLC, HMI, and robot programs

**What You'll Bring**

* Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering, Mechatronics, Controls Engineering, or a related field
* 3+ years of experience programming and troubleshooting PLCs in an industrial/manufacturing environment
* Hands-on experience programming industrial robots and integrating them into automated systems
* Working knowledge of electrical schematics, ladder logic, structured text, and function block programming
* Understanding of pneumatics, sensors (photo eyes, proximity, encoders), servo/motion control, and machine safety circuits
* Experience with HMI development platforms
* Strong troubleshooting skills with the ability to diagnose mechanical, electrical, and software issues under time pressure
* Ability to read and interpret mechanical drawings, electrical schematics, and P&IDs
* Advanced knowledge of Microsoft Office Suite

**The Ideal Candidate Will Also Bring**

* Experience with FANUC and Universal Robots programming/certification
* Familiarity with machine vision systems (Keyence or similar)
* Experience with industrial networking protocols (EtherNet/IP, Profinet, DeviceNet, Modbus TCP)
* Experience with Autodesk Inventor, SolidWorks, or similar 3D CAD software for reviewing mechanical designs
* Prior experience in high-volume assembly and testing automation, packaging automation, or similar
* Six Sigma, Lean Manufacturing, or continuous improvement training

You should be proficient in:

* Bachelor's Degree
* 120/208/240/480 Voltage Systems
* CNC Machine Installation
* CAD Software
* Design for Assembly (DFA)
* Electrical / Electronic Systems
* Conduit Pulling
* Conduit Bending
* Access Control Systems
* Aerospace Manufacturing

new_jobs.title: Senior Power Electronics Engineer
new_jobs.description:
**Senior Power Electronics Engineer**
=====================================

**Packet Digital** is seeking a **Senior Power Electronics Engineer** to join our engineering team. In this role, you will help design and develop advanced power system electronics for unmanned systems, including drones and other terrestrial, space, and naval applications.

This is a great opportunity for an experienced hardware engineer who enjoys working across the full product development lifecycle - from requirements and circuit design through PCB layout, testing, troubleshooting, and product integration.

**About Packet Digital**
------------------------

Packet Digital designs, manufactures, and markets advanced electronic solutions for portable electronic devices, embedded systems, and unmanned aircraft. Our team develops innovative power electronics and battery-powered systems used in demanding real-world applications.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

As a Senior Power Electronics Engineer, you will be responsible for designing, developing, testing, and supporting electronic hardware systems. Responsibilities include:

* Capture and define product requirements based on customer needs and engineering input
* Research technologies, components, standards, and design approaches
* Propose, simulate, and validate hardware architectures and circuits
* Create schematics and PCB layouts based on project requirements
* Provide project timeline and development estimates
* Support product development from concept through production
* Optimize designs for cost, manufacturability, reliability, and performance
* Document assemblies, bills of materials, engineering changes, and related design details
* Participate in and lead schematic, layout, and design reviews
* Work closely with other engineering disciplines to complete product designs
* Assemble, test, troubleshoot, and validate prototypes and finished products
* Create technical and customer-facing documentation
* Provide customer support as needed
* Assist with maintaining component libraries and project databases
* Mentor less experienced engineers and share best practices
* Maintain a clean and organized lab and workspace
* Support a collaborative, positive, and team-oriented work environment
* Perform other duties as assigned

**What We're Looking For**
--------------------------

The ideal candidate is a hands-on hardware engineer with strong experience in power electronics, embedded systems, PCB design, and battery-powered applications.

### **Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering
* 4+ years of related hardware engineering experience
* Strong problem-solving and troubleshooting skills
* Deep understanding of DC-DC power conversion and switch-mode power supply topologies
* Experience with battery-based electric power systems
* Understanding of vehicle electrification and safety requirements for battery-powered systems
* Experience designing hardware involving microcontrollers
* Schematic capture and PCB layout experience
* Experience with thermal analysis and thermal management strategies
* Experience with precision analog measurements in high-noise environments
* Experience designing for high-current and high-voltage applications
* Experience implementing CAN, USB, and serial communication circuits
* Experience using test equipment such as oscilloscopes, signal generators, and power supplies
* Strong attention to detail and organizational skills
* Strong written and verbal communication skills
* Ability to work well in a fast-paced, team-based environment
* Ability to manage deadlines and support multiple project priorities

**Why Join Packet Digital?**
----------------------------

At Packet Digital, you will have the opportunity to work on advanced electronic systems that support innovative unmanned and battery-powered technologies. You'll collaborate with a multidisciplinary team, take ownership of meaningful design work, and contribute to products used in demanding applications.

We offer a collaborative and inclusive work environment with opportunities for professional growth, technical development, and advancement.

**Work Environment**
--------------------

This is a full-time position based in our main office. Candidates should be comfortable working in a hands-on engineering environment, collaborating with cross-functional teams, and supporting projects from concept through completion.

**Equal Opportunity Employer**
------------------------------

Packet Digital is an Equal Opportunity Employer and does not discriminate based on race, color, religion, gender, national origin, age, disability, or any other legally protected status. All qualified applicants will be considered for employment.

Description:

**Senior Software Engineer**

LayerZero Power Systems, Inc. is a leader in power management products for mission and process critical business applications. Our customer base is comprised of companies in the transaction processing, financial, computer service provision and semiconductor manufacture sectors. LayerZero provides innovative products to ensure ultimately high uptime of computers, servers, routers, communication equipment and other critical equipment. LayerZero manufactures “Best in Class” Eproducts representing high-end industrial solutions. LayerZero Power Systems is on a trajectory of sustained, high double-digit growth, with a loyal base of existing Fortune 100 customers and an expanding portfolio of new customers. To meet the challenge of growth and opportunities, LayerZero Power Systems is seeking additional Software Engineers to join the engineering team.

**PURPOSE & RESPONSIBILITIES**

The successful candidate will have direct responsibility for new product development projects and the processes that bring them to fruition. A Senior Software Engineer takes ownership of the full software life cycle from concept capture through end-of-life deprecation. Planning and process monitoring throughout the software life cycle are integral to the position’s responsibilities, as are specification, coding, testing and QA/QC of product. In addition to product development, a successful Senior Software Engineer acts as a role model and mentor for junior-level engineers, helping in guiding both their day-to-day contributions and their professional growth.

Embedded real-time software systems, communications, embedded databases, and human interfaces are all aspects of LayerZero’s core competency in software engineering. The successful candidate will be responsible for contributing to this broad range of software engineering disciplines. Excellence in customer communication is paramount to success in this role.

**PRIMARY DUTIES:**

* Work with customers, both within LayerZero and end users, to define and capture requirements.
* Develop software system architectures to realize complex requirements.

* Directly contribute to the addition of new features and bug fixes to new and existing systems.

* Participate in software code reviews via on-line tools.

* Mentor junior-level engineers.

**EXPERIENCE, SKILLS & EDUCATION:**

* Master of Science in Electrical Engineering, Master of Science in Computer Engineering, Master of Science in Computer Science, or Ph.D. in the above disciplines
* A minimum of 10 years of success in full software lifecycle development from concept capture through end-of-life

* Experience with embedded Linux build frameworks such as Yocto or Buildroot
* Experience with TCP/IP networking and industrial data communication protocols such as MODBUS/TCP, BACnet, and SNMP
* Expertise with project management and defect management tools

new_jobs.description:

Our products represent the industry standard for quality, which are all designed to improve engine performance and enhance reliability. We are looking for a skilled Embedded Electronics Hardware Engineer with a strong primary focus on schematic capture and PCB layout to join our team developing rugged embedded control systems for the industrial stationary engine market.

In this hands-on role, you will own the core hardware design process: translating system requirements into detailed schematics, developing high-reliability multilayer PCB layouts optimized for harsh industrial environments, and actively bringing up and debugging prototypes in the lab. You'll work closely with systems engineers, firmware developers, and manufacturing to deliver products that withstand vibration, extreme temperatures, EMI, and decades of continuous operation in power generation, gas compression, and heavy industrial applications.

This is an excellent opportunity for a detail-oriented hardware designer who loves the full cycle of circuit design - from initial concept sketches to functional prototypes on the bench.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Analyze, design, and develop analog and digital circuits as required
* Create detailed, well-documented schematics for embedded systems including microcontrollers, power supplies, analog sensor interfaces, high-voltage drivers, and industrial communication circuits
* Perform component selection, derating analysis, and worst-case circuit analysis for reliability in harsh conditions
* Design high-reliability multilayer PCBs (4–6 layers typical) with focus on signal integrity, power distribution, thermal management, EMI/EMC mitigation, and mechanical constraints
* Optimize layouts for manufacturability, testability, and long-term field reliability (vibration, shock, -40°C to +85°C operation)

* Assemble, power-up, and debug first-article prototypes using oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, spectrum analyzers, thermal imaging, and environmental chambers

* Support firmware integration and system-level validation on engine test stands
* Work directly with systems engineers to refine requirements and architecture

* Participate in root-cause analysis for field returns and legacy product sustaining
* Conduct design reviews

**Requirements:**

* Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering or related field
* 3+ years of hands-on experience in embedded hardware design, with strong emphasis on schematic capture and PCB layout.
* Proficiency with EDA tools (KiCad preferred)
* Solid understanding of analog/digital design, power electronics, high-speed signals, and EMI best practice
* Experience bringing up and debugging complex prototypes in a lab environment
* Familiarity with industrial/automotive-grade design practices (derating, conformal coating, wide-temp components)
* Hands-on skills with lab equipment (scopes, multimeters, soldering stations, logic analyzers)
* Strong attention to detail and documentation discipline

**Preferred Requirements:**

* Knowledge of engines and how they operate
* Experience designing electronics for stationary engines, heavy equipment, or similar harsh-environment applications
* Knowledge of industrial protocols (CAN/J1939, Modbus) and safety certifications (CSA, UL, IEC, ATEX)

-----------------------

**Sr. Hardware Development Electrical Engineer**
------------------------------------------------

*Infrastructure for the Autonomous Era · First in. First up.*

On-site · Austin, TX

-

**Who We Are**
--------------

First Order Effects (FOE) is building America's Infrastructure Prime for the robotic era. Autonomous ships, drones, and robots are rewriting how the world moves, fights, and builds - but none of them work without infrastructure to power them, connect them, and launch and recover them.

**We've Built Cutting Edge Systems at Legendary Companies**

Our team comes from SpaceX, Anduril, Saronic, Lockheed Skunk Works, Forterra, and Fuse Energy. * Do your own layout. You'll be placing parts and routing boards, not handing a schematic to someone else. Stackup, impedance control, power planes, thermal reliefs, creepage and clearance, and DFM for our own floor are your call.
* Design mixed-signal boards that have to work the first time in salt air, heat, and vibration, and keep working for months without anyone watching: controllers, gate drive, sensing and instrumentation, power supplies, interface and communications boards.
* Build the bench and the test fixtures for your boards, bring them up yourself, and write down what you learned so the next rev is better.
* Be on the floor when your boards get built and in the field when they get deployed. If one fails, you go find out why.
* Work closely with mechanical, thermal, firmware, test, and supply chain so the board fits the enclosure, sheds its heat, gets built repeatably, and uses parts we can actually buy.
* Push back on requirements that don't hold up, and change your mind when the data says to.

**What We're Looking For**
--------------------------

* Bachelor's degree in electrical engineering, computer engineering, or physics.
* 5+ years designing circuits, electronic products, or hardware in industry.
* You've taken new boards from a blank schematic through production, not incremental revisions of something that already existed, and you can show us the layouts.
* Fluent in at least one ECAD tool (we use KiCad; Altium or similar is fine) and able to manage a shared library and release process.

* Master's degree in electrical engineering or a related discipline.
* Mixed-signal layout experience: processors or FPGAs, Ethernet, high-speed serial, DDR, I2C/SPI, op-amps, ADCs/DACs, and power supply design on the same board.
* Power electronics layout: switching converters, gate drive, current sensing, magnetics placement, and managing loop area and parasitics at kilowatt scale.
* EMI/EMC-aware design and experience taking boards through environmental or compliance testing.
* Experience debugging and testing electronics on a bench and in the field, and the instinct to build the test setup before the problem shows up.
* Comfortable in Python and C/C++ for test automation, data analysis, and firmware collaboration.
* Experience on defense, aerospace, maritime, or other hardware that has to survive its environment.

**Compensation**
----------------

$140,000–$220,000 base + equity + benefits.

new_jobs.title: Computer Vision Software Engineer
new_jobs.description:
**About fab2**

The fab2 team can build anything. We design all the hardware and software needed to make chips and we make the fabs, tools, and components ourselves.  
  
We're looking for exceptional, hands-on people who can iterate to the limits of what's possible.

fab2 was founded by Sam Zeloof and Jim Keller. Sam is best known for making chips in his garage, and Jim has been a leader in the semiconductor industry for the past 40 years.

**About the Team**

The tool software group builds Linux control software and microcontroller firmware for fab2’s in-house semiconductor manufacturing equipment. This includes software for sensing, real-time microcontroller firmware, closed loop controls, sequencing, recipe execution, interlocks, operator user interfaces, and diagnostics.

**About the Role**

You will build computer vision software for lithography and metrology on semiconductor manufacturing equipment. This includes modeling optical systems and developing nanometer-scale alignment (fiducials, calibration methods) through iteration on real hardware. You will also develop vision systems for wafer-handling and process automation equipment. Additionally, you will work on post-lithography metrology, including defect detection and optical proximity correction (OPC) modeling.

You will work closely with full-stack, mechanical, electrical, optical, and process engineers on cross-functional problems.

We are open to a range of experience levels, from early-career to experienced engineers. The most important attribute is a strong mathematical and programming background and the ability to experiment and learn new things.

**Responsibilities**

* Develop classical computer vision algorithms for inspection, measurement/metrology, alignment, positioning, defect detection, and camera calibration.
* Build systems that extract reliable measurements and process information from images, including dimensions, feature boundaries, and manufacturing variation.
* Develop image registration, camera calibration, and pose estimation capabilities for precision equipment and optical systems.
* Apply spatial-domain and frequency-domain image processing techniques to solve scientific and industrial vision problems.
* Integrate computer vision systems with cameras, motion systems, robotics, and other electromechanical equipment.
* Turn experimental approaches into reliable production software, including testing, validation, performance optimization, and failure handling.
* Partner with software, mechanical, electrical, optical, and process engineers to develop new manufacturing and metrology tools.

**Required Experience**

* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Computer Science, Robotics, Electrical Engineering, Optical Engineering, Applied Physics, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Strong foundation in classical computer vision and image processing.
* Experience with techniques such as image registration, feature detection, camera calibration, geometric transformations, pose estimation, or image filtering.
* Experience analyzing images in both the spatial and frequency domains.
* Understanding of how optics, illumination, sensors, noise, and resolution affect image quality and computer vision performance.
* Experience developing computer vision software using Python, C++, OpenCV, or similar tools.
* Ability to design experiments, compare technical approaches, and characterize algorithm accuracy and repeatability.
* Ability to take computer vision work beyond a prototype and deploy it as maintainable, reliable software.

**Nice-to-have**

* Experience with semiconductor equipment, metrology, manufacturing inspection, microscopy, scientific instrumentation, or industrial automation.
* Experience characterizing optical systems using metrics such as resolution, MTF, PSF, etc.
* An understanding of optical inaccuracies: chromatic/spherical aberrations, astigmatism, etc.
* Experience with precision alignment, motion systems, robotics, or sensor fusion.
* Experience working with scientific or industrial cameras.
* Research experience, publications, or a strong computer vision project portfolio.

**Working at fab2**

We’re an early-stage hardware startup with solid funding, world-class advisors, and labs/offices in Austin, TX, Lockhart, TX, and San Francisco, CA.

**Benefits:** fab2 offers the following benefits, subject to applicable eligibility requirements:

* Medical, Dental, and Vision insurance
* Generous Paid Time Off inclusive of Holidays and Sick Time
* Visa Sponsorship
* Life and Disability Insurance
* Paid Parental Leave
* 401(k) retirement plan
* Weekly Learning & Development opportunities
* Commuter Benefits including Parking and Late Night Uber rides from the office
* Lunches daily, Dinners 3x per week, Stocked Office Kitchen with Snacks and Spindrifts

We are an equal-opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

The Starship team supports the mission to revolutionize orbital flight and space travel–opening access for humankind to establish new frontiers in space and ultimately become a multi-planetary species. Our avionics component development team builds some of the most advanced electronics ever flown in space at a cost and rate previously considered unthinkable in the space industry. Become a part of this fast moving and world class hardware team designing sensors, power and network systems, propulsion interfaces, and data acquisition for Starship. On this team, you'll work with super smart and motivated engineers and achieve truly audacious goals. **Company:** FireAvert, LLC  
**Location:** Mapleton, Utah

About FireAvert:

FireAvert is a growing technology company focused on developing innovative fire prevention and safety solutions. Our products combine electrical engineering, embedded systems, wireless communication, and smart technology to help prevent fires and protect lives and property.

As we continue to expand our product portfolio and engineering capabilities, we're looking for an experienced Lead Electrical Engineer to help drive the next generation of FireAvert products.

Position Overview:

We are seeking a highly experienced, hands-on **Lead Electrical Engineer** with a strong background in electrical hardware design and embedded firmware development.

This individual will take primary technical ownership of FireAvert's electrical engineering efforts, including circuit design, PCB development, embedded systems architecture, firmware development, testing, troubleshooting, and product certification support.

For several years, FireAvert has partnered with an external engineering consulting firm to handle much of our electrical hardware and firmware development. A major objective of this role is to progressively bring these engineering capabilities in-house, establishing stronger internal technical ownership while maintaining strategic relationships with outside engineering partners where appropriate.

The ideal candidate is an accomplished electrical engineer who is equally comfortable developing hardware, working with embedded firmware, solving complex technical problems, and leading other engineers.

This position will also provide technical leadership and mentorship to our existing electrical engineering team and work closely with mechanical engineering, software development, manufacturing, and executive leadership.

Key Responsibilities:

Electrical Hardware Design & Development

* Lead the electrical design and development of FireAvert's existing and future products.
* Design, review, and troubleshoot electrical schematics, PCB layouts, and electronic assemblies.
* Develop and maintain embedded hardware architectures incorporating microcontrollers, sensors, power supplies, wireless communication modules, and switching or control circuits.
* Oversee component selection, electrical BOMs, design documentation, and hardware revisions.
* Identify and implement improvements in product reliability, performance, manufacturability, and cost.
* Lead root-cause investigations and resolve complex electrical hardware failures.
* Support electrical safety evaluations, regulatory testing, and product certification efforts.

Embedded Firmware Development:

* Provide technical ownership of firmware architecture and development across FireAvert's embedded products.
* Develop, maintain, review, and troubleshoot embedded firmware, primarily in C/C++.
* Work with microcontrollers, communication interfaces, peripheral devices, and embedded communication protocols.
* Collaborate with cloud and software engineers to ensure reliable integration between embedded devices and connected platforms.
* Establish firmware development, testing, version control, and release management practices.
* Troubleshoot complex issues involving interactions between hardware, firmware, and connected systems.

Technical Leadership & Engineering Ownership:

* Serve as FireAvert's primary internal technical authority for electrical engineering and embedded systems.
* Lead electrical and firmware development projects from concept through production.
* Progressively assume ownership of engineering responsibilities currently managed by external consulting partners.
* Evaluate which engineering activities should be handled internally and which are best supported through specialized outside resources.
* Coordinate with external engineering consultants, providing technical direction and reviewing deliverables.
* Mentor and provide day-to-day technical guidance to junior electrical engineers.
* Establish engineering standards, documentation practices, design review processes, and long-term architectural direction.
* Partner with the CTO to prioritize engineering initiatives, allocate technical resources, and develop product roadmaps.

Product Validation & Manufacturing Support:

* Develop and oversee electrical and firmware validation procedures.
* Support product safety certification and compliance testing.
* Collaborate with manufacturing and quality teams to improve production processes, test fixtures, and product reliability.
* Investigate field failures and manufacturing issues, implementing corrective design improvements.
* Ensure designs are maintainable, manufacturable, scalable, and adequately documented.

Required Qualifications

* Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering or a closely related engineering discipline.
* **7+ years of professional electrical engineering experience**, with substantial hands-on hardware design responsibility.
* Strong understanding of analog and digital circuit design, schematic capture, PCB design, and component selection.
* Demonstrated experience bringing electronic products from initial concept through production.
* Professional experience developing or maintaining embedded firmware using C/C++.
* Strong understanding of microcontrollers, embedded peripherals, and common communication interfaces such as SPI, I²C, UART, and similar protocols.
* Proficiency using electrical laboratory equipment, including oscilloscopes, multimeters, logic analyzers, and related debugging tools.
* Demonstrated ability to troubleshoot complex problems spanning electrical hardware and embedded firmware.
* Experience coordinating technical projects, reviewing engineering work, or providing technical mentorship.
* Strong technical documentation, communication, and cross-functional collaborati

**Overview**

The Operating Systems and Server team within the Microsoft 365 Core Platform is responsible for improving the reliability, security, compliance, and operational health of the infrastructure that powers Microsoft 365 services worldwide.

Our team builds intelligent systems and automation that keep one of the world’s largest cloud fleets secure, current, and resilient. We focus on operating system lifecycle management, firmware health, security and patch freshness, vulnerability remediation, fleet compliance, and safe deployment of critical platform updates across hyperscale infrastructure.

As a Senior Software Engineer, you will design, build, and operate large-scale distributed systems that analyze fleet telemetry, identify security and freshness risks, and drive automated remediation across Microsoft 365 infrastructure. You will work at the intersection of cloud engineering, operating systems, firmware, security, data platforms, and AI-assisted operations to improve the trustworthiness and reliability of the services millions of customers depend on every day.

You will partner closely with security teams, hardware and firmware engineering, Azure infrastructure and Fleet management teams, service owners, and site reliability engineers to deliver solutions that improve platform health, reduce operational risk, and ensure Microsoft 365 infrastructure remains secure, compliant, and up to date.

The team operates a dedicated lab environment used to The lab enables realistic testing of hardware and software configurations, rollout safety mechanisms, telemetry, failure scenarios, and remediation workflows.

Enabling our success in these objectives is our lab environments, where we validate new server platforms, deployment processes, operating system changes, and firmware updates before they are introduced into production.In this role, This role will encompass lab management, including server inventory, capacity planning, hardware installation and retirement, configuration consistency, test readiness, and documentation. You will partner with hardware, firmware, networking, security, and deployment teams to ensure the environment remains representative, reliable, secure, and available for engineering validation.

You will also apply practical networking knowledge to configure and troubleshoot lab infrastructure, including top-of-rack switches (ToRs), VLANs, load balancers, virtual IP addresses (VIPs), routing, addressing, connectivity, and related network dependencies. Success requires the ability to diagnose issues across server, firmware, operating system, deployment, and network layers and to drive problems through resolution.

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

 **Responsibilities**

* Design and build large-scale distributed services that improve operating system, firmware, security, and patch freshness across Microsoft 365 infrastructure.
* Develop telemetry, analytics, and reporting platforms that measure fleet compliance, update readiness, vulnerability exposure, firmware health, and remediation progress.

At Blue Origin, we envision millions of people living and working in space for the benefit of Earth. We’re working to develop reusable, safe, and low-cost space vehicles and systems within a culture of safety, collaboration, and inclusion. Join our team of problem solvers as we add new chapters to the history of spaceflight!

Blue Origin is pioneering the future of space-based connectivity with TeraWave, a revolutionary satellite communications network designed to deliver symmetrical data speeds of up to 6 Tbps anywhere on Earth. This network will service tens of thousands of enterprise, data center, and government users who require reliable connectivity for critical operations.  

We are seeking a Sr. Electrical Engineer to own user terminal board design.

This is a founding hire. The terminal architecture is still converging, and the PCB workstream is waiting on the engineer who will lead it. You would not be inheriting a design — you would be defining the schematic and layout approach for a product line that does not exist yet, working alongside RF, ASIC, and antenna engineers who are locking their own requirements in parallel. If you want a role where your first six months determine how the hardware gets built rather than how it is maintained, this is that role.

  

We are developing a family of terminals at different capability and cost points, so this is not a one-design job. You will carry a design from architecture through prototype bring-up, then apply what you learn to the next variant. Terminals are a mass-market product, not spacecraft hardware — build volume and unit cost are first-order design constraints, and we deliberately reach for terrestrial, COTS, and automotive-industry pricing rather than traditional aerospace pricing.

  

The hardest part of this problem is power and heat. mmWave phased array apertures draw substantial current across a large board area with dynamic load behavior, and the resulting power density means conventional board-level thermal approaches do not come for free. Delivering that current cleanly, and getting the heat out, will dominate the physical design and significantly influence overall terminal size and weight. This is a mixed-signal power integrity and thermal codesign problem as much as it is a high-speed digital problem.

  

You will sit at the boundary between the digital and RF worlds: high-speed data buses and clock distribution on one side, beamforming ICs and radiating elements on the other, with mmWave routing that cannot tolerate the noise the digital side produces. Our RF and antenna teams are in-house, so you will co-design that interface with them directly rather than across a supplier boundary.

**Core responsibilities include, but are not limited to:**
----------------------------------------------------------

* Own schematic capture and layout strategy for user terminal logic boards and aperture PCBAs, from architecture through release to fabrication.
* Lead multi-layer, high-density interconnect PCB design, maintaining strict isolation between high-speed digital, IF, and sensitive mmWave routing on shared stackups.
* Design power delivery networks capable of supplying and distributing high aggregate current across large-format boards, with the dynamic load behavior that beamforming produces.
* Partner with thermal and mechanical engineering on board-level thermal design and heat extraction; the terminal's thermal solution and its electrical design cannot be developed separately.
* Collaborate with in-house RF, antenna, and ASIC engineers to define and optimize the physical interface between PCBs and radiating elements, including packaged-antenna integration, front-end IC placement, and feed routing.
* Design and route high-speed data buses and reference clock distribution networks connecting modem, processing, and beamforming devices; manage insertion loss, matching, and phase and amplitude consistency across many parallel chains.
* Perform signal integrity, power integrity, crosstalk, and EMI simulation and analysis at board and system level.
* Contribute to component selection and architecture trades across processing, power, and front-end, treating availability, lead time, and cost as first-class criteria alongside performance.
* Drive design for manufacturability and test with PCB fabricators and assembly partners, including panel utilization, stackup feasibility, and yield at production volume.
* Lead physical bring-up, hardware debug, and functional lab characterization of prototype boards and integrated terminals.
* Support qualification and regulatory compliance testing for an intentional radiator.
* Help establish the electrical design practices, review standards, and documentation the terminal program will run on.

**Required Qualifications:**
----------------------------

* Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering or a related technical field.
* 7+ years of experience in complex hardware product development, such as telecom infrastructure, mmWave or 5G radio hardware, high-performance computing hardware, or comparable.
* Proficiency in EDA tools such as Altium Designer or Cadence Allegro, with direct hands-on experience in schematic capture and layout of high-speed, multi-layer, mixed-signal boards.
* Demonstrated experience designing robust power delivery networks for high-current, dynamically loaded systems.
* Strong working understanding of RF fundamentals — impedance matching, transmission line design, shielding, insertion loss — sufficient to co-design effectively with RF and antenna specialists.
* Hands-on experience with high-speed oscilloscopes, spectrum analyzers, and vector network analyzers for hardware characterization and debug.
* Track record of carrying hardware through the full lifecycle, from concept and schematic through integration, test, and production.

new_jobs.description:
**About Agile Defense**

At Agile Defense we know that action defines the outcome and new challenges require new solutions. That’s why we always look to the future and embrace change with an unmovable spirit and the courage to build for what comes next.

Our vision is to bring adaptive innovation to support our nation's most important missions through the seamless integration of advanced technologies, elite minds, and unparalleled agility—leveraging a foundation of speed, flexibility, and ingenuity to strengthen and protect our nation’s vital interests.

**Requisition #:**

**Job Title for Careers Page:** Full-Stack Software Engineer

**Location:** National Capital Region (2 positions) | Honolulu, HI (1 position) | On-site

**Clearance Level:** TS/SCI eligibility required

**Required Certification(s):**None

### **Summary**

Target Effect Pairing (TEP) gives USPACOM Joint Fires AI recommendations, through the Maven Smart System, that commanders can trace, explain, and audit. Those recommendations are only useful if operators can compare options and see the reasoning in time to act on it. That puts weight on both ends of the stack: services that recompute quickly when inputs change, and interfaces that present dense comparisons and geography clearly.

You build across both. On the back end that means microservices, message-driven architecture, and workflow and agent orchestration. On the front end it means React and TypeScript interfaces, including geospatial views. You implement the Senior UX Designer's workflow designs and work with the program's architects, the Systems Integration Engineer, and the Product Manager/Fires SMEs.

The team works in two locations, requirements are still taking shape, and all work happens in secure facilities.

**What Success Looks Like**

**Objective 1: In the first 90 days, ship a feature end to end in the program's environment**

* Your code is reviewed, merged, and deployed in the secure environment.
* You can explain the operational workflow behind the feature to a Fires SME in their terms.
* You know where the program's architecture and interfaces constrain your work, and you build within them.

**Objective 2: Build services that recompute fast enough for operators to explore options**

* When an operator changes an input, the updated recommendation arrives inside their workflow rather than after it.
* Performance is measured, and regressions are caught before release.
* Each orchestration step leaves a record that can be traced during an audit.

**Objective 3: Build interfaces that let operators compare recommendations and see the reasoning**

* Comparative and geospatial views match the design, and usability testing confirms operators can read them.
* From the interface, an operator can trace any recommendation to the inputs and logic behind it.
* Changes requested after operator feedback ship in the next increment.

**Objective 4: Raise engineering quality across both locations**

* Your tests and reviews catch defects before government testing does.
* Documentation lets an engineer in the other location pick up your work without a handoff meeting.
* The code you write is covered by automated tests that run in the delivery pipeline.

**What You Bring**

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Proven ability to drive progress and create clarity in fast moving, ambiguous environments. Ability to maintain required TS/SCI access.

**Preferred Skills**

* You have built and shipped full-stack applications in production, with back-end services in Go, Java, or Python.
* You have built microservices or message-driven systems that held up under real load.
* You have built data-dense interfaces in React and TypeScript that people relied on to compare options.
* You have built geospatial visualizations with CesiumJS, Mapbox, or similar.
* You have worked with workflow or agent orchestration frameworks.
* You have tuned performance and can point to the measured result.
* You have built from a designer's work and pushed back constructively when something wouldn't work.
* Experience in secure or classified DoW environments, or with Maven Smart System, is a plus.

**WORKING CONDITIONS**

All work takes place in secure facilities. Two positions are based in the National Capital Region and travel 50% of the time. One is based in Honolulu with the USPACOM-based development team.

**Environmental Conditions**

Work is primarily performed in professional office, Government, and technical development environments. This position requires regular on-site collaboration in the San Diego area, including work with Government and development stakeholders at or in support of NIWC-Pacific. Periodic travel may be required to support operational stakeholders and other mission activities. Work may occur in secure facilities with restrictions on personal electronic devices and remote connectivity.

**Strength Demands**

Sedentary to light physical demands associated with professional office and technical work environments. Occasional movement or transport of laptops, documents, and other standard work materials may be required.

**Physical Requirements**

Regular use of computers and standard office equipment; ability to participate in meetings, technical working sessions, and collaborative development activities for extended periods; ability to communicate effectively in person and through approved electronic means; and ability to travel as required.

**Our Core Values**

Employees of Agile Defense are our number one priority, and the importance we place on our culture here is fundamental. Our culture is alive and evolving, but it always stays true to its roots. Here, you are valued as a family member, and we believe that we can accomplish great things together. Agile Defense has been highly successful in the past few years due to our employees and the culture we create together.

What makes us Agile? We call it the 6Hs, the values that define our culture and guide everything we do. Together
